title: Senior Product Manager
description:
As Senior Product Manager for 888casino, you will lead the product strategy and roadmap for the brand, translating customer, commercial and business priorities into clear product outcomes. You will be the senior product leader within the 888casino team, driving alignment across stakeholders and ensuring teams focus on the highest-value opportunities.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own and evolve the 888casino product strategy and roadmap.
  • Lead prioritization of major product initiatives based on customer value, commercial impact, data and strategic priorities.
  • Partner closely with Commercial, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing and Compliance to deliver key initiatives.
  • Define product objectives, success measures and business outcomes, using data and customer insight to guide decisions.
  • Lead complex and high-impact initiatives from discovery through delivery and optimization.
  • Balance revenue growth, customer experience, regulatory requirements and technical considerations when making product decisions.
  • Provide clear product direction to development teams and ensure alignment across multiple workstreams and dependencies.
  • Influence senior stakeholders and communicate product strategy, progress, trade-offs and recommendations clearly.
  • Identify future opportunities and build a strong pipeline of initiatives that continue to improve the 888casino proposition.
  • Provide product leadership and guidance to other Product Managers within the 888casino team.

Requirements

Who we are looking for:

  • Strong experience in real money gaming is essential, ideally within online casino, betting or another regulated gaming environment.
  • Significant experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of owning strategy and roadmaps for complex digital products.
  • Deep understanding of real money gaming customer journeys, commercial drivers, regulatory considerations and responsible gaming requirements.
  • Proven experience delivering complex, commercially important initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly autonomous, self-led and comfortable operating independently, with the ability to identify priorities, make decisions and drive initiatives forward with limited oversight.
  • Strong commercial and analytical mindset, using data and customer insight to guide prioritization and product decisions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including working with senior leadership.
  • Experience working closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, Marketing and Compliance teams.
  • Strong understanding of agile product development and the full product lifecycle.
  • Ability to translate strategic goals into clear product priorities, measurable outcomes and executable plans.
  • Experience managing multiple workstreams, dependencies and competing priorities.
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to provide direction, challenge constructively and guide other Product Managers.


What we offer:

Our roles offer more than just a job, you’ll become part of the evoke family! We have created an environment where our people can thrive. Check out some of the fantastic benefits on offer:

  • Financial: Competitive salary;
  • Hybrid working: Our employees can work from home up to 80% of the time with 20% of office time built in to ensure we get some face-to-face collaborative team time - and the chance for a coffee and a catch-up!;
  • Holiday entitlement;
  • eLearning;
  • Family Support: Industry-leading maternity and paternity leave and paid time off if you have caring responsibilities;
  • Health & wellbeing: Tools and services to help support your well-being, including support with mental health and financial education. You will also have access to gym discounts;
  • Healthcare: We prioritize your health and well-being, offering comprehensive healthcare benefits;
  • ...and more.


More about evoke

We’re a business that embraces change and progress. The power behind big name brands William Hill, 888, and Mr Green, evoke is the new name for 888 Holdings. Marking a new sense of purpose, direction, and ambition for the business, there couldn’t be a more exciting time to join us as we accelerate our journey to bring even greater delight to our customers with world-class betting and gaming experiences. That’s the future. That’s evoke.

At evoke, you’ll benefit from flexibility and a culture built on trust. We’ll give you the space to be yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest in your future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for you.

Apply

title: Engineer, Turnaround & Projects
company: BRUNEL INTERNATIONAL SOUTH EAST ASIA PTE. LTD.
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Engineer, Turnaround & Projects to support the planning, coordination, execution, and close-out of major plant turnarounds and project activities at our Jurong Island facility. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering safe, reliable, and cost-effective turnaround execution while supporting plant improvement and capital projects.

Key Responsibilities

Turnaround Planning & Engineering

  • Develop and maintain detailed turnaround work scopes and schedules.
  • Prepare execution work packs, methodologies, manpower requirements, equipment, tools, scaffolding, lifting plans, and logistics arrangements.
  • Conduct site verifications and technical reviews to ensure work readiness.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Inspection, and E&I teams for turnaround preparation and execution.
  • Support procurement of long-lead materials, specialist services, and rental equipment.
  • Participate in readiness reviews, risk assessments, and scope freeze activities.

Turnaround Execution

  • Coordinate daily shutdown activities to ensure safe and efficient execution.
  • Monitor contractor productivity, schedule adherence, quality, and milestone achievement.
  • Identify execution risks and implement recovery plans where required.
  • Resolve field technical issues in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Support progress reporting, control room coordination, startup, commissioning, and plant handover activities.
  • Support day or night shift operations during major turnaround events.

Project Engineering

  • Support execution of plant modification, reliability improvement, and minor CAPEX projects.
  • Coordinate engineering reviews, procurement, installation, and contractor management activities.
  • Develop and monitor project schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
  • Support Management of Change (MOC), commissioning, mechanical completion, and project close-out documentation.

Contractor & Cost Management

  • Coordinate contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with safety, quality, and project requirements.
  • Monitor contractor performance, manpower utilization, and project expenditures.
  • Support cost tracking, project justification, and management reporting activities.

Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in post-turnaround reviews and lesson-learned sessions.
  • Drive improvements in turnaround planning, execution methodologies, and maintenance practices.
  • Support development of engineering standards, templates, and procedures.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 5 years' maintenance or turnaround experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Chemicals, Industrial Gases, or related process industries.
  • Diploma holders with extensive relevant experience may also be considered.
  • Experience participating in at least two major plant turnarounds exceeding 150,000 man-hours is preferred.
  • Experience in gas processing plants, ASU, SMR, or gasification facilities will be advantageous.

Technical Competencies

  • Knowledge of maintenance planning and execution for rotating equipment including: Steam Turbines, Centrifugal Compressors , Reciprocating Compressors, Screw Compressors, Multistage Pumps
  • Familiarity with static equipment such as pressure vessels, boilers, storage tanks, piping systems, valves, and safety relief valves.
  • Understanding of engineering standards and codes including API and ASME.
  • Knowledge of SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) systems.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications

title: Lähihoitajia tuntityöhön lapsiperheiden palveluihin – Helsinki ja Länsi-Uusimaa
location: Kirkkonummi, Lohja, Karkkila, Kauniainen, Espoo, Ingå, Raasepori, Helsinki, Vihti, Finland
description:
Lähihoitajia tuntityöhön lapsiperheiden palveluihin – Helsinki ja Länsi-Uusimaa

Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten ja perheiden omassa arjessa joustavasti oman elämäntilanteesi mukaan? ANNU sosiaalipalvelut etsii lähihoitajia tuntityöhön Helsingin ja Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueelle.

Lähihoitajan työ ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja palkitsevaa. Voit työskennellä lapsiperheiden kotipalvelussa tai omaishoidon vapaan palveluissa asiakkaiden kodeissa. Työssä pääset tukemaan lapsia ja perheitä käytännönläheisesti heidän yksilöllisten tarpeidensa mukaisesti.

Tuntityöntekijänä voit vaikuttaa siihen, kuinka paljon ja milloin työskentelet. Työaika painottuu arkipäivien iltapäiviin, mutta työvuoroja voi olla myös iltaisin ja lauantaisin. Työtuntien määrä vaihtelee asiakastarpeen ja oman käytettävyytesi mukaan.

Asiakaskäynnit kestävät vähintään kaksi tuntia ja toteutuvat pääasiassa viikoittain. Vaikka kyseessä on tuntityö, etsimme työntekijöitä, jotka pystyvät sitoutumaan vastaanottamiinsa asiakkuuksiin useamman kuukauden ajaksi. Näin lapsille ja perheille voidaan tarjota turvallinen ja mahdollisimman pysyvä työntekijä.

Mitä työ sisältää?

Työpäivääsi voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

  • lapsen perustarpeista, hygieniasta ja ruokailusta huolehtimista

  • leikkimistä, ulkoilua ja yhdessä tekemistä

  • lapsen tukemista harrastuksissa ja muissa arjen tilanteissa

  • sairastuneiden tai erityistä tukea tarvitsevien lasten hoitamista

  • perheen avustamista kodinhoidossa ja ruoanvalmistuksessa

  • vanhempien jaksamisen ja koko perheen arjen tukemista.

Työtehtävät määräytyvät aina asiakasperheen tarpeiden sekä sovitun palvelun sisällön mukaan.

Toivomme sinulta

  • lähihoitajan tutkintoa

  • rekisteröitymistä Valviran ammattihenkilörekisteriin

  • kokemusta lasten ja lapsiperheiden kanssa työskentelystä

  • iloista, vastuullista ja asiakaslähtöistä työotetta

  • valmiutta työskennellä asiakkaiden kodeissa

  • kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ammattitaitoisesti

  • hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

  • sitoutumista vastaanottamiisi asiakkuuksiin.

Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi erityisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan alueella. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös muusta ammatillisesta osaamisestasi, mahdollisista erityisosaamisalueistasi sekä siitä, millä alueilla pystyt työskentelemään.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • joustavan tuntityön oman käytettävyytesi mukaan

  • mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa siihen, milloin, missä ja kuinka paljon työskentelet

  • työn, joka sopii esimerkiksi opiskelun, toisen työn tai muun elämäntilanteen rinnalle

  • mahdollisuuden ottaa vastaan yksittäisiä asiakkuuksia tai työskennellä enemmän asiakastarpeen mukaan

  • merkityksellisen ja monipuolisen työn lasten ja perheiden parissa

  • kattavan ja palkallisen perehdytyksen ennen työtehtävien aloittamista

  • oman esihenkilön tuen itsenäiseen asiakastyöhön

  • kannustavan ja välittävän työyhteisön

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi kasvavassa sosiaalialan yrityksessä.

Perehdytyksestä maksettava palkka maksetaan ensimmäisen palkanmaksun yhteydessä.

Palkkaus

Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Tehtävän palkkaluokka on G20C. Peruspalkan lisäksi maksamme saatavuuslisää, jolloin tuntipalkkasi on 18,57 euroa. Tämän lisäksi maksetaan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset ilta-, lauantai- ja muut mahdolliset lisät.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä meille hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Kerro hakemuksessasi:

  • kokemuksestasi lasten ja perheiden kanssa työskentelystä

  • ammatillisesta osaamisestasi

  • millä alueilla pystyt työskentelemään

  • millaisina viikonpäivinä ja kellonaikoina olet käytettävissä

  • kuinka paljon haluaisit työskennellä.

Voimme käyttää Teams-etäyhteyttä osana rekrytointiprosessia. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtäviä sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut on ystävänpäivänä vuonna 2023 perustettu, sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattilaisten luotsaama yritys. Tarjoamme palveluita lapsiperheille, nuorille ja aikuisille eri puolilla Suomea.

Tervetuloa mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme Suomen parasta sosiaalialan työpaikkaa!

title: Research Associate, Detection and automation
description:
Priority may be given to the following designated employment equity groups: women, Indigenous Peoples* (First Nations, Inuit and Métis), persons with disabilities and racialized persons*.

* The Employment Equity Act, which is under review, uses the terminology Aboriginal peoples and visible minorities.

Candidates are asked to self-declare when applying to this hiring process.

City: Edmonton

Organizational Unit: Quantum and Nanotechnologies

Classification: RO

Tenure: Term

Duration: 2 years

Language Requirements: English

Work arrangements: Due to the nature of the work and operational requirements, this position will require full-time physical presence at the NRC work location identified

At the NRC, we recognize that Indigenous candidates may have important connections to their communities and you may be eligible for an exception to this work arrangement. Alternative work arrangements may also be considered to accommodate candidates as required. To learn more about these options, please contact the NRC Hiring team using the contact information below.

Defence Industrial Strategy

The NRC has an important role within the Government of Canada's Defence Industrial Strategy, accelerating research and innovation, and helping Canadian businesses develop leading-edge technologies for civilian and military use.


With expertise across fields such as transportation, quantum science, medical countermeasures and advanced manufacturing, the NRC is hiring to drive the development of national sovereign defence capabilities. The following role will support the NRC’s contributions to defence priorities.

The role

We are looking for a Research Associate, Detection and Automation (RA) to support our Quantum and Nanotechnologies (QN) Research Centre. The incumbent would be someone who shares our core values of Integrity, Excellence, Respect and Creativity.

Our team is developing a variety of techniques for measuring materials important in the environment, including contaminents and pathogens, in cost effective and portable devices that can be automated. We are seeking a candidate that is looking for a dynamic, team-oriented setting to contribute to creating, new detection methods, devices, and protocols that can provide critical information about environmental contaminants.

These devices are intended to identify threats in the environment, where key problems from our collaborators inspire our efforts. Key collaborators from ECCC, DFO, and DRDC enable guiding our efforts toward real-world applications, including field tests.

The Research Associate, Detection and Automation will be able to contribute to core development and dissemination of results, including design of experiments, technology testing, and integration of devices into field-deployable packages. All of these activities take place in a team that is highly collaborative and where creativity in finding solutions to various environmental concerns is our guiding principle.

Screening criteria

Applicants must demonstrate within the content of their application that they meet the following screening criteria in order to be given further consideration as candidates:

Education

PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related fields.

As part of the RA Program, you must have received your PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related fields within the last five years or you expect to receive the degree within the next six months.

For information on certificates and diplomas issued abroad, please see Degree equivalency

Experience

  • Experience in biological and chemical sensors development and integration.
  • Experience with electrochemical and spectroscopic measurements.
  • Experience with methods and techniques related to preparing for, conducting, documenting and analyzing experiments/tests in chemical and biological sensors development.
  • Experience in the full spectrum of research activities including experimental design, data production, analysis and quality assurance as reported through written documentation, publications and/or presentations.
  • Experience in micro/nano-fabrication is an asset.

Condition of employment

Reliability Status
For a Reliability Status, verification of background information over a period of 5 years is required.

Language requirements

English

Information on language requirements and self-assessment tests

Assessment criteria

Candidates will be assessed on the basis of the following criteria:

Technical competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of analytical measuring principles and techniques.
  • Strong ability to perform, analyze, document complex biological and chemical sensors fabrications and related experiments.
  • Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary research environment, and ability to set priorities and manage time to maximize productivity.
  • Strong writing skills with the ability to write scientific reports, either as scientific publications or similar.
  • Strong presentation skills and ability to present scientific findings to research audiences at national or international conferences.

Behavioural competencies

  • Research - Communication (Level 2)
  • Research - Creative thinking (Level 2)
  • Research - Initiative (Level 2)
  • Research - Results orientation (Level 2)
  • Research - Teamwork (Level 2)

Competency Profile(s)

For this position, the NRC will evaluate candidates using the following competency profile: Research

View all competency profiles

Compensation

The intent of this hiring action is to staff through the Research Associate (RA) Program at the AsRO level, which is an early-career level position with a salary range of $83,985 to $116,641.

NOTE: Salary determination will be based on a review of the candidate’s expertise, outcomes and impacts of their previous work experience relative to the requirements of the level. As a guide, the current annual PhD recruiting rate is $83,985.

title: Research Analyst
description:
The Research Analyst will generate investment ideas across both equities and fixed income within their assigned area of market coverage, and communicate these ideas to the investing public and internal stakeholders through original research articles, house views, and presentations.

This is a cross-asset role: analysts are expected to build and extend coverage across both asset classes over time, rather than remaining confined to a single one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct fundamental research within an assigned area of coverage — by sector, issuer, and/or geography — spanning both equities and fixed income, using financial statements, company filings, published research, and other public sources.
  • Generate high-conviction investment ideas across stocks, bonds, unit trusts, and ETFs, and contribute to a comprehensive range of active and passive product recommendations.
  • Communicate ideas through original research articles, house views, and seminar presentations, to both the investing public and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain regular issuer coverage while extending into the corresponding equity or credit exposure of the same names where relevant.
  • Contribute to portfolio decision-making discussions within the team's disciplined investment process.
  • Undertake additional ad-hoc duties and projects as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (Accountancy, Economics, Finance, Business Administration, or related).
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read and interpret financial statements; exposure to both equity valuation methodologies and fixed income analysis (credit assessment, duration/spread concepts) is a strong plus — candidates with depth in one and genuine willingness to build the other are encouraged to apply.
  • Excellent command of spoken and written English, with strong storytelling ability — able to distil complex, cross-asset information into a clear, investable thesis for a retail and semi-professional audience.
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted research tools as part of day-to-day workflow.
  • Demonstrated interest in and passion for financial markets broadly, rather than a single asset class.
  • Able to multi-task and manage multiple concurrent deadlines across coverage areas.
  • At least one year of investment research experience preferred; fresh graduates with strong aptitude and a genuine interest in developing cross-asset capability are welcome to apply.
  • Proficiency in an additional language (e.g. Mandarin, Bahasa Melayu) or familiarity with Islamic finance principles will be viewed favourably.

title: Lead SDET – (India)
description:
Overview
We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end-to-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross-functional teams.
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.

  • Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates.

  • Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state-model outputs for completeness and consistency.

  • Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability.

  • Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with delivery timelines.

  • Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies.

  • Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement.

  • Act as the escalation point for cross-layer technical discrepancies and evidence-quality issues.

  • Compile and quality-check the raw technical evidence dossiers produced by the workstreams.

  • Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, or areas requiring rework before handoff to client stakeholders.

  • Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps.

  • Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic-gap assessment.

  • Support technical readout preparation by ensuring that findings are traceable to empirical evidence.

Project Details
Title: Lead SDET
Rate: $17/hr
Start Date: 19th October
Duration: 4 Months
Commitment: 22 Hours per Week
Location: India (Remote)
Job Type: Contractual (with the possibility of a Full-time employment extension based on performance and project needs)
QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proven experience of 8+ years in a QA leadership role spanning multiple testing layers (frontend, middleware, backend)

  • Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance

  • Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity-relationship data modeling and its application to test/data traceability

  • Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently verifying quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions

  • Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership and stakeholder communication skills

  • Deep technical grounding across QA disciplines (manual, automation, systems-level testing) to credibly guide teams at every layer

  • Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts

  • Experience leading complex multi-week technical QA, API validation, or security-assessment engagements is strongly preferred.

  • Experience establishing evidence/traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred.

  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity-relationship models, or structured technical dependency/evidence modeling is preferred; deep knowledge-graph engineering expertise is not required.

  • Ability to synthesize technical evidence into concise stakeholder-ready findings and handoff materials.

title: Haemme työntekijöitä lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun Turkuun!
description:
ANNU sosiaalipalvelut hakee nyt joukkoonsa lähihoitajaa luomaan kanssamme parempaa huomista ihanille asiakkaillemme.

Tiimimme kaipaa iloista ja sosiaalista työhönsä heittäytyjää, jolle lasten ja lapsiperheiden hyvinvointi on sydämen asia. Meillä työssä menestyy ihminen, joka kykenee työskentelemään asiakastyössä omatoimisesti ja ammattitaitoisesti.

Lähihoitajan työ ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla on monipuolista ja palkitsevaa. Etsimme lähihoitajaa lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun. Työajat vaihtelevat perheiden toiveiden ja Sinun työskentelymahdollisuuksiesi mukaisesti.

Työpäiväsi lähihoitajana sisältää esimerkiksi hoidettavan lapsen perustarpeista huolehtimista; hygieniasta ja ruokailuista huolehtimisesta, leikkimistä, ulkoilua tai vaikka harrastuksissa tukemista. Saatat auttaa perhettä esimerkiksi kodinhoidossa tai ruoanvalmistuksessa. Huomioithan, että työ ei ole satunnaista keikkatyötä, vaan etsimme työntekijöitä useamman kuukauden mittaisiin asiakkuuksiin.

Tarjoamme joustavan ja merkityksellisen palkkatyön:

  • Vaikutat itse työtunteihisi ja siihen, että milloin ja missä työskentelet. Työtuntien lisääminen on myös mahdollista.

  • Työaika painottuu päiväsaikaan, mutta voi olla myös iltapäivä/iltapainotteista.

  • ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla sinulla on työntekoasi tukeva esihenkilö.

  • Maksamme palkan kahdesti kuukaudessa.

  • Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen ennen työtehtävien alkamista, perehdytys on palkallinen ja se maksetaan ensimmäisen palkanmaksun yhteydessä.

  • Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimusta ja maksamme työstä työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan (palkkaluokka G20C).

ANNU sosiaalipalvelut on ystävänpäivänä 2023 perustettu, sote-alan ammattilaisten luotsaama yritys. Tarjoamme palveluita lapsiperheille, nuorille ja aikuisille ympäri Suomen!

Tervetuloa mukaamme luomaan Suomen parasta sosiaalialan työpaikkaa! Haethan pian, täytämme paikat sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä! Voimme käyttää teams-etäyhteyttä tarvittaessa osana rekrytointiprosessiamme.

They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.

Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on-budget
completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities
clearly and running client and internal project meetings.

successful and get the job done.
Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
Resolves destructive conflict.

  • Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to AVE installation projects

  • Provides constant monitoring of labor, equipment and materials budgets.
  • Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members.
  • Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
  • Performs field verification of prospective work site. Documents all issues with site and keeps everyone informed of potential issues and solutions.
  • Coordinates all drawings and documentation between all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitates and directs design reviews to assure proper documentation in the field.
  • Coordinates all system programming and final checkout of systems. Provides punch-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
  • Contracts with contractors and other trades when necessary.
  • Monitors status of projects including cost, timing and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
  • Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinates training & turnover of projects to client, service department, & sales.

Complexity:
Every project is different and every set of project stakeholders is different. The PM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between system design, site conditions and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence and people management skills. The PM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
Decision Making Authority: 1. Takes full ownership of project a. Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project. b. Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction. c. Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client. d. Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through. 2. Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions. 3. Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.
Physical Working Environment: Physical Demands:The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee. The employee may be exposed to construction site conditions on a regular basis. Employee will be responsible for their safety while on job sites and to comply with all safety regulations in place by the GC. Use of PPE is usually required on job sites. Specific vision abilities required for this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision and depth vision. When not on construction sites, the employee will experience normal office conditions and be required to use office equipment such as computers, peripherals, etc.
Travel: Frequent travel by car and occasional airplane trips are required. Employee must possess a valid driver’s license in their state of residence. Employees will be required to use their own vehicle and will be reimbursed for mileage at the current corporate rate. Local travel to job sites (within a 2 hour driving distance each way) will make up 70-90% usually but remote travel can be up to 30% of the job at times. 10% remote travel is required on a regular basis.

Education/ Certifications:

  • Associates/Bachelors degree required and/or equivalent experience. • A PMP certification from the Project Management Institute is desired. • AVIXA CTS certification • Other relevant certifications may be required or preferred based on the technology focus of the position.

Familiarity with audio/video systems installations.Knowledgeable of low voltage electrical projects.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Supervisory and people skills.

title: Adolescent & Family Services Clinician
description:
Educational Alliance brings together and partners with diverse communities in Lower Manhattan, offering individuals and families high-quality, multi-generational programs and services that enhance their well-being and socioeconomic opportunities. We are a place where everyone is welcome and where progress is powered one relationship at a time. We are proud of our legacy as a Jewish organization, and we provide high-quality, transformational services and programs to all New Yorkers through our network of community centers on Manhattan’s Lower East Side and East Village. As we have for 130 years, we offer best-in-class programming–now across 15 sites—focusing on a mix of education, health and wellness, arts and culture, and civic engagement.

The Center for Recovery and Wellness is part of Educational Alliance (EA), which brings together diverse communities in Lower Manhattan, offering individuals and families high-quality, multigenerational programs and services that enhance their well-being and socioeconomic opportunities. One of New York City’s original settlement houses, EA was founded in 1889 to offer educational, social, and cultural services to Jewish immigrants arriving to the Lower East Side. Today, EA partners with diverse communities throughout Lower Manhattan. Across our network of community centers, we empower people of all backgrounds to flourish, recognizing the intrinsic value within each individual and the importance of building community.

We are seeking an experienced Adolescent and Family Clinician who will provide specialized clinical counseling to adolescents (ages 12-21) and their families in a NYS OASAS-certified outpatient treatment program, with a primary focus on adolescent substance use, co-occurring mental health concerns, and family systems. Utilizing a person-centered, trauma-informed, and developmentally responsive lens, individualized assessment and counseling services are delivered both in person and virtually. The clinician in this role will also carry a secondary caseload of adult clients and provide support to significant others and family members across treatment tracks.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Clinical Services and Documentation

  • Maintain a primary caseload focused on adolescents and families, providing weekly individual counseling and family sessions consistent with individualized treatment plans across the Adolescent, Significant Other/Family, and adult Substance Use Treatment tracks.
  • Continuously assess the appropriateness of the current level of treatment, corresponding with LOCADTR and utilization review instruments (Substance Use treatment track).
  • Coordinate integrated services with medical, mental health, vocational, recovery services, and other social service providers.
  • Complete detailed progress notes, comprehensive treatment plans, intake/admission assessments, psychosocial assessments, discharge plans, and other required documentation in accordance with OASAS and CARF standards.
  • Maintain accurate and organized clinical charts, engaging in pre-audits of charts to ensure compliance with OASAS, managed care, and CARF standards.
  • Send weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports to HRA through the Substance Abuse Tracking and Reporting System.
  • Specimen collection for clients and monitors for treatment-related issues in order to update the treatment plan (Substance Use treatment track)
  • Check the toxicology reporting portal daily to ensure any positive toxicology reports are communicated to supervisory staff, documented, and addressed with the client (Substance Use treatment track)
  • Coordinate integrated services with medical, mental health, housing, vocational, recovery services, and other social service providers.
  • Facilitation of individual and group-level interventions during other clinician vacations or leave
  • Ensure that clients’ annual medical examinations are completed, with associated referrals as needed.
  • Engage parents, guardians, and/or family contacts upon admission of adolescent and adult clients; maintain consistent communication with referents and families throughout the course of treatment, including written or oral clinical updates as required.
  • Effective advocacy and collateral contacts to meet client treatment needs.

Other

  • Work collaboratively with our Project ENTER Team to build and sustain the adolescent caseload pipeline.
  • Attend staff meetings and training as required, as well as individual and group supervision.
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s Degree in a mental health discipline (MSW, MHC, MFT, etc.), and either licensed in the State of New York or working under a limited permit and eligible for licensure. Experience working with adolescents and/or families in a clinical or community-based setting is strongly preferred. OR
  • CASAC credentialing (Credentialed Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Counselor) or CASAC-T with a bachelor's degree in a human services-related field and a minimum of 2 years’ experience working in a substance use program and treating adolescent population.
  • Possess a demonstrated ability to deliver patient treatment, including communication skills, successful engagement in specialized human services training, understanding of human interaction and personality development, and the ability to write and record case documentation.
  • Familiar with Regulatory Agency/OASAS Regulations regarding the operation and practices of patient care.
  • Knowledge of adolescent development, family systems theory, and group dynamics is essential; experience with motivational interviewing, CBT, and evidence-based adolescent SUD interventions (e.g., CRAFT, MET/CBT, Brief Strategic Family Therapy) strongly preferred.
  • Must be computer-literate with knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Competent in electronic health records that support treatment plans and case notes such as AURA Relias, Netsmart, and AWARDS (willing to learn new systems).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and handle challenging situations in a professional and courteous manner
  • Self-motivated
  • Ability to work professionally and empathetically with a diverse group of clients and staff.
  • Bilingual in any language preferred; Spanish fluency is a plus given the communities served.


Benefits:

  • Generous PTO Policy
  • Competitive Salary
  • Medical & Dental Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • 403b Retirement Plans
  • Discount Perks for Movies, Broadway Shows, Amusement Parks.Etc
  • Free Gym Membership to our MCC Fitness & 14TH ST Y Gym
  • Discounts to programs at Educational Alliance


Limitations and Disclaimer

The above job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required for this position.

title: Manager - Cybersecurity Architect (Offensive AI Security)
description:
Job Objective

  • Serve as an Offensive Cybersecurity Architect for conventional applications, AI-enabled applications, products and cloud platforms by assessing system designs, identifying security weaknesses and validating relevant findings.
  • Use AI-assisted tools and automation to enhance penetration testing, vulnerability validation, evidence analysis and the quality, speed and consistency of security outputs.
  • Translate technical observations into clear risk exposure statements, architectural considerations and reproducible evidence.
  • Make findings transparent through structured documentation, reporting and communication, while ownership of risk treatment, remediation implementation, acceptance and closure remains with the respective business, product, platform and operational stakeholders.

Tasks Description

1. Application and AI Security Architecture Assessment

  • Assess conventional and AI-enabled application designs through threat modelling, trust-boundary analysis and abuse-case development.
  • Use AI-assisted analysis to expand test scenarios, identify attack paths and improve the completeness and consistency of architecture assessments.
  • Document architectural observations, risk exposure and security design options for stakeholder evaluation and action.

2. AI-Assisted Penetration Testing, Validation and Findings Communication

  • Perform or coordinate penetration testing and vulnerability assessments for conventional applications, AI-enabled applications, APIs, cloud-connected services and relevant products.
  • Use AI-assisted automation to generate and execute test cases, analyse responses, correlate evidence and accelerate validation while maintaining human verification.
  • Support the Vulnerability Alerting Process (VAP) by assessing8 high-priority vulnerabilities using criticality, exploitability, publicity and asset-context signals, and by contributing validated evidence for alerts and escalation.
  • Validate reported vulnerabilities, confirm exploitability and potential business impact, reduce false positives and document reproducible evidence.
  • Communicate findings, affected assets, risk exposure and technical considerations to accountable owners; remediation and closure remain with responsible stakeholders.

3. Cloud Security and Global Vulnerability Detection (GVD) Exposure Analysis

  • Correlate cloud asset inventory, vulnerability findings, exposure context, ownership data and business criticality.
  • Support Global Vulnerability Detection (GVD) activities by reviewing internal asset scope, scan coverage and Qualys findings, and by linking relevant evidence to ServiceNow records for accountable stakeholder follow-up.
  • Define and document risk exposure using exploitability, reachability, asset criticality and business context.
  • Make ownership and exposure information transparent to the stakeholders responsible for treatment decisions and follow-up.
  • Provide technical architecture observations and security options for cloud-hosted products and services.

4. Secure Architecture Advisory

  • Facilitate threat-modelling and secure design reviews with development and platform teams.
  • Identify security control gaps and explain their technical and business exposure where required.
  • Recommend architecture patterns, security requirements and treatment options for implementation by responsible teams.
  • Provide clarification and technical consultation without owning implementation or remediation closure.

5. AI-Enhanced Findings Transparency and Risk Communication

  • Use AI-assisted analysis to correlate findings, affected assets, evidence, ownership and business context across conventional and AI-enabled applications.
  • Verify generated outputs and maintain clear, traceable records that distinguish validated findings from unconfirmed observations.
  • Define risk exposure and provide concise reports and briefings on technical implications, business relevance and treatment options.
  • Monitor and report stakeholder-provided status while leaving treatment, implementation, acceptance and closure accountability with designated owners.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field ; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
  • Relevant security certification in application security, cloud security, penetration testing or security architecture is beneficial.
  • Training in secure software development, threat modelling, AI application security, AI-assisted penetration testing, security automation or cloud-native security is beneficial.
  • Minimum 5 years of cybersecurity experience across product security, application security, cloud security, security architecture or related disciplines.
  • Practical experience conducting threat modelling, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment and validation, and secure design reviews for conventional and AI-enabled applications.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools, automation, scripting and APIs to improve testing coverage, validation accuracy, evidence analysis and reporting efficiency.
  • Experience documenting technical evidence, defining risk exposure and communicating findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong technical judgement, stakeholder communication and advisory skills in distributed, multicultural environments.
  • Strong knowledge of security architecture, product and application security, threat modelling, trust boundaries, abuse cases and secure design patterns for conventional and AI-enabled applications.
  • Knowledge of AI application security, including adversarial prompt testing, guardrail by pass scenarios, data leakage, insecure integrations, model or agent abuse and related attack surfaces.
  • Practical penetration-testing and vulnerability-validation skills for web applications, APIs, cloud-connected services and AI-enabled applications, including development of reproducible evidence.
  • Ability to apply AI-assisted testing, scripting, APIs and workflow automation to generate testcases, support automated penetration testing, validate findings, correlate evidence and improve reporting outputs.
  • Ability to critically verify AI-generated outputs, minimize false positives, protect sensitive information and maintain appropriate human oversight and traceability.
  • Understanding of cloud assets, vulnerability findings, exposure context, ownership mapping, business criticality and secure SDLC practices.
  • Working knowledge of vulnerability disclosure, researcher-submission triage, validation, ownership identification and risk communication.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into transparent risk statements, business exposure, architectural considerations and treatment options for decision by accountable stakeholders.

Please be informed that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Hankekehityspäällikkö, Tilat, Espoo
description:

Tehtävässä korostuvat investointisuunnittelu, vuokrahankkeiden kilpailutuksen johtaminen, asiakkuuksien johtaminen sekä yhteistyö keskeisten kumppaneiden kanssa. Tehtävä sisältää myös kiinteistökehityskohteiden edistämistä alueella. Tulevaisuudessa tehtävä saattaa sisältää myös kiinteistöjen transaktioihin liittyvää valmistelua ja toimeenpanoa.

Tehtävässä toimit tilapalveluiden johtoryhmän jäsenenä. Johdat tilasuunnitteluyksikköä, joka vastaa hankkeiden alkuvaiheen valmistelusta, tarveselvityksistä, hankekehityksestä sekä vuokrahankkeiden kilpailutuksista. Työnkuvaan kuuluvat myös kaavalausunnot ja lausuntoihin liittyvä toimivalta.

Odotamme sinulta tehtävään soveltuvaa ylempää korkeakoulututkintoa sekä vahvaa ja monipuolista kokemusta kiinteistöalalta, tilahankkeiden valmistelusta, vuokrahankkeista ja projektijohtamisesta. Arvostamme erityisesti sopimusosaamista, neuvotteluosaamista sekä kykyä hallita laajoja, useita toimijoita ja aikatauluja yhdistäviä kokonaisuuksia. Investointi- ja taloudellinen ymmärrys on edellytys tehtävässä menestymiselle. Kokemus sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon kiinteistöistä, julkisen sektorin tilahankkeista, johtoryhmätyöskentelystä ja esihenkilötyöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos olet oma-aloitteinen, yhteistyöhakuinen ja kehitysmyönteinen. Tarvitset vahvaa kokonaisuuksien hallintaa, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja sekä kykyä edistää samanaikaisesti useita hankkeita, sopimusprosesseja ja sidosryhmäyhteistyötä muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä.

title: Network Engineer, Foundation & Support
description:
Meta is seeking a Network Engineer, Foundation & Support to join our Edge and Network Services (ENS) Foundation NetOps team. In this role, you will utilize your knowledge in hyperscale data center structured cabling, fiber connectivity solutions, and IP networking to support the delivery of field repair services. You will work closely with internal business teams, external vendors, network design/engineering, and other cross-functional teams to develop strategies for integrating new technologies and better supporting existing technologies across our operational fleet. Your objective will be to understand technical drivers for the business and organize strategies to ensure operational supportability meets those needs. Additionally, you will help represent ENS across various stakeholder groups to help achieve critical projects. Our team is dedicated to improving the operational efficiency and reliability of one of the world's most dynamic and fast-paced networks.

Responsibilities

  • Incident Response: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, managed service providers, and third-party vendor partners to investigate complex technical and process issues during major incidents/site events (SEVs) on edge, caching, and network infrastructure. Work closely with team members to understand the root cause of incidents and contribute to their resolution
  • Change Management: Identify security & business continuity issues affecting the network and infrastructure at Meta and work with the team to implement effective changes. Provide feedback on existing tools, processes, and policies to help scale with the rapid expansion of the Meta platform and customer base
  • Operations: Drive operations by identifying improvement opportunities across policies, processes, and procedures to improve efficiency and quality of activities. Ensure standards compliance across the network and optimize service delivery
  • Collaboration and Partnership: Work closely with internal customers to address their needs and issues, and influence future iterations of data center and network designs for seamless integration of new infrastructure and scalability
  • Team Leadership: Work with cross-functional teams within and outside the organization to deliver business outcomes predictability across global sites. Analyze operational datasets to detect and prioritize problems and create aligned team projects, programs, and roadmaps
  • Risk Management: Collaborate with partner teams to design and implement aligned processes that identify and manage data and asset protection risks, as well as operations continuity issues across the network
  • Information and Data Assurance: Ensure relevant operational process, procedure, and policy documentation is effectively managed, and the data required to support operations is complete and accurate in systems
  • Automation: Collaborate with the team to analyze operational events to identify new automation opportunities and achieve our goals of all Tier-1 faults in the network being fully remediated by software. Help others understand our requirements and drive their roadmaps, and in some cases, directly implement lightweight solutions in code
  • Data Measurement: Drive quality into the metrics we report, measuring and analyzing escalation issues, fault/event trends, infrastructure capacity, and vendor performance failures. Formulate appropriate metrics and definitions of success to drive quality, efficiency, cost, and timeliness, evolving these over time to match changes to the infrastructure and business requirements
  • Communication: Provide clear and effective communication around personal and team goals, progress, outcomes, and lessons learned across assigned scope
  • Travel: International and domestic travel may be required up to 25% of the time, depending on the needs of the business

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
  • 7+ years of experience operating, deploying, and designing large-scale network, optical, and/or physical layer infrastructure
  • 7+ years of network operations experience while supporting large-scale service provider, data center, and/or enterprise network infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with various optical/network communication equipment such as network/fiber/copper test gear, and other WDM equipment, as well as associated tools and test equipment
  • Communication skills with a demonstrated ability to engage effectively with hardware vendors, service providers, and colocation facility vendors globally, and translate performance issues into actionable technical requirements
  • Experience analyzing tactical situations, troubleshooting, root causing systems and tools, and problem solving via tasks or larger cross functional projects
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to external vendors to direct repair actions
  • Working knowledge of Network Services, including topology, traffic analysis, hardware platform, and architectures
  • Familiarity with Enterprise and Service Provider network hardware platforms and architectures, including Cisco and Juniper routers/switches and Nexus data center switching hardware platforms
  • Knowledge of physical data center design: rack elevations, cabling, fiber optics, power/cooling, and facility infrastructure
  • Experience with network hardware platforms and architectures including Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Ciena, Infinera, Nokia, Cisco WDM Equipment
  • Ability to move technical or engineering programs and products from inception to delivery, and articulate their impact using metrics

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in partnering with infrastructure engineers within varied infrastructure environments, such as data center facilities or leased facilities
  • Direct experience within global Network Operations Center (NOC) environments and managing SLAs (service level agreements) and continuous improvement against metrics at scale
  • Project management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

title: Brand Identity & Design Coordinator
description:

In this role, you'll be at the centre of ING Australia's internal creative studio, helping shape how creative work is planned, prioritised and delivered across the business. Using your strong organisational, stakeholder management and workflow coordination skills, you'll manage incoming creative requests, oversee workflow and resource planning, and ensure projects are clearly briefed, prioritized, tracked and delivered to agreed timelines.


Reporting to the Brand & Creative Operations Senior Manager, you'll work closely with Brand Managers, Marketing Managers, designers, copywriters and stakeholders across Marketing, Brand & Corporate Affairs. This is an excellent opportunity for a brand, marketing or creative operations professional looking to deepen their expertise in brand management, governance and creative operations within a highly regulated environment.

If you're ready to do something different, we'd love to hear from you!



What you’ll do…

  • Coordinate studio workflow, resource planning, stand-ups and prioritisation meetings to maintain visibility of deadlines and capacity.

  • Act as a trusted brand advisor, helping teams across ING apply our brand identity consistently and effectively across customer and employee communications.
  • Coordinate brand governance and communications review processes, ensuring submissions are complete, compliant and accurately tracked.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance workflows, reporting, templates and the use of approved AI and digital tools.

What we’re looking for…

  • 3+ years' experience in brand, marketing, design agency, creative services or a similar coordination role.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, customer-focused approach.
  • Experience using workflow, project management or planning tools, along with strong Microsoft 365 capabilities.
  • Knowledge of brand governance, creative production workflows or regulated environments, with an interest in AI, automation and continuous improvement.

What’s in it for you?

  • Discounted ING Health Insurance.

About Us

At ING, we’re all about making life simpler and more rewarding - for the people who bank with us, the team members who work with us, and the communities we’re proud to support. Joining ING means stepping into an environment where your individuality isn’t just welcomed - it’s celebrated. We’ve built a culture that’s fun, inclusive, and supportive, giving you the freedom to be yourself, so you can do your thing.

Whether you’re taking ownership of exciting projects, thinking outside the box, or working with global colleagues, you’ll find ING is the kind of place where growth isn’t just a possibility; it’s a promise. As a WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality and Family Inclusive workplace, you’ll feel the difference in how we value and champion our people.

We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities, and how you align with our values - not on ticking every box. So, if you’re interested but don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply. We’re invested in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels like they belong. We’re your allies in helping you do your thing during the recruitment process, so let us know (email below) if you require any support or adjustments when you apply.

Sounds like your kind of vibe? We can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Technical Solution Lead – Learning Technology
description:
This is a remote position.

About TTRO
The Training Room Online (TTRO) designs and delivers digital learning for organisations across South Africa, the UAE and the wider MENA region.

The role
We're looking for a Solution Lead to own our learning-technology work. That means large-scale learning platforms (Moodle and Surge9), how they are architected and governed, and how the partners around them come together as one working system.

You'll take over an established portfolio and hold it at programme level, across clients and platforms rather than one project at a time. The role is based in South Africa, with a global client base. You'll report to the Head of Product Development, with a dotted line to the Head of Solutions.

What you'll do

  • Own the learning-technology solution across a portfolio of client programmes. You set the approach and standards so the work holds together across clients and platforms.
  • Lead solutioning on new opportunities. You scope, size and cost the work, write the solution narrative and technical approach, and defend it in commercial conversations.
  • Lead the technical scoping, architecture and management of Moodle and Surge9 implementations, which is about half the role. This includes platform governance: plugin security, POPIA compliance, CI/CD, LTI and interoperability.
  • Bring infrastructure, development, data-visualisation and platform partners together into one linked system. You hold technical quality across parties you don't directly manage.
  • Work with the client leads who own each account, and link the learning-technology solution into the wider programme, including content and other services.
  • Work closely with our Product team, shaping client solutions that draw on, and feed back into, our productised platform capability.
  • Specify what each solution needs so our Delivery team can plan and execute: components, success measures, costs, skills and partner inputs.
  • Build solutioning capability in others through method-sharing and coaching. We work squad-first, so this is an enabling role, not a solo expert seat.

What this role is not
This is not a hands-on software development role. Deep custom build sits with our development partners, and learning frameworks and methodology sit with our Skills and Capability team. You hold the architecture and make sure the whole solution fits together.



Requirements

What you'll bring

  • 8–12 years in learning technology, digital learning systems, ed-tech delivery or technical solutioning, with depth in large-scale learning platforms.
  • Moodle experience is essential. Surge9 or a comparable enterprise learning platform (such as Totara, Docebo or Cornerstone) is an advantage.
  • A track record of owning a technical approach across multiple engagements or clients, not only delivering discrete projects.
  • Client-facing solutioning or technical-advisory experience, including work with senior stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience scoping and managing platform implementations and governance: security, POPIA or equivalent data-protection compliance, LTI and interoperability, and CI/CD.
  • Experience coordinating infrastructure, development and data-visualisation partners.

Years matter less than evidence. If you have built, architected and led this kind of work with fewer years, we'd still like to hear from you.

How you work

  • You think in systems. You see how platforms, infrastructure, data and content connect, and you spot where one piece breaks the whole.
  • You make structure visible. You map systems as blocks and relationships, often live in the room, so others can pressure-test them.
  • You give vague client needs a shape, such as an architecture or a measurable structure that others can work from.
  • You write and present clearly, you choose Word or PowerPoint depending on the audience, and you work comfortably with and through AI.
  • You hold solution quality and commercial reality together.
When you apply
Please include a short note on a learning-technology ecosystem you've architected. Tell us which platforms were involved, who the partners were, and what you were accountable for.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Remote working. This is a remote role. You work from home anywhere in South Africa
  • A globally distributed team. You'll work with colleagues, partners and clients across South Africa, the UAE, the MENA region and beyond, mostly online and occasionally in person.
  • Home-office support. A monthly allowance towards connectivity and data
  • Meaningful work. Large-scale learning programmes for clients worldwide, in a squad-based team that shares method and builds capability together.


By applying, you consent to TTRO processing your personal information for recruitment purposes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

TTRO is committed to employment equity. In line with our Employment Equity Plan, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups.

Due to the volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, please consider your application unsuccessful.

title: Oracle Integration Cloud Developer
description:
Oracle Cloud Integration Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Oracle Cloud Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$170,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Integration Cloud Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integration scenarios that connect Oracle Cloud Applications, on-premises Oracle systems, and third-party platforms. In this role you will own the full integration lifecycle, from analysis and design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience with OIC integrations, processes, and visual builder applications, and will combine that with a clear understanding of integration patterns, API management, and Oracle Cloud Applications data models.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integration flows in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Oracle Cloud Applications (ERP, HCM, CX) with on-premises and third-party systems.
  • Build app-driven and scheduled orchestrations, including complex mappings, error handling, and recovery flows.
  • Configure and operate a wide range of OIC adapters (REST, SOAP, FTP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, custom).
  • Develop process automation flows using OIC Process Cloud Service for human-centric workflows.
  • Build Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) applications integrated with OIC and Oracle Cloud Applications.
  • Implement API management strategies, including security policies, throttling, and developer portals.
  • Design robust error-handling and notification patterns, including retries, escalation, and resubmission workflows.
  • Optimize performance of high-volume integrations through batching, parallelism, and asynchronous patterns.
  • Migrate legacy Oracle SOA Suite or third-party integrations to OIC.
  • Collaborate with Oracle Cloud Applications functional teams to align integrations with business processes.
  • Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to internal integration patterns and standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 12 or more years of integration experience, with strong hands-on time in Oracle Integration Cloud.
  • Solid experience with Oracle Cloud Applications (ERP, HCM, or CX) data models and APIs.
  • Experience with REST and SOAP web service development.
  • Working knowledge of Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) and Process Cloud Service.
  • Familiarity with API management concepts and Oracle API Platform.
  • Strong scripting skills (Groovy, JavaScript) and SQL.
  • Experience with security standards (OAuth2, SAML, mTLS).
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Prior experience migrating from Oracle SOA Suite to OIC is a strong plus.

title: Combat Systems Technician (SPY Technician)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Provide Fleet Technical Assistance (FTA) to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve casualties involving AN/SPY-1 radar and associated combat systems

  • Perform on-site (OS) and distant support (DS) for U.S. Navy ships and shore-based OCONUS activities

  • Conduct maintenance, installation, testing, and repair of radar systems, including Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) and auxiliary equipment

  • Execute advanced fault isolation within radar subsystems, including Signal Processor (SIGPRO) components

  • Analyze radar performance and provide recommendations on clutter mitigation and environmental impacts

  • Support System/Equipment Assessments (e.g., TSRA, INSURV, ICMP, BMDRAs, Combat Systems Assessments)

  • Assist with logistics support, including validation of Allowance Parts Lists (APLs) and identification of required components

  • Provide on-the-job training (OJT) and technical guidance to ship's force personnel

  • Document findings using Navy systems (e.g., MFOM/NMD, FTS) and prepare formal reports/debriefs in accordance with JFMM standards

  • Recommend updates to technical documentation, including Maintenance Requirement Cards (MRCs), manuals, and procedures

  • Support Engineering Technical Branch (ETB) efforts, including system analysis and corrective action development

  • Travel as required to support forward-deployed naval forces

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of journeyman-level experience within the last five (5) years in radar/combat systems

  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance, installation, testing, and repair of U.S. Navy radar systems, including BMD-related equipment

  • Strong knowledge of electromagnetic energy, radar theory, quantum theory, and electronic phasing as applied to AN/SPY-1 systems

  • Ability to understand and apply mono-pulse radar principles, including interpretation of sum and delta signals for fault isolation

  • Experience troubleshooting radar signal processing (SIGPRO) components

  • Ability to work independently without supervision in a journeyman-level capacity

  • Familiarity with Navy maintenance and tracking systems such as MFOM/NMD and FTS

  • Ability to interpret and apply technical manuals, drawings, and engineering documentation

  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently, including OCONUS and shipboard environments

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

  • Strong communication skills, including experience preparing technical reports and briefs

BENEFITS

Solvere offers a comprehensive and generous benefits package. The Solvere benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance for the employee and/or families. Solvere also includes basic life insurance plus short- and long-term disability for the employee. Employees may elect to enroll in our company’s 401k plan. Employees will also accrue paid time off and holidays. Additional voluntary options include supplemental insurance plans.

Solvere Technical Group is committed to non-discrimination and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination based on disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer

SCHADS Level 3 | $80,020 - $85,797 per annum (pro rata) + Superannuation + Salary Packaging Benefits
Support Veterans. Strengthen Community. Make a Difference.
At Lives Lived Well, we believe in supporting people to live healthy, connected and fulfilling lives.
We're seeking a highly organised and community-minded Administration & Events Officer to join our Northern Adelaide Veterans' & Families' Hub.
This is more than an administration role. You'll be the welcoming face of the Hub, helping veterans and their families feel supported from the moment they walk through the door while also coordinating events, supporting community engagement initiatives and assisting with the day-to-day operations of the service.
Funded by the Department of Veterans' Affairs as part of the Australian Government's response to the Royal Commission into Defence and Veteran Suicide, the Hub provides a welcoming and supportive environment where veterans and their families can access services, strengthen wellbeing and build meaningful community connections.
Given the nature of the service, team members may engage with veterans and family members affected by trauma, mental health challenges, suicide, grief and other complex life experiences. Applicants should consider their own suitability for working within this environment.
About the Role
This is a permanent part-time position working 9:00am - 2:05pm Monday to Friday (22.8 hours per week).
While the role is primarily worked during these hours, some flexibility is required to support occasional community events and commemorative activities outside standard hours. This may include events such as ANZAC Day, Remembrance Day, veteran wellbeing activities and other community engagement initiatives.
You will work closely with the Centre Manager, clinicians, volunteers and community stakeholders to ensure the Hub provides a welcoming, professional and engaging experience for veterans and their families.
No two days will be the same. You will provide front-of-house support, coordinate community events and activities, assist with social media and communications, and help ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of the Hub.
Key Responsibilities

Provide high-quality administrative and reception support.
Welcome and assist veterans, families, volunteers and visitors attending the Hub.
Coordinate meetings, training sessions, community events and wellbeing activities.
Prepare correspondence, reports, meeting minutes and administrative documentation.
Maintain accurate records, databases and administrative systems.
Support quality improvement, compliance, audit and workplace health and safety activities.
Assist with social media content, event promotion and community communications.
Coordinate venue bookings, catering, suppliers and event logistics.
Support volunteer engagement and the delivery of Hub activities and events.
Assist with facility and vehicle management requirements.
Provide short-term supervision of children attending the Hub while parents or carers participate in counselling sessions, appointments or other Hub activities.

What We're Looking For
To be successful in this role, you will have:

Experience providing high-quality administrative support in a busy environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
Confidence managing competing priorities and multiple activities.
Experience coordinating events, meetings, community activities or stakeholder engagement.
Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
Experience using social media platforms such as Facebook and Instagram.
A professional, welcoming and customer-focused approach.
The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment.
A willingness and confidence to occasionally supervise children attending the Hub whilst parents or carers participate in counselling sessions, appointments or Hub activities.

Highly Regarded

Qualifications in Administration, Business or a related field.
Experience working in community services, health, mental health, veterans' services or the not-for-profit sector.
Experience supporting community engagement activities and events.
Experience working with veterans, Defence families or community-based wellbeing services.
Experience using Canva or similar content creation tools.
Photography skills or an interest in capturing community events and activities.

Essential Requirements

Current Australian Driver Licence.
Current Working with Children Check (or ability to obtain).
Current National Police Check (or ability to obtain).
Ability to undertake occasional travel as required.

Why Join Lives Lived Well?

Five additional days of paid wellbeing leave each year (pro rata).
Salary packaging benefits to increase your take-home pay.
Wellspring employee discounts across hundreds of retailers.
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family.
Ongoing learning, development and career progression opportunities.
The opportunity to support veterans and their families through a nationally significant community service.
A genuinely inclusive workplace committed to diversity, equity and inclusion.

Our Values
The people who thrive at Lives Lived Well are those who share our values:

We are humble, human and full of hope.
We show up and share.
We ask "Why not?" and "What's next?"
We leave a positive wake.
