title: Senior iOS Developer / Platform
description:
About AppNation

We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide.

Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries.

We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior iOS Developer to help us build and scale world-class mobile experiences.

You’ll work across our portfolio of AI-powered and consumer mobile apps, taking ownership from architecture decisions to production releases. You’ll solve challenging engineering problems, improve app performance, and help shape the technical standards of our mobile team.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain scalable, high-quality iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Take ownership of the native iOS layer in our Flutter apps, including architecture, integrations and platform-specific capabilities.
  • Build and ship Apple-native features in our apps, such as WidgetKit widgets, Live Activities and Dynamic Island, App Intents and Siri Shortcuts, push and notification extensions, Share extensions, Sign in with Apple and StoreKit 2.
  • Bring AI capabilities to the native side where they make sense, using technologies such as Core ML, on-device models, Apple Intelligence APIs, Speech and Vision frameworks.
  • Design and evolve maintainable iOS architectures, reusable components and clear boundaries between native and Flutter layers.
  • Profile and optimize app performance, startup time, memory usage and responsiveness using Instruments and production monitoring tools.
  • Ensure our apps look and work correctly across supported iPhone and iPad screen sizes, OS versions and form factors, including native components such as widgets and extensions.
  • Improve engineering practices around testing, code review, CI/CD, release processes and mobile observability.
  • Act as the team's iOS mentor by reviewing native code, writing internal guidelines, running knowledge-sharing sessions and helping our Flutter developers become confident on iOS.

What We’re Looking For

  • At least 5 years of professional iOS development experience, including apps you have shipped and maintained in production on the App Store.
  • Strong interest in the Apple ecosystem and modern iOS engineering practices.
  • Strong proficiency in Swift and hands-on production experience with SwiftUI.
  • Strong knowledge of iOS application architecture, application lifecycle, modular design and platform APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of the Apple platform beyond the main app, including app extensions, WidgetKit, background modes, push notifications, StoreKit and the app lifecycle.
  • A solid understanding of Swift Concurrency, including async/await, actors, structured concurrency and thread safety; experience with Combine is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of ARC, memory management, retain cycles and performance profiling.
  • Comfortable using Instruments and production diagnostics to identify and resolve performance and memory issues.
  • Hands-on experience with Xcode project configuration, code signing, provisioning, CI/CD and the full App Store release process.
  • Experience investigating production issues using crash reports, logs, metrics and profiling tools.
  • Experience connecting native iOS code with a cross-platform framework, or a strong willingness to learn Flutter.
  • Familiarity with Android and Kotlin is a plus.
  • Experience working with Objective-C or legacy iOS codebases is a plus.
  • Experience with visionOS, watchOS or tvOS is a plus.
  • Working proficiency in English.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why AppNation?

  • Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally.
  • Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment.
  • Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build.
  • Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions.
  • Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options.

Our Hiring Process

Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews

At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: APAC Logistics Planner
description:
Summary

The Pacific Logistics team sits at the centre of Apple's Operations function, translating business demand into executable logistics capacity across freight, distribution, and fulfilment channels. We work closely with both internal stakeholders and a network of logistics partners across the region to ensure supply moves efficiently from origin to end consumer. We are looking for a results-driven individual to join our planning and analytics team. This role applies structured analytical thinking to capacity planning — bridging upstream demand signals with logistics execution across Inbound/Outbound Transportation and Distribution Centre (DC) Operations. The right candidate is comfortable working with ambiguity, translating data into decisions, and holding themselves accountable to outcomes.

This is a central planning role requiring close collaboration with Supply/Demand Management, Operations Finance, Retail Fulfilment Operations, and Reseller Operations on all logistics capacity matters. The objective is to proactively align with functional teams — balancing cost, infrastructure, supply, and supplier relationships — and to scale logistics capacity appropriately to support sell-through targets.

Description

In this role, your responsibilities include:

  • Represent Logistics on all capacity-related matters across Inbound & Outbound Freight, Distribution Centres, and all route-to-market channels
  • Develop and sustain a forecast and capacity review cadence with cross-functional teams (Supply/Demand Management, Retail Fulfilment Operations, Procurement) and internal Logistics teams (Freight, DC Operations), covering steady-state operations, quarter-end shipments, new product launches, and promotional events
  • Communicate and influence scale decisions with key stakeholders, incorporating demand/supply assumptions, supportability constraints, and cost considerations to maximise consumer sales while managing spend
  • Lead logistics capacity planning activities ahead of and during peak events, ensuring shipment and delivery lead times are met; surface risks to stakeholders and provide clear execution direction to internal Logistics teams
  • Own Mid-Term and Long-Term Volume Planning with regional and worldwide stakeholders, including forecast review, capacity requirements modelling, and scale action planning to support business growth
  • Provide returns volume forecasts to plan DC and freight resources during peak periods, ensuring timely goods receipt in line with Service Level Agreements
  • Support planning and monitoring reporting requirements, including troubleshooting planning tool issues and building supplementary dashboards where needed.
  • Drive continuous process improvement in capacity planning workflows and management systems to improve efficiency and operational effectiveness

Minimum Qualifications

  • Strong data analytics and numeracy skills with high attention to detail
  • Organised and able to adapt quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrates strong problem-solving capability with comfort navigating ambiguity and complexity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, influencing, and negotiation skills
  • Proven ability to build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams
  • Strong experience with data analysis tools (Tableau, Python, SQL, Excel); ability to read or write code is an advantage
  • Demonstrated ability to adopt new technologies and champion their use within the team

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor/ Masters degree preferred. Candidates with 5 years of relevant experience in supply chain/ logistics are welcome
  • Experience in leveraging GenAI and/or low-code LLM platforms (Claude, Gemini, etc.) to automate processes, build analytical models, and drive efficiency across individual and team workflows

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. Apple provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities and in accordance with local requirements. Apple is a drug-free workplace.

title: Vaihtoautomyyjä Saloon
description:
Haluatko seuraavaksi huippumyyjäksi?
Etsimme Salon toimipisteeseemme energistä, rohkeaa ja tuloshaluista VAIHTOAUTOMYYJÄÄ!


Aiempi kokemus autoalalta ei ole meille kynnyskysymys – tärkeintä on persoona ja asenne. Etsimme aktiivista ja oma-aloitteista tekijää, joka syttyy ihmisten kohtaamisesta. Nykypäivän autokauppaa tehdään vahvasti myös verkossa, joten haemme tyyppiä, joka uskaltaa laittaa itsensä likoon, heittäytyä videolle ja hyödyntää sosiaalisen median kanavia myynnin sekä oman asiantuntijabrändinsä rakentamiseen.
Me opetamme sinulle autokaupan ammattitaidon ja niksit. Sinä tuot mukanasi nälän menestyä, draivin ja halun kehittyä alasi parhaaksi!

Oletko etsimämme tyyppi?
* Energinen ja tavoitteellinen: Sytyt onnistumisista ja haluat ylittää omat rimat.
* Sosiaalinen meisseli: Viihdyt ihmisten parissa ja löydät yhteisen kielen kaikkien kanssa.
* Oma-aloitteinen: Tartut toimeen itsenäisesti ja myös puhelin pysyy kädessäsi.
* Somerohkea: Uskallat näkyä ja hyödyntää sosiaalista mediaa myynnin tukena.
* Tuleva huippumyyjä: Haluat rakentaa itsellesi menestyksekkään uran myynnin parissa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
* Kattavan ja perusteellisen perehdytyksen tehtävään
* Vahvan, kannustavan ja rennon tiimin tuen
* Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, jossa voit vaikuttaa omiin ansioihisi
* Mahdollisuuden kehittyä autoalan huippuammattilaiseksi

Kiinnostuitko? Laita verkot vesille ja hae heti!
Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi viipymättä, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä!

title: SAP Basis Administrator
description:
SAP Basis Administrator - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Basis Administrator
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$170,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a seasoned SAP Basis Administrator responsible for the architecture, installation, configuration, performance tuning, and day-to-day operation of complex SAP landscapes that may span on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-hosted environments. This role is critical to keeping mission-critical SAP systems available, performant, secure, and compliant. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, HANA database administration, system copies, upgrades, and migrations, and will partner with infrastructure, security, and SAP functional teams to deliver a stable, well-governed SAP platform.
Key Responsibilities
  • Architect, install, configure, and operate SAP landscapes including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Solution Manager, and other NetWeaver-based systems across on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Administer SAP HANA databases — including installation, sizing, replication, backup, recovery, and performance tuning — to meet demanding availability and performance SLAs.
  • Plan and execute SAP system copies, refreshes, and post-copy automation activities to support development, testing, training, and migration scenarios.
  • Lead SAP upgrades, EHP installations, Support Package application, kernel upgrades, and S/4HANA conversions with minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Design and implement SAP migrations to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SAP RISE/Grow environments, including network and identity integration.
  • Configure and operate high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions for SAP, including HANA System Replication, cluster-based failover, and validated DR runbooks.
  • Implement and maintain SAP transport management strategies, including Solution Manager ChaRM and CTS+ workflows.
  • Manage SAP user provisioning, role management, and audit support in close collaboration with the SAP Security/GRC team.
  • Monitor SAP system performance, capacity, and health using Solution Manager, Focused Run, native HANA tools, and external APM platforms.
  • Develop automation scripts and runbooks using Ansible, PowerShell, or Python to reduce operational toil and accelerate routine tasks.
  • Manage and remediate SAP security notes, kernel patches, and database patches in accordance with internal security and compliance policies.
  • Provide 24x7 on-call support for production SAP systems and lead structured incident response and post-incident reviews.
  • Document SAP architecture, operations procedures, and standard operating processes to support knowledge sharing and team scalability.
  • Mentor junior Basis engineers and contribute to the broader SAP platform roadmap.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of SAP Basis / platform engineering experience in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering SAP HANA databases in production.
  • Experience operating S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Solution Manager, and other NetWeaver systems.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP migrations to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong experience with SAP upgrades, EHP/SP application, and system conversions.
  • Solid experience with SAP HA/DR strategies, including HANA System Replication and clustering.
  • Working knowledge of SAP transport management and Solution Manager ChaRM.
  • Scripting skills in Bash, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

We are looking for an R&D Engineer to join the Computer Vision team within our Applied Data Science department. In this role, you will develop computer vision and document intelligence solutions that automate banking processes, strengthen fraud prevention, and improve operational efficiency.

You will work on problems such as OCR/ICR on banking documents, signature recognition and verification, object detection and segmentation, and multimodal document understanding with Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

As part of the Applied Data Science team, you will work closely with fast-paced and highly skilled R&D engineers, taking CV models from research and prototyping to production, and scaling and maintaining them in core banking systems.

Qualifications:

  • M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree (completed, ongoing, or planned) in a Machine Learning / Deep Learning / Computer Vision related field from Computer, Industrial, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering,
  • Demonstrated expertise in coding and problem-solving using Python,
  • Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks and model ecosystems, especially PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers,
  • Strong understanding of deep learning architectures for computer vision, including CNNs (e.g., ResNet) and Vision Transformers (ViT),
  • Experience with object detection and segmentation models (e.g., YOLO family, Mask R-CNN, U-Net, or similar),
  • Experience with OCR and ICR techniques and tools such as PaddleOCR, EasyOCR, or similar, including text detection and recognition on printed and handwritten documents,
  • Experience with document layout analysis, table/form extraction, reading-order detection, and structured information extraction from scanned or digital documents.
  • Proficiency in image processing with OpenCV (preprocessing, augmentation, geometric transformations, image enhancement),
  • Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and multimodal approaches for document understanding and visual question answering,
  • Interest or experience in signature recognition and verification, including handling limited and imbalanced data,
  • Practical experience applying CV models to real-world datasets, with a demonstrated ability to analyze results, fine-tune models, and troubleshoot issues,
  • Strong understanding of ML training, testing, validation, data labeling, and ML project pipelines,
  • Experience with GPU-based training and distributed training setups,
  • Experience with version control systems (Git, Git LFS),
  • Experience with containerization using Docker,
  • Experience with SQL databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server),
  • Familiarity with Linux environments and command-line tools,
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and project updates effectively to stakeholders,
  • Eager to follow technical literature and willing to contribute actively by publishing academic papers in international conferences.

Job Description:

  • Design, develop, and train computer vision models for document intelligence, OCR/ICR, signature recognition, object detection, and segmentation use cases,
  • Fine-tune and adapt pretrained models (CNNs, ResNet, ViT, YOLO, VLMs) to banking-specific data,
  • Plan and manage data labeling processes, including defining annotation guidelines, preparing labeled datasets, and ensuring label quality and consistency,
  • Build image preprocessing and data augmentation pipelines using OpenCV and PyTorch,
  • Evaluate and benchmark OCR/ICR engines (PaddleOCR, EasyOCR, etc.) and VLM-based approaches for extracting information from banking documents,
  • Take part in every phase of the project: data analysis, technical design, prototyping, model development, integration into core banking systems, and end-to-end testing,
  • Optimize models for production performance, including latency, throughput, and resource usage,
  • Monitor deployed models and continuously improve them based on performance metrics and business feedback,
  • Follow state-of-the-art research in computer vision and multimodal AI and turn it into applicable solutions.

Would be Advantageous:

  • Prior experience in banking, financial services, fraud detection, or document processing projects,
  • Experience with model optimization and deployment tools (ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, or similar),
  • Experience with data annotation tools (CVAT, Label Studio, or similar),
  • Experience with container orchestration tools (Kubernetes).

Candidate Selection Process:

Our recruitment process for all positions typically encompasses technical interviews, director assessments, competency evaluations, and personality tests. We will extend our offer to candidates who have successfully completed a positive evaluation process.

title: Senior SDET – (India)
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a Senior SDET to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.

The ideal candidate has strong distributed-systems and API-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.

This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre-approved benign scenarios.


Project Details

Title: Senior SDET
Rate: $13.5/hr
Start Date: 19th October
Duration: 5 Weeks
Commitment: 33 Hours per Week
Location: India (Remote)
Job Type: Freelance

Responsibilities

  • Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record-linking

  • Execute pre-approved request variations and boundary-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.

  • Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly

  • Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data-handling requirements.

  • Validate behavior of near-real-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected

  • Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing

  • Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.

  • Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.

  • Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff

  • Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post-incident reviews

  • Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed-system defects

  • Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure-mode and chaos-style testing

  • Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements

  • Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience of 5-8+ years in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter-service API behavior

  • Hands-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques

  • Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes

  • Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores

  • Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices

  • Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries

  • Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills for root-causing complex, systemic defects

  • Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.

  • Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.

  • Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence-based reporting requirements is a plus

title: Tuotantotyöntekijä, Dagsmark, Loimaa, Loimaa

title: Kaivinkoneen kuljettaja
description:
Perustukset ovat kunnossa – nyt etsimme sinua kaivinkoneen ohjaimiin

Hyppää mukaan perheyritykseen, jossa hommat tehdään yhdessä ja porukasta pidetään huolta! Meille etsitään nyt kaivinkoneenkuljettajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työmaamme sijaitsevat eri puolilla Suomea, joten matkustusvalmius vaaditaan. Koneissamme on käytössä Novatron 3D-koneohjausjärjestelmä ja olemme erikoistuneet teollisuusrakentamisen kohteisiin.

Hakijalta odotamme:

  • Sinulla on alan koulutus tai muulla tavoin hankittu kokemus kaivinkoneenkuljettajan tehtävistä.

  • Pidät koneesta huolta ja pidät sen siistinä. Pienten huoltojen osaaminen on plussaa.

  • Sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, sillä sujuva yhteistyö eri toimijoiden kanssa on meille tärkeää.

  • 3D-koneohjausjärjestelmän osaamista.

Eduksi katsotaan kokemus

  • tehdasalueilla tehtävistä konetöistä

  • maanalaisten putkistojen rakentamisesta

  • tela- ja pyöräalustaisilla kaivinkoneilla työskentelystä.

Palkkauksessa noudatetaan Infra-alan työehtosopimusta. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian, ja tarkempi ajankohta sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa.

Tehtävässä menestymisen avaimet ovat:

  • Aiempi kokemus kaivinkonetöistä

  • Kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti

  • 3D-koneohjausjärjestelmien osaaminen

  • Työturvallisuuskortti

  • Valmius matkustaa ja työskennellä työmaiden sijainnin mukaan

  • Mahdollisuus tarvittaessa vuorotyöhön, esimerkiksi 7/7 vuorokierto

  • Halu oppia uutta sekä aikaansaava ja yhdessä tekemiseen nojaava asenne

  • Sujuvat organisointi- ja tiimityötaidot sekä kyky kantaa vastuuta

Enemmän kuin vain pelkkä työpaikka

Työntekijöiden viihtyvyys ja yhteisöllisyys on meille ykkösasia. Meillä ei pelätä pitää kaverista huolta ja tiimityö on meille arkea. Kun yksi tarvitsee tukea, muut ovat valmiina auttamaan kohti yhteistä päämäärää. Etsimme JPH:lla aktiivisesti uusia tapoja kehittää toimintaamme ja palveluitamme. Arvostamme tekijöitä, joilla on ideoita ja uskallat rohkeasti tuoda ne myös esille. Meillä jokainen voi vaikuttaa siihen, miten töitä tehdään. Palkkauksemme on ammattitaitoasi arvostava, jonka lisäksi tuemme työntekijöidemme arkea kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedulla, hyvinvointia hierontaedulla sekä kattavalla sairausturvalla ja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella.

Hae tehtävään jättämällä meille hakemuksesi ja CV:si viimeistään 12.10.2026.

title: Senior QA Analyst (Frontend) – (India)
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a Senior QA Analyst to own quality assurance across the frontend-to-middleware boundary of a multi-step web onboarding workflow.

This role goes beyond scripted execution — it requires the analytical depth to design exploratory test strategies, apply structured testing techniques like equivalence partitioning, and validate that the workflow's step-by-step progression and submission states behave correctly under a wide range of input conditions.

The candidate will review the evidence produced by the Manual QA Tester and convert observed frontend behaviour into a validated state model/FSM, including decision forks, equivalence classes, persona-specific behaviour, and boundary conditions.

The ideal candidate is comfortable triaging complex defects and driving them to resolution.

Project Details

Title: Senior QA Analyst (Frontend) - (India)

Rate: $6/hr

Start Date: 19th October

Duration: 4 Weeks

Commitment: 40 Hours per week

Location: India (Remote)

Job Type: Freelance (with the possibility of full time employment based on performance and project needs in all opportunity)

Responsibilities

  1. Design and execute advanced exploratory testing to uncover issues not captured by scripted test cases, particularly around how form-level validation carries through to submission behaviour

  1. Apply boundary testing techniques to identify edge-case failures across frontend input handling and the middleware calls that consume that data

  1. Use equivalence partitioning to design efficient, high-coverage test cases across valid, invalid, and edge-case input classes for form and workflow fields

  1. Validate application behavior against defined state models (e.g., step progression, enabled/disabled action states, submission and confirmation states) to confirm correct transitions under both expected and unexpected input

  1. Lead defect triage sessions, prioritizing issues by severity, impact, and reproducibility

  1. Partner with developers to clarify root causes and confirm fixes against original defect conditions

  1. Mentor junior QA testers on exploratory techniques and structured test design

  1. Contribute to test strategy documentation and coverage planning for frontend/middleware features

  1. Formalize and maintain the onboarding FSM/state-transition model based on observed application behavior.

  1. Identify and document decision forks, state dependencies, persona-specific variations, and boundary conditions.

  1. Validate coverage across the representative onboarding personas and identify gaps requiring additional controlled testing.

  1. Produce a validated frontend/state-model evidence package for handoff to the Middleware SDET workstream.

  1. Maintain traceability between observed UI behavior, FSM states, decision forks, and supporting evidence.

Required Qualifications

  1. Solid 3-5+ years of experience as a QA Analyst with exposure to both frontend and middleware testing

  1. Demonstrated expertise in exploratory and boundary testing methodologies

  1. Practical experience applying equivalence partitioning and other formal test design techniques

  1. Familiarity with state-machine / workflow-state concepts and validating multi-step systems against expected state transitions

  1. Strong defect triage experience, including severity/priority classification and cross-team coordination

  1. Analytical mindset with the ability to identify non-obvious edge cases

  1. Effective communicator capable of guiding triage discussions and mentoring peers

  1. Experience testing complex multi-step workflows, onboarding systems, registration flows, or account-creation processes is strongly preferred.

  1. Ability to translate observed application behavior into structured state-transition models or equivalent workflow representations.

  1. Working familiarity with browser and network developer tools is preferred; deep protocol-level expertise is not required.

description:
Varastotyöntekijöitä Uudenmaan alueelle!

Etsimme asiakasyrityksillemme varastotyöntekijöitä monipuolisiin logistiikka-alan tehtäviin Uudenmaan alueelle. Työt sijaitsevat Helsingin, Espoon, Vantaan, Tuusulan, Keravan, Järvenpään ja Vihdin alueella. Työ on keikkaluontoista ja keikkojen kestot vaihtelevat asiakkaidemme tarpeiden mukaan parista päivästä useisiin kuukausiin.

Tehtävänkuva:

Työ koostuu mm. tavaran vastaanotosta, tilausten keräilystä, tuotteiden pakkaamisesta sekä tavaroiden lähettämisestä jakeluun. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös trukin kanssa työskenteleminen ja varaston siisteyden ylläpitäminen.

Työn edellytykset:

Vaadimme sinulta jonkin verran kokemusta varastoympäristössä työskentelemisestä mutta sinun ei tarvitse olla kokenut konkari. Tärkeintä on, että sinulla löytyy aitoa kiinnostusta logistiikka-alaa kohtaan ja olet halukas oppimaan uutta. Vaadimme sinulta kuitenkin seuraavat asiat:

* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
* Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan isoksi eduksi, koska asiakkaidemme varastot eivät aina sijaitse julkisten kulkuvälineiden lähettyvillä. Trukkikortti ja hygieniapassi ovat myös iso plussa.

Hakuprosessi:

Jos ilmoitus heräsi kiinnostuksesi, laita rohkeasti hakemuksesi tulemaan jo tänään! Reagoimme asiakkaidemme työvoimatarpeisiin ja työt voi alkaa nopeallakin aikataulla.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:

Henkilöstökonsultti André Bärlund
andre.barlund@wirestaff.fi

WIRESTAFF on kokenut henkilöstöalan toimija. Osaamisemme pohjautuu yhteensä kymmenien vuosien kokemukseen henkilöstövuokrauksesta ja rekrytoinneista useilta eri toimialoilta. Meille ihmiset ovat enemmän, kuin ansioluettelonsa ja työpaikka enemmän, kuin tehtäväkuvaus. Arvostamme osaamista ja pyrimme löytämään tekijöille heille sopivat työpaikat, joissa he voivat tehdä työnsä #hyvässäwireessä.

title: Erfaren direktionssekretær til koncernledelsen
description:
Motiveres du af at understøtte topledelsen i en central rolle, hvor relationer, prioritering og situationsfornemmelse er afgørende? Har du erfaringen til selvstændigt at skabe overblik, beskytte direktørernes tid og koordinere effektivt på tværs af organisationen?

Om stillingen
I Alm. Brand Group søger vi en erfaren direktionssekretær til Direktions- og Bestyrelsessekretariatet.

Du bliver en del af et mindre team bestående af en anden direktionssekretær og sekretariatets øvrige medarbejdere, som sammen understøtter koncernledelsen og bestyrelsen. I rollen vil du primært understøtte 3-5 koncerndirektører og få en central funktion i at sikre, at deres tid og opmærksomhed anvendes dér, hvor den skaber størst værdi.

Rollen handler om mere end kalenderstyring og mødekoordination. Du bliver en betroet samarbejdspartner, som hjælper med at prioritere, skabe overblik og sikre, at de rette emner får opmærksomhed på det rette tidspunkt. Det kræver, at du hurtigt forstår konteksten omkring møder, beslutninger og interessenter og kan omsætte denne forståelse til handling.

Du bliver samtidig et vigtigt bindeled på tværs af organisationen og skal trives med at samarbejde med mange forskellige interessenter på alle niveauer.


Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Prioritering, planlægning og koordinering af koncerndirektørernes møder, kalender og aktiviteter

  • Forberedelse og koordinering af møder, herunder materiale, agendaer og opfølgning

  • Koordinering på tværs af organisationen og håndtering af mange interne og eksterne interessenter

  • Praktisk og teknisk understøttelse af møder, arrangementer og ledelsesaktiviteter

  • Håndtering af fortroligt materiale og administrative opgaver med høj kvalitet og præcision

”Det mest spændende ved rollen er, at ingen dage er ens. Jeg får mulighed for at beskytte topledelsens tid og fokus, skabe overblik i en kompleks hverdag og samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker på tværs af organisationen. Samtidig kommer jeg helt tæt på beslutningerne og får et unikt indblik i forretningen.”


Om dig
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Trives i en alsidig og dynamisk hverdag, hvor prioriteringer kan ændre sig hurtigt.

  • Har erfaring fra en rolle tæt på topledelsen og evner selvstændigt at vurdere, prioritere og handle uden behov for detaljeret retning.

  • Forstår hurtigt kontekst, interessenter og forretningsmæssige prioriteter og omsætter denne forståelse til handling.

  • Kan skabe struktur og overblik samt sikre effektiv koordinering på tværs af mange interessenter.

  • Er diskret og håndterer fortroligt materiale med høj professionalisme.

  • Har en god digital forståelse og er en person, der får tingene til at fungere. Du er fx tryg ved at klargøre digitalt udstyr til møder, løse mindre tekniske udfordringer og finde en vej videre, når noget ikke virker som forventet.

Som person er du imødekommende, tillidsvækkende og stærk til at opbygge relationer på tværs af organisationen. Du trives med mange kontaktflader, fortrolige opgaver og skiftende prioriteringer. Samtidig motiveres du af rollen som direktionssekretær og finder energi i at skabe de bedste rammer for ledelsen og få hverdagen omkring koncernledelsen til at fungere.

Vi tilbyder
En central rolle tæt på koncernledelsen i en virksomhed med høje ambitioner og vægt på ordentlighed. Du får stor indsigt i koncernens ledelse og beslutningsprocesser og bliver en betroet samarbejdspartner for flere af koncernens direktører.

Din hverdag bliver på vores hovedkontor på Midtermolen i København – med udsigt til vandet og i gåafstand fra Østerport station. Vi tilbyder en attraktiv arbejdsplads med løn efter kvalifikationer, en stærk pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring. Derudover har vi omsorgsdage, der hjælper dig med at skabe balance mellem arbejde og privatliv, og vi tilbyder sociale aktiviteter samt adgang til sports- og medarbejderforeninger.


Ansøgning
Er du vores nye kollega? Så send os et motiveret CV hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Senior Executive Advisor, Birgitte Arendal, på 51 27 92 01.

Tiltrædelse snarest muligt og senest den 1. januar 2027.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!


Til dig, der søger hos os
Du er velkommen til at bruge AI, når du søger hos os. Det vigtigste for os er, at vi stadig kan mærke dig – dine refleksioner og din motivation.

I vores rekrutteringsproces er der mennesker hele vejen. Vi bruger ikke AI til at screene eller vurdere ansøgninger.

Alle ansøgninger behandles naturligvis fortroligt. Vi opfordrer alle – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, handicap eller oprindelse – til at søge stillingen.

Alm. Brand Group er en af Danmarks største forsikringsselskaber, og omfatter både Alm. Brand, Codan, Privatsikring og Erhvervssikring. Vi er over 2000 medarbejdere, der arbejder for at sikre og forsikre vores flere end 800.000 kunder. Vores fundament er fokus på kunden, høj arbejdsglæde og vores værdisæt: Vi er ambitiøse, Vi er ordentlige, Vi udviser tillid. Læs mere om Alm. Brand Group på . Følg os på LinkedIn: Alm. Brand Group.

title: Business Application Analyst (Banking Sector)
description:
This Senior Business Application Analyst position sits within the Market Risk systems program, covering VaR, IRC calculations, daily PnL production and attribution, risk consolidation and regulatory reporting, as well as Prudent Valuation calculations and adjustments ensuring the firm's trading book exposures are measured conservatively and in full compliance with applicable capital and valuation standards.

The core technology stack includes Apache Spark on HDFS, with primary development in Java. This role is well-suited to someone with a strong interest in data processing and data engineering. If you are looking to deepen your expertise in Big Data technologies and the complex technical ecosystems that surround them, this position offers an excellent career opportunity.

Main Responsibilities

Functional Knowledge & Analysis

  • Own and maintain deep functional knowledge of Market Risk applications
  • Liaise with Front Office, Risk Managers, Quantitative Analysts, and IT stakeholders to gather, clarify, and document business requirements
  • Analyze the functional impact of changes in coordination with the technical lead, considering system and architectural constraints
  • Prepare, present, and document functional specifications and user stories in JIRA, aligned with business needs and regulatory requirements
  • Support the development team on functional matters and maintain up-to-date functional documentation
  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of risk consolidation workflows, regulatory reporting processes, and market data management within a Banking environment

Functional Testing

  • Define and own the test strategy in coordination with the Application Manager
  • ·Conduct continuous testing in development environments; write functional unit and system test cases and maintain test artefacts throughout the project lifecycle
  • Coordinate UAT prioritization with the Project Manager and support production deployments through post-deployment validation checks

Application Support – Functional Incidents

  • Provide Level 2 functional support for incidents escalated from Level 1
  • Reproduce, analyze, and investigate functional issues related to risk calculations and market data
  • Resolve functional problems in coordination with developers and perform ad hoc simulations and impact analyses for Front Office users

Qualifications andProfile

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Systems Analysis, or related discipline
  • 10+ years of experience as a Senior Business Analyst within the Market Risk department of a Banking industry with hands-on expertise across VaR, IRC, PnL calculations, risk consolidation, regulatory reporting, and Prudent Valuation
  • Strong technical grounding in data models and SQL, with the ability to perform ad hoc data analysis and impact simulations for Front Office users
  • Proven experience acting as the functional liaison between Front Office, Risk Managers, Quantitative Analysts, and IT stakeholders — bridging onshore business lines and offshore technical teams as the primary functional point of contact
  • Extensive experience in requirements gathering, drafting detailed functional specifications and user stories in JIRA, and presenting functional changes to development teams in line with FRTB, Basel III/IV, and CRR/EBA regulatory frameworks
  • Thorough experience in functional testing and validation, including writing unit test cases, maintaining test artefacts, coordinating UAT, and performing post-deployment production checks to ensure the integrity of risk outputs
  • Demonstrated experience in Level 2 application support, including issue reproduction, root cause analysis, and resolution of calculation and data discrepancies in collaboration with developers
  • Practical experience leveraging AI-powered tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, generative AI assistants) to enhance productivity and problem-solving
  • Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals, including prompt engineering, model limitations, and best practices for human-AI collaboration
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs for accuracy, security, and alignment with business requirements
  • Ability to identify and implement opportunities for AI integration and workflow automation

Technical

  • Apache Spark, HDFS, Java — Core platform technologies
  • SQL — data analysis, ad hoc queries, and impact simulations
  • XML, UML — data exchange and system modelling
  • JIRA — user story and functional specification management
  • Familiarity with Big Data ecosystems and distributed computing concepts

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Mexico.

Pay: $100–$150/hr

Role Title: Senior Software Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)

Location: Remote

the company is selecting expert Senior Software Engineers to support a customer’s innovative project. In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

As an expert you will be creating Reinforcement Learning Environments which test and AI model's ability to solve complex software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code and optimizing performance. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and golden reference solution for the problem.

Scope of Work

  • Contribute expert-level code samples, debugging strategies, and development insights in Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects and performance bottlenecks in diverse codebases.
  • Implement robust new features, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and adherence to software best practices.
  • Refactor and optimize legacy code to improve clarity, efficiency, and long-term reliability.
  • Document technical reasoning, solution approaches, and code decisions to enhance AI training data quality.
  • Review and validate peer-contributed code and technical submissions for accuracy and clarity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  • Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
  • Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.
  • Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery within cross-functional projects.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: Lähihoitaja Rinnekodit Säteeseen
description:
Rinnekodit on työntekijöidensä kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia tukeva työpaikka. Rakennamme yhdessä arvostavaa ja yhdenvertaista työkulttuuria, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä.

Haemme nyt määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen perhevapaan sijaisuuteen ohjaajaa ajalle 12.10.2026-31.8.2027:

Tervetuloa Rinnekodit Säteeseen!

Rinnekodit Säteen asumisyksikkö on koti aikuisille kehitysvammaisille asiakkaillemme, joita henkilökuntamme ohjaa ja auttaa elämään omannäköistään elämää. Säteen 18 asuntoa jakautuvat kolmeen ryhmäkotiin. Yksikkömme sijaitsee Espoon Viherlaaksossa lähellä palveluita ja hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella. Voit hurauttaa meille kätevästi bussilla tai halutessasi vaikka omalla työsuhdepyörälläsi!

Tuemme asiakkaidemme toimijuutta ja osallisuutta heidän omassa arjessaan. Asiakkaidemme toimintakyky vaihtelee ja jokainen heistä on omanlaisensa persoona. Tällaisena haluamme asiakkaamme myös kohdata; meillä jokainen on juuri oikeanlainen omana itsenään.

Tehtävä ja sen tavoitteet

Lähihoitajana olet avainroolissa asiakkaiden yksilöllisten tarpeiden tunnistamisessa ja laadukkaan hoidon varmistamisessa. Työskentelet ammattitaitoisella otteella asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta kunnioittaen ja hänet arvostavasti kohdaten.

Työsi sisältää muun muassa perushoitoa, lääkehoitoa ja kuntouttavaa ohjausta. Tuet asiakkaita myös fyysisesti päivittäisissä toimissa. Tarjoamme hyvän perehdytyksen ja erilaisia koulutuksia sujuvan työskentelyn varmistamiseksi.

Odotamme sinulta:

- lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja Lupa- ja valvontaviraston Suosikki-rekisteröintiä TAI loppuvaiheen opintoja
- sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattikorttia (Kanta-varmennekortti) TAI valmiutta hankkia kortti koeajan aikana
- valmiutta osoittaa lääkehoidon osaaminen suorittamalla lääkehoitolupa neljän kuukauden sisällä työsuhteen aloittamisesta ja säännöllisesti työsuhteen aikana
- valmiutta kolmivuorotyöhön, vaikka tällä hetkellä työvuorot painottuvat iltavuoroihin
- suomen kielen perusosaamista, jota tarvitset kirjaamisessa ja asiakkaiden kohtaamisessa
- tartuntatautilain 48 § mukaista rokotesuojaa

Rinnekodit on savuton ja päihteetön työpaikka.

Tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen tehtävään valitulta lainsäädännön (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta) tarkoittamalla tavalla ennen työsuhteen solmimista. Rikosrekisteriote ei saa olla kuutta kuukautta vanhempi.

Työyhteisö ja kulttuuri

Työyhteisöömme kuuluu lähihoitajia, sairaanhoitajia, erityisohjaajia, kodinhuoltaja sekä esihenkilönäsi toimiva palveluyksikön johtaja. Esihenkilösi on sitoutunut tukemaan sinun ja koko työyhteisön kehittymistä valmentavalla otteella - kannustaen, palautetta antaen ja huolen hetkellä kuunnellen. title: Security Consultant (Offensive Security)
description:
ITSEC Asia is looking for a Cybersecurity Consultant (Offensive Security) to join our growing team.

We are primarily looking for candidates with around 3 years of hands-on penetration-testing

experience, although we also welcome applications from strong junior pentesters and early-career

professionals who can demonstrate solid technical foundations, curiosity and a genuine passion for

ethical hacking.

This role provides exposure to a wide range of security assessments across enterprise, cloud,

government and critical environments. We are particularly interested in people who are keen to

embrace AI, automation and emerging technologies to improve the efficiency, depth and quality of

penetration testing.

About ITSEC Group

ITSEC Group is a cybersecurity organisation operating across the Asia-Pacific region and beyond,

with offices in Singapore, Indonesia, Australia, the UAE and Mauritius.

We provide cybersecurity consulting and security services to clients across government, critical

infrastructure, financial services, telecommunications, healthcare, technology and other industries.

Joining ITSEC provides the opportunity to work across diverse technology environments, complex

security challenges and a broad range of consulting engagements, while developing both your

technical and client-facing capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across web applications, APIs, mobile

applications, networks, cloud environments and other technology platforms.

• Support security assessments involving IT, Operational Technology (OT), Internet of Things (IoT)

and other specialised environments.

• Identify, validate and demonstrate security vulnerabilities using appropriate testing methodologies

and techniques.

• Assess the technical and business impact of identified vulnerabilities and attack paths.

• Document testing activities, technical evidence, proof-of-concept results and assessment

conclusions in a clear and defensible manner.

• Prepare professional penetration-testing reports covering findings, risk implications, supporting

evidence and practical remediation recommendations.

• Present technical findings to clients and explain security risks and remediation approaches to both

technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Conduct remediation verification and retesting to confirm that identified vulnerabilities have been

effectively addressed.

• Explore and responsibly apply AI-assisted security testing, automation, scripting and emerging

technologies to improve research, reconnaissance, analysis, testing and reporting workflows.

• Continuously develop knowledge of emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, security tools,

technologies and industry methodologies.

• Contribute to the development of the team's testing methodologies, knowledge base, tooling and

technical capabilities.

What We Are Looking For

• Diploma or degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering or a

related discipline.

• Ideally around 3 years of relevant hands-on penetration-testing or offensive-security experience.

• Strong junior candidates with less experience are also encouraged to apply if they can demonstrate

good practical offensive-security skills and a strong willingness to learn.

• CREST Registered Tester (CRT), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) or a comparable

recognised offensive-security certification is strongly preferred.

• Good practical understanding of penetration-testing methodologies, tools and techniques.

• Hands-on experience in areas such as web application, API, network, Active Directory, mobile or

cloud penetration testing will be advantageous.

• Experience or knowledge in OT, ICS, IoT or critical-infrastructure security testing is highly

advantageous.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to produce clear, accurate and professional technical reports.

• Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical security issues clearly to clients.

• Interest in AI, automation, scripting and emerging offensive-security technologies, together with the

ability to learn and adapt quickly.

• Willingness to take ownership, work collaboratively and continue developing professionally within a

cybersecurity consulting environment.

Singapore Government / Classified Project Experience

Singapore citizens are preferred, particularly candidates who are eligible to support sensitive or

classified Singapore Government engagements.

Previous experience working on Singapore Government, highly classified, critical-infrastructure or

other high-security projects is highly advantageous.

Candidates who are familiar with the security expectations, professional conduct, documentation

discipline and operational constraints associated with sensitive government environments will be

especially relevant to this role.

What You Can Expect

ITSEC provides on-the-job training, technical mentorship and exposure to experienced cybersecurity

professionals to help consultants continue developing their capabilities.

You will have opportunities to:

• Work on diverse and technically challenging penetration-testing engagements.

• Develop deeper expertise across traditional IT, cloud, OT and emerging technology environments.

• Strengthen your consulting, client communication and professional report-writing skills.

• Learn from experienced offensive-security practitioners.

• Experiment responsibly with AI-assisted and automated security-testing approaches.

• Progress technically into specialised offensive-security domains as your experience develops.

If you enjoy understanding how systems can be broken, explaining why it matters, and helping

organisations become more secure, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer (Forward Deployed)
description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to help design, build, and operate the data foundations that underpin Nscale’s platform, internal operations, and customer-facing capabilities.

This is a high-impact, early-stage role. You’ll work closely with Operations, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Product, and Commercial teams to turn raw operational signals — from GPUs, clusters, customers, and internal systems — into reliable, scalable data products that ensure delivery at a previously unseen pace. You’ll help define how data is collected, modelled, served, and trusted across the company, and have the opportunity to build on Palantir Foundry, as well as other products.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building data systems from first principles, thrives in ambiguous environments, and wants to see their work directly influence product decisions, platform reliability, and customer outcomes.

What you'll be doing

Data Platform & Architecture

  • Design and build scalable, reliable data pipelines that ingest data from infrastructure, platform services, and business systems.
  • Define data models and schemas that support operational workflows and use cases across the business, monitoring, and analytics.
  • Clean, transform and structure the data to create a digital twin of Nscale.
  • Implement permissioning and manage access and security of the Foundry implementation.

Data Products & Enablement

  • Create trusted datasets and metrics that power workflows and processes, internal tools, and customer-facing insights.
  • Enable self-serve analytics by establishing clear data contracts, documentation, and semantic layers.
  • Build use cases including but not limited to capacity planning, cost optimisation, reliability analysis, and customer reporting to drive our business forward.
  • Collaborate with Product and Commercial teams to translate real-world questions into robust data solutions.

Reliability, Quality & Governance

  • Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to ensure data correctness and availability.
  • Codify data lineage, freshness, and consistency across systems.
  • Establish best practices around data versioning, access control, and governance appropriate for a fast-scaling company.
  • Continuously improve system resilience and observability.

Early-Stage Ownership & Growth

  • Take end-to-end ownership of projects, from design through to production and iteration.
  • Help define standards, tooling, and ways of working for data at Nscale.
  • Contribute to technical decision-making as the company scales its platform and customer base.
  • Act as a thought partner to engineers and operators, not just a service function.

About You

  • Deep, hands-on experience building in Palantir Foundry, including ontology modelling, pipeline development, API integration, and large-scale data platform design.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, with experience applying data engineering libraries and frameworks (e.g. Spark, PySpark, Dask, pandas) to work with large, complex datasets.
  • Familiarity with API-driven data integration, including REST, GraphQL, and Foundry Action APIs.
  • Practical experience working in Git-based development workflows, including code reviews, version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage environments where requirements evolve quickly.
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain data concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A bias toward ownership, pragmatism, and shipping useful solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure telemetry.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, monitoring data, or usage-based billing data.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing data products or platforms.

What we can offer you

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months. 🚀
  • Join the fastest-growing tech startup, your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI. ✨
  • Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
  • Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
Job Description & Requirements

You will lead a team of testers and automation engineers, ensuring high-quality deliverables through robust test planning, automation, and continuous improvement. This role requires strong leadership, technical expertise, and collaboration across agile squads.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Governance

  • Define and evolve the testing strategy (shift‑left, risk‑based testing, BDD/TDD, contract testing) across squads and products.
  • Establish common standards and templates (test strategy, plan, RTM, exit criteria) aligned to recognized practices (e.g., ISTQB foundations, ISO/IEC 29119 test documentation, OWASP Testing Guide).
  • Create and run quality governance (readiness/exit gates, defect SLAs, change failure rate tracking) and own QA OKRs for the division.
  • Maintain a test architecture roadmap (frameworks, environments, data, observability) and drive tool consolidation.

Test Engineering & Automation

  • Own end‑to‑end automation strategy: UI, API, contract, component, and smoke/regression suites integrated into CI/CD.
  • Ensure maintainable frameworks, coding standards, and code reviews; champion modular page/object models, data builders, and parallelization.
  • Ability to define and achieve comprehensive test coverage across functional, non-functional, and automation layers to ensure quality and risk mitigation
  • Plan and execute performance, scalability, resilience, and security testing; collaborate with engineering on tuning and hardening.
  • Define SLO aligned test goals (latency, throughput, error rate) and bake checks into pipelines.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Compliance to balance risk, speed, and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide clear dashboards and release readiness reports; communicate trade offs and recommendations to leadership.
  • Lead and mentor a multi disciplinary squad (automation, functional, performance, security) serving multiple applications; manage capacity, prioritization, and cross team engagement.
  • Stand up shared services for regression, performance & security testing, test data management, and environment orchestration.
  • Coach squads on story quality (acceptance criteria, testability, Definition of Ready/Done) and facilitate test planning in sprint cadences.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead retrospectives and incident reviews (escaped defects, production issues) to improve prevention.
  • Drive skills development (automation, performance, security) and keep the team current with tooling and methods.


Requirements:

  • 10+ years in QA/testing, 3+ years leading centralized or cross product testing teams.
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
  • Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in MySQL and PostgreSQL for test data preparation, backend verification, and database-level testing.
  • Hands on expertise with Selenium, Cypress and Playwright and API testing (Postman/REST Assured), plus CI/CD integration.
  • Strong grasp of Agile/Scrum, DevOps, and shift left practices (BDD/TDD, contract testing).
  • Solid knowledge of performance and security testing concepts and tools (JMeter/k6, OWASP ZAP).
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and container orchestration (Kubernetes) for test environment management.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
  • Self-motivated with a passion for continuous learning and improvement.

Genel Nitelikler

  • Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun olan,

  • Yazılım ekiplerinde teknik liderlik, çözüm mimarisi, teknik yönlendirme veya takım liderliği deneyimine sahip,
  • Java ve Spring Boot teknolojileri ile kurumsal ölçekli uygulama geliştirme ve yazılım mimarisi konularında ileri seviyede bilgi sahibi,
  • Microservice mimarileri ve RESTful API tasarımı konusunda deneyimli,
  • BFF (Backend for Frontend), API Gateway, Authentication ve Session Management gibi mobil backend mimarileri hakkında bilgi sahibi ve bu yapıların uçtan uca işleyişinde deneyimli,
  • Spring Batch, Kafka ve benzeri mesajlaşma ve kuyruk teknolojileri ile asenkron sistemler geliştirmiş,
  • SonarQube, Fortify ve benzeri kod kalitesi ve güvenlik analiz araçları konusunda deneyimli,
  • Dynatrace, Instana veya benzeri APM (Application Performance Monitoring) araçları hakkında bilgi sahibi,
  • Push Notification süreçleri ve mobil kullanıcı etkileşimi sağlayan backend yapılarında deneyim sahibi,
  • Oracle, MongoDB, Elasticsearch ve Redis gibi veri yönetim teknolojileri konusunda bilgi ve deneyim sahibi,
  • Docker, Kubernetes ve bulut tabanlı mimariler konusunda deneyimli,
  • CI/CD süreçleri, Jenkins, Bitbucket ve benzeri DevOps araçlarıyla çalışma tecrübesine sahip,
  • Tercihen React veya benzeri frontend teknolojileri hakkında temel seviyede bilgi sahibi,
  • Github Copilot ve benzeri yapay zeka destekli yazılım geliştirme araçlarını etkin şekilde kullanabilen,
  • Agile/Scrum metodolojileri ile çalışma deneyimine sahip, analitik düşünme ve problem çözme yetkinlikleri gelişmiş,

Her yönü ile düşünülmüş esnek çalışma modellerimiz, en trend dijital uygulamalarımız, engelsiz, samimi ve en sıkı dostlukların kurulduğu çalışma ortamımız ve birbirine gönülden bağlı kocaman ailemiz ile seni de aramıza bekliyoruz.

title: Employee Relations Advisor
description:
Employee Relations Expert III


Help shape a workplace built on fairness, trust, and accountability


People do their best work when they feel respected, heard, and supported. At ING Hubs Philippines, we're looking for an experienced Employee Relations professional who can help create a positive and compliant work environment while partnering with leaders on complex employee matters.

If you enjoy solving people challenges, navigating complex workplace situations, and influencing business decisions through sound judgment and expertise, we'd love to hear from you.


Role Summary

As an Employee Relations Expert III, you will manage a broad range of employee relations matters across the organization. You will serve as a trusted advisor to leaders, HR stakeholders, and employees, ensuring that workplace concerns are addressed fairly, consistently, and in line with company policies and labor regulations.

You will play a key role in managing employee relations cases, supporting workplace investigations, handling labor relations matters, strengthening policy governance, and helping maintain a culture of integrity and respect.


About the Team

The Employee Relations team partners closely with HR, Legal, Compliance, business leaders, and employees to create a workplace where people can thrive. We manage sensitive matters with professionalism, objectivity, and care while balancing employee experience, business needs, and regulatory compliance.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage employee relations cases from intake through resolution.
  • Assess employee complaints, misconduct concerns, policy violations, and workplace disputes.
  • Support and coordinate workplace investigations with relevant stakeholders.
  • Administer disciplinary processes, including due process documentation and administrative hearings.
  • Facilitate grievance handling, mediation, and conflict resolution initiatives.
  • Partner with Legal, HR Business Partners, and business leaders on labor relations matters.
  • Represent and support the organization in labor and regulatory proceedings when required.
  • Provide guidance on policy interpretation, labor regulations, and employee relations best practices.
  • Identify workplace risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Prepare management reports, case summaries, and employee relations insights.

What We're Looking For

  • 5 to 8 years of experience in Employee Relations, Labor Relations, Human Resources, Legal Compliance, or a related field.
  • Proven experience managing employee relations cases from intake to closure.
  • Strong knowledge of Philippine labor laws, procedural due process requirements, and employment regulations.
  • Experience handling disciplinary actions, workplace investigations, grievance management, and labor disputes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and documentation capabilities.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with professionalism and integrity.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Experience participating in SENA conferences, NLRC proceedings, or DOLE hearings.
  • Experience within financial services, shared services, BPO, or multinational organizations.
  • Exposure to policy governance, compliance, audit, or risk management environments.

What We Offer

At ING, you'll have the opportunity to work with diverse, talented colleagues while helping shape a workplace culture built on trust, accountability, and continuous improvement. We provide an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your expertise is valued, and your growth is supported.

Don't meet 100% of the qualifications? Don't let that hold you back. Research shows that many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If this role excites you and your experience is closely aligned, we encourage you to apply.


How to Apply

Click the apply button on our career site and submit your application through Workday. We look forward to learning more about you.


Job Application Safety Reminder ⚠️

We're seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

  • Apply only via official ING platforms. ING uses Workday as its recruitment system.
  • Verify the sender's email address carefully. Legitimate communications will come from@ing.com and/or@myworkday.com.
  • ING will never request payments, banking information, or fees during the recruitment process. If someone asks for these details, it is a scam.

About ING

At ING, our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and in business. ING Hubs Philippines is an international part of the ING organization, delivering services to business units around the world across Wholesale Banking and Retail Banking activities.

With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help others take a step ahead in life and business. If you want to work with progressive, inspiring, diverse, and supportive colleagues while making a meaningful impact, there is no better place to invest your talents than ING. Join us and apply today

It has built a reputation among founders and investors as the finance partner scale-ups trust, and it now serves scale-ups across Denmark. Requirements

  • At least 4 years in Big Four audit with mid-market clients, plus at least 2 years in-house with final responsibility for accounting or finance
  • Experience as Head of Finance, Accounting Director, or similar in a growth stage business
  • Strong technical judgment in Danish GAAP, and IFRS where it applies
  • You have owned the month-end close, the reporting and the finance systems in-house, and improved them
  • Commercial and comfortable in front of people: founders, boards, investors. You explain a technical issue in plain language and you enjoy the conversation
  • Fundraising or due diligence experience is a strong plus, from either side of the table
  • Fluent in Danish and English, and based in Greater Copenhagen

Benefits

  • A senior role in leadership next to the Managing Director in a proven company
  • Competitive base salary and incentive package

title: Business IT Solution Analyst
description:
This Business IT Solution Analyst position sits within the Market Risk systems program, covering VaR, IRC calculations, daily PnL production and attribution, risk consolidation and regulatory reporting, as well as Prudent Valuation calculations and adjustments ensuring the firm's trading book exposures are measured conservatively and in full compliance with applicable capital and valuation standards.

The core technology stack includes Apache Spark on HDFS, with primary development in Java. This role is well-suited to someone with a strong interest in data processing and data engineering. If you are looking to deepen your expertise in Big Data technologies and the complex technical ecosystems that surround them, this position offers an excellent career opportunity.

Main Responsibilities

Functional Knowledge & Analysis

  • Own and maintain deep functional knowledge of Market Risk applications
  • Liaise with Front Office, Risk Managers, Quantitative Analysts, and IT stakeholders to gather, clarify, and document business requirements
  • Analyze the functional impact of changes in coordination with the technical lead, considering system and architectural constraints
  • Prepare, present, and document functional specifications and user stories in JIRA, aligned with business needs and regulatory requirements
  • Support the development team on functional matters and maintain up-to-date functional documentation
  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of risk consolidation workflows, regulatory reporting processes, and market data management within a Banking environment

Functional Testing

  • Define and own the test strategy in coordination with the Application Manager
  • ·Conduct continuous testing in development environments; write functional unit and system test cases and maintain test artefacts throughout the project lifecycle
  • Coordinate UAT prioritization with the Project Manager and support production deployments through post-deployment validation checks

Application Support – Functional Incidents

  • Provide Level 2 functional support for incidents escalated from Level 1
  • Reproduce, analyze, and investigate functional issues related to risk calculations and market data
  • Resolve functional problems in coordination with developers and perform ad hoc simulations and impact analyses for Front Office users

Qualifications andProfile

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Systems Analysis, or related discipline
  • 10+ years of experience as a Senior Business Analyst within the Market Risk department of a Banking industry with hands-on expertise across VaR, IRC, PnL calculations, risk consolidation, regulatory reporting, and Prudent Valuation
  • Strong technical grounding in data models and SQL, with the ability to perform ad hoc data analysis and impact simulations for Front Office users
  • Proven experience acting as the functional liaison between Front Office, Risk Managers, Quantitative Analysts, and IT stakeholders — bridging onshore business lines and offshore technical teams as the primary functional point of contact
  • Extensive experience in requirements gathering, drafting detailed functional specifications and user stories in JIRA, and presenting functional changes to development teams in line with FRTB, Basel III/IV, and CRR/EBA regulatory frameworks
  • Thorough experience in functional testing and validation, including writing unit test cases, maintaining test artefacts, coordinating UAT, and performing post-deployment production checks to ensure the integrity of risk outputs
  • Demonstrated experience in Level 2 application support, including issue reproduction, root cause analysis, and resolution of calculation and data discrepancies in collaboration with developers
  • Practical experience leveraging AI-powered tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, generative AI assistants) to enhance productivity and problem-solving
  • Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals, including prompt engineering, model limitations, and best practices for human-AI collaboration
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs for accuracy, security, and alignment with business requirements
  • Ability to identify and implement opportunities for AI integration and workflow automation

Technical

  • Apache Spark, HDFS, Java — Core platform technologies
  • SQL — data analysis, ad hoc queries, and impact simulations
  • XML, UML — data exchange and system modelling
  • JIRA — user story and functional specification management
  • Familiarity with Big Data ecosystems and distributed computing concepts
