title: Cost Analyst
description:
Do you have a passion for finance and a knack for problem-solving? Are you interested in working in the exciting world of aerospace manufacturing?
Job Title: Cost Analyst
Department: Finance / Accounting
Location: EURO-COMPOSITES Corporation – Culpeper, VA
Employment Type: Full-Time, Salary Exempt
Salary Range: $60,000 – $75,000
We're looking for a highly motivated and results-driven Cost Analyst who's excited to build controlling structures, optimize manufacturing costs, and shape the site's long-term profitability. Reporting directly to the Cost Accounting Manager within the Finance team, you will support all plant controlling activities and provide data to drive operational decision-making within a precision-critical aerospace defense government contracting environment. If you enjoy solving complex financial and operational challenges and seeing your insights directly impact decision-making on the production floor, this role is for you!
In this role, you will play a vital role in our financial success by:
  • Extract and analyze data from ERP and financial systems to perform inventory valuation, product costing, and price-cost analysis. Calculate production costs, labor costs, and overhead expenses across 5,000+ unique custom products with multi-layer Bill-of-Materials (BOMs) and routings to support these efforts.
  • Conduct variance and margin analyses to identify and monitor root-cause issues, including but not limited to labor and overhead efficiency, scrap trends, yield estimates, purchase price differentials, machine rates, employee utilization, and resource usage.
  • Utilize advanced Microsoft Excel tools, including extensive Power Query use, to perform the above responsibilities and build live reporting tools for use across departments.
  • Support internal and external audits as required, such as year-end audits, customer-mandated price and cost analysis reports (PCARs), in-house physical inventory counts, daily cycle counts, etc.
  • Establish and scale controlling structures to support accurate and effective internal controls across all financial processes, with particular emphasis on inventory.
  • Support capital investment (CapEx) through financial analysis and business case development, to include return-on-investment (ROI)/payback period calculations.
  • Assist in the development and continuous evaluation of annual account/departmental budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
  • Prepare and analyze monthly financial reports, including commentary, to support financial closing activities.
  • Establish, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) regarding operational and financial performance to management.
  • Create and maintain operational dashboards and financial models to provide real-time insights into revenue and cost trends, supporting profitability.
  • Locate opportunities for cost reduction and process improvement through pro-active collaboration with Plant Management, Operations, Sales, Procurement, and Corporate Finance teams.
  • Integrate directly with daily floor operations, building cross-functional relationships to align operational activities with financial outcomes.
  • Assist in cleaning datasets in preparation for group-wide ERP and Accounting software migrations.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements such as FAR, DFARS, CAS, ITAR, EAR, CUI, and CMMC.
To be successful in this role, you will need:
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. MBA or related advanced degree is a plus.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in cost analysis, plant controlling, manufacturing finance, or industrial controlling.
  • Strong knowledge of cost accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis within a complex custom manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Sage, or equivalent.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (V/X-lookup, Index/X-Match, Ifs/And/Or/Switch, Text-Split, Filter, Unique/Sort, Sum-Product, X-IRR/X-NPV, and forecast functions; Inquire auditing; pivot tables and chart modeling; regressions; VBA macros; and Power Query) backed by hands-on experience with business intelligence and reporting tools.
  • Proven expertise with Power Query is a must.
  • Experience using SQL to extract and analyze raw data directly from relational databases is a plus.
  • Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, and CAS compliance standards and contract reporting requirements. Understanding of ITAR, EAR, CUI, and CMMC security and compliance requirements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and presentation capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively and manage multiple reporting requirements in a cross-functional and international environment.
  • German language skills are considered an advantage.
Why EURO-COMPOSITES® Corporation?
We believe great people build great products. When you join our team, you can expect:
  • Competitive compensation ($60,000 – $75,000 per year) and comprehensive benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA contributions, and Company-Paid Life Insurance.
  • 401(k) with Company Match, generous PTO, and 10 Paid Holidays.
  • Teladoc Virtual Health & Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Clear opportunities for professional growth and leadership development in a rapidly growing enterprise.
  • A collaborative, respectful culture where your financial and operational insights directly drive outcomes.
  • Exposure to exciting, high-impact custom manufacturing projects in aerospace and advanced materials.
Shape the Future of Composites!
If you’re ready to take your manufacturing finance skills to the next level and be a key strategic partner in a forward-thinking plant operations team, we’d love to hear from you!
Apply today and help drive financial excellence and operational success at EURO-COMPOSITES Corporation!
This position is located at an ITAR-regulated facility. Applicants must be U.S. persons as defined by 22 CFR § 120.15 (U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident).

title: Digital Functional Senior Analyst
description:

Bring clarity to complexity: help shape digital initiatives by connecting customer needs, business goals and platform capabilities.

Join us in Genoa as Digital Functional Senior Analyst and help shape the way our guests discover, purchase and personalize their Costa experience across our digital ecosystem. If you are passionate about understanding how digital platforms enable customer journeys and enjoy translating business needs into scalable functional solutions, this is your opportunity to make an impact. You will act as a key bridge between Business, Product and Technology teams, ensuring that digital initiatives are aligned with platform capabilities, dependencies and implementation requirements.

Live your ambition. Lead with impact

title: Engineering Supervisor

The Town of The Blue Mountains is a proud municipal employer located in Grey County. The Town provides services for more than 9,300 full-time residents and has a diverse staff of more than 170 full and part-time employees. The Town is also home to an extensive part-time and seasonal population, welcoming more than 2.5 million visitors annually. We're looking for people who share our commitment to building a sustainable community and our values of Accountability & Transparency, Leadership, Stewardship, Respect, and Collaboration.
Come gain a unique experience in the 2nd fastest growing municipality in Canada!
Position Summary:
Reporting to the Manager of Engineering, the Engineering Supervisor provides technical leadership and supervision within the Town’s Engineering Division, ensuring high-quality, consistent, and timely engineering review of development applications. The position leads the design compliance and quality assurance functions for engineering deliverables and coordinates growth-related infrastructure initiatives, ensuring alignment between development requirements, capital planning, and municipal infrastructure delivery. The Supervisor assists the Manager in the day-to-day operation of the Division and acts in their absence as required.
Key Duties and Responsibilities:
Supervision and Operational Leadership

Supervise, mentor, and support Engineering staff, including onboarding, training, and performance management.
Coordinate and prioritize divisional workflows, including development review activities and infrastructure-related work.
Monitor workflow performance and manage resource allocation, including tracking development files and capital-related activities, and adjusting as required to meet service levels.

Analyze data to support program budgeting, resourcing, and development-related financial considerations.
Identify and implement improvements to processes, procedures, and service delivery.

Development Review and Design Compliance

Lead and oversee engineering review of development applications, including subdivisions, site plans, and condominiums, ensuring compliance with municipal standards and applicable legislation.
Ensure detailed engineering review of development submissions, including servicing design, calculations, modelling, and construction coordination, to confirm compliance with municipal standards and approved conditions.
Provide quality assurance and control on development engineering deliverables, including comments, reports, agreements, and approvals, including securities, certificates, and assumption processes.

Ensure consistency, accuracy, and completeness in technical reviews and recommendations.
Confirm servicing capacity and identify infrastructure upgrades required to support development proposals.

Infrastructure Coordination and Capital Support

Coordinate and support the delivery of growth-related infrastructure projects arising from development approvals and municipal requirements, in coordination with the Manager’s direction and approved capital plans.

Provide technical oversight and coordination for infrastructure works, including projects initiated by the Town or through developer obligations.

Support coordination of design and construction requirements for infrastructure works associated with development, including review of drawings, specifications, and project sequencing.
Liaise with internal departments and Engineering Project Managers to support alignment, scheduling, and delivery of infrastructure projects.

Monitor assigned project activities, timelines, and budget performance, and escalate risks or issues as required.

Project Management and Contract Administration

Undertake project management, including procurement support, contract administration, change order review, and construction oversight for development-related infrastructure works, including projects in Default status.

Assist in procurement processes, preparation of contract documents, and administration of consultant and construction contracts.
Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with approved designs, standards, and contractual requirements.

Stakeholder Coordination

Coordinate meetings and engagement with internal staff, developers, consultants, agencies, and the public on engineering matters.
Support resolution of technical issues and stakeholder concerns in a professional and consistent manner.

Technical Support and Reporting

Assist in the preparation of technical reports, studies, and presentations for senior management and Council.
Support the Manager in budget planning, forecasting, and resource allocation.
Maintain current knowledge of industry standards, technologies, and best practices.

Compliance and Health & Safety

Ensure adherence to municipal policies, applicable legislation, and health and safety requirements.
Promote a safe, respectful, and professional work environment.

What you will need:

Post-Secondary Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering or related field with a designation as a P.Eng or CET. Preference for CET with eligibility to apply for a limited license for municipal engineering work from Professional Engineers Ontario (PEO)
Minimum of 5 (five) years of practical and progressive design, costing, construction inspection, and approval experience related to municipal infrastructure with progressive more substantial project management and contract administration skills.

title: Head of Legal & Compliance
description:
Position Summary

The Head of Legal & Compliance is responsible for leading the Company's legal, compliance, and corporate governance functions, ensuring adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and industry best practices. This is a hands-on role that combines legal advisory, regulatory compliance, and company secretarial oversight while partnering closely with senior management to support business growth and manage legal and regulatory risks. May require travel to West Africa a few times per year.

Key Responsibilities

Legal & Compliance

  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the Company's legal and compliance framework, policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Review and strengthen existing compliance programmes, including Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) frameworks.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) and manage all regulatory communications, submissions, inspections, and enquiries.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and advise management on legal and compliance implications.
  • Conduct compliance monitoring, risk assessments, internal reviews, and control testing to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
  • Coordinate and support internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and remediation efforts.
  • Develop and deliver compliance awareness and training programmes across the organisation.

Legal Advisory & Corporate Governance

  • Provide practical and commercially focused legal advice to management and business units.
  • Draft, review, negotiate, and approve a broad range of commercial agreements, contracts, board resolutions, and other legal documentation.
  • Serve as Company Secretary or oversee outsourced company secretarial functions, ensuring compliance with statutory and corporate governance requirements.
  • Maintain legal, compliance, and governance documentation required for regulatory reviews and audits.
  • Lead the digitalisation and automation of legal and compliance records to improve operational efficiency, governance, and regulatory compliance.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead the Legal & Compliance function while remaining actively involved in day-to-day legal matters, regulatory issues, escalations, and operational challenges.
  • Build strong working relationships with regulators, external legal counsel, auditors, business partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, and compliance across the organisation.
  • Support senior management with practical legal and compliance solutions that enable business objectives while managing regulatory risk.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in law (LLB or equivalent) is required. Admission to practice as a lawyer in Singapore or another common law jurisdiction is strongly preferred.
  • 5–10 years of relevant post-qualification experience, preferably as an in-house legal counsel within large family-owned organisations and family offices.
  • Strong stakeholder management – able to engage and influence senior management, business leaders and external stakeholders.
  • Commercially minded – able to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice rather than taking a purely legalistic approach.
  • Ability to challenge constructively – comfortable pushing back on business decisions where there are legal, regulatory or compliance risks, while still maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in commercial contracting, corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and legal risk management.
  • Strong working knowledge of MAS regulations, AML/CFT requirements, KYC frameworks, and corporate governance practices.
  • Experience serving as Company Secretary or overseeing corporate secretarial matters is an advantage.

Key Competencies

  • Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility across all levels of the organisation.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice.
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Hands-on leader who leads by example and actively supports the team through complex legal and regulatory matters.
  • Demonstrates composure and sound judgment under pressure, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and deliver pragmatic solutions.
  • High integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail.

Able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

title: SDET - API/Middleware (India)
description:
Job Overview

Welo Global is hiring an SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) to bring deep technical rigor to middleware-layer testing. This role requires strong technical expertise across gRPC-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, JSON-RPC/REST, proxy-based traffic inspection, and API scripting. The primary responsibility is to observe and reconstruct the network interactions generated by the onboarding UI, including request/response structures, schemas, headers, identifiers, Enums, and client-injected parameters. This is primarily an API/network analysis and evidence-generation role rather than a conventional UI automation or regression-testing role. The resource will produce sanitized network evidence and controlled, benign tracer replay scripts for downstream backend validation.


Project Details

Title: SDET - API/Middleware
Rate: $9.50/hr
Start Date: 19th October
Duration: 5 Weeks
Commitment: 35 Hours per Week
Location: India (Remote)
Job Type: Freelance

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain automated API test suites covering gRPC-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, and JSON-RPC/REST based services

  • Export clean, sanitized HAR/network evidence while maintaining traceability between UI actions and corresponding network requests.

  • Map relevant schemas, headers, identifiers, routing information, and client-injected parameters.

  • Use proxy tools such as Mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, and browser DevTools to inspect, intercept, and validate network traffic between client and server

  • Develop and maintain API automation scripts using Python, Postman, and cURL for functional and regression testing

  • Analyze protocol-level request/response behavior to identify defects related to serialization, encoding, and transport

  • Inspect and validate request payload structure, including system-level headers (e.g., auth tokens, routing identifiers) and internal/hidden parameters, ensuring correct handling under both valid and malformed conditions

  • Collaborate with backend and middleware engineers to define testable contracts and edge-case scenarios

  • Continuously improve test automation frameworks for reliability, speed, and maintainability

  • Document technical findings, automation coverage, and known protocol-level limitations

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on expertise of 3-5+ years with gRPC-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, and JSON-RPC/REST protocols

  • Proficiency with proxy/traffic inspection tools including Mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, and browser DevTools

  • Solid scripting/programming skills in Python, with practical use of Postman and cURL for API automation

  • Experience designing and maintaining automated test suites for middleware or API-layer services

  • Working understanding of API request structure, including headers, auth tokens, and internal/system parameters, and how to test for their correct handling

  • Understanding of software engineering practices as applied to test automation (version control, CI integration, code review)

  • Strong debugging skills at the network/protocol level

  • Experience analysing browser-generated network traffic and reconstructing API behaviour is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with HAR analysis, API schema reconstruction, or controlled API replay is strongly preferred.

  • Ability to work within approved staging/test environments and follow defined data-handling and test-authorization requirements is required.

Senior SAP HANA Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced SAP HANA Engineer to design, build, and optimize HANA-native data models and analytical objects supporting S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, and standalone HANA platforms. In this role you will translate complex business and analytics requirements into performant HANA models, and you will be the go-to expert for diagnosing and resolving HANA performance issues across the SAP landscape. The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in HANA-native modeling — including calculation views, CDS views, AMDPs, and SQLScript — with strong performance-tuning skills and a clear understanding of HANA internals.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop performant calculation views, CDS views, AMDPs, and SQLScript procedures for analytical and transactional workloads.
  • Translate business and analytics requirements into well-structured HANA data models that balance flexibility, performance, and maintainability.
  • Optimize complex queries, joins, and aggregations through careful use of partitioning, pruning, and parallelization features of HANA.
  • Lead HANA performance reviews and audits, using tools such as HANA Studio Plan Visualizer, ST04, ST05, and DBACOCKPIT to identify bottlenecks.
  • Implement appropriate security models for HANA, including analytic privileges, roles, and row-level security.
  • Design and operate HANA replication scenarios using SLT, smart data integration, and smart data access.
  • Support data tiering using HANA Native Storage Extension and dynamic tiering where appropriate.
  • Build and maintain HANA-native applications and procedures consumed by Fiori, BW, and BTP services.
  • Lead capacity planning and sizing for HANA systems, taking into account both current and projected workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with Basis, ABAP, and analytics teams to ensure HANA models are integrated cleanly with the broader landscape.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior developers on HANA-native development and performance best practices.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 12 or more years of SAP HANA development experience.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with calculation views, CDS views, AMDPs, and SQLScript.
  • Solid understanding of HANA architecture, including in-memory storage, columnar processing, and parallel execution.
  • Hands-on experience with HANA performance tuning tools and methodologies.
  • Experience with HANA replication tools (SLT, SDI, SDA).
  • Working knowledge of HANA security models, including analytic privileges and roles.
  • Familiarity with S/4HANA embedded analytics or BW/4HANA modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

title: Project Analyst, Provost Office (Academic Affairs)
description:
Salary: £36,000 per annum

Employment type: Maternity Cover for 12 months

Hours per week: 37

Reporting into: Director of the Provost Office

Department: Academic Office

Click here to read the full job description and view our excellent benefits here

This role operates primarily on a remote working arrangement that will require little to no travel into our Coventry head office.

Our working model arrangements are a non-contractual benefit so please note that an Arden work location is added to our employment contracts.

About Arden University:

We are an aspirational and multi-award-winning university, delivering rapid growth with ambitious plans to disrupt the HE sector through our passion for innovation and digital education. Our vision is to become the first-choice university for career-focused lifelong learners worldwide, ensuring that everyone, everywhere can access higher education.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines, forge worldwide partnerships, and expand our locations.

About our Department:

The Academic Office at Arden University supports academic governance, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and student success.

It oversees programme approval, policy development, assessment management, and academic standards, working with faculties, professional services, and regulators to ensure compliance and enhance the student experience.

About the Role:

You will support the Director of the Provost Office in managing the Academic Affairs project portfolio. You will collect, analyse, and present data on project proposals, progress, risks, and capacity to support prioritisation and decision-making.

Working with Business Analysts, Project Managers, and stakeholders, you will maintain an accurate project overview, support governance reporting, and promote consistent processes and tools.

The role will provide data-driven insights, improve transparency, and support the delivery of strategically aligned projects.

About You:

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and analytical Project Analyst to join the Provost Office (Academic Affairs).

You will bring strong project management, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to support a diverse portfolio of projects in a fast-paced environment as well as the following:

Essential requirements:

  • Educated to degree level OR Proven track record of relevant extensive work experience, in a series of progressively more complex roles.

  • Meticulous attention to detail, highly organised, capable of administering a diverse programme portfolio effectively

  • Excellent communication skills sufficient to produce and present high-quality reports and dashboards to track project and portfolio trends.

  • Experience of managing a project within a fast-paced organisation

  • Sound understanding of the relevant professional, legal and regulatory requirements of own field of work.

Desirable requirements:

  • Project Management qualification e.g. PRINCE2 or Agile PM OR Formal BA qualification e.g. Agile BA, BCS BA Foundation or Diploma OR equivalent.

  • Experience working within the Higher Education sector

Why Arden:

At Arden, you will become a part of a passionate and dedicated team who are committed to removing unnecessary barriers to learning and making education more accessible. Our people work hard to ensure our students journeys are the best they can possibly be, as such we want to reward our people with fantastic benefits. Employees benefit from:

  • 30 days holiday + bank holidays on-top, and even a Christmas closure!

  • A generous Aviva pension plan, company contributions starting from 7%

  • BUPA Cash Plan

  • Private Medical Insurance coverage (applies to certain job roles)

  • Access to Perkbox benefits

  • Study any Arden course for free, with a discount for all family and friends

  • Plus, other excellent benefits

  • Our ‘Golden Ticket’ which allows you to gift anyone in your life a free Arden education

Our Values:

Stand out, Progressive, Accessible, Resourceful, Kindness, reflect who we are as an institution, a team and as individuals. If they also reflect you and you are excited by the chance to be the driving, creative force within a growing business, we want to hear from you.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines and locations.

Closing Date: Monday 12 October

We reserve the right to close this vacancy before the specified closing date should we receive sufficient applications or in order to respond to business needs. In order to avoid missing an opportunity to apply please submit your application as early as possible.

If you are a current Arden student or have an upcoming course with us, you are not eligible to apply for Student Experience roles due to a conflict of interest related to system access.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion:

Arden University is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. This means that if you have a disability, as defined by the Disability Equality Act 2010, you may be guaranteed an interview if you meet the essential criteria for the role.

If you wish to be considered under this scheme, you can indicate via the application form below. By doing so, you are also consenting for this information to be shared with the hiring team. For more details on what qualifies as a disability under the Disability Equality Act 2010, please refer to the guidance here.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. Therefore, we make sure that our recruitment and selection processes never discriminate based upon people's age, disability, gender, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or other personal circumstances, and actively welcome applications from all groups.

Sponsorship statement:

Please be aware that some roles may not meet the points requirement for a sponsored Skilled Worker visa, or fulfil the criteria we have for providing sponsorship. However we welcome applications from candidates who do not currently have the right to work in the UK but may be eligible for a visa through an alternative route.

title: Finance Executive (Ubi/SME/near MRT)
description:

title: Yard Specialist
description:
If you enjoy working with a team, outdoors, and with your hands, then this is a great opportunity to get your foot in the door of a booming industry! We’re looking for people who don’t shy away from hard work and who are dedicated to what they do. There’s no better time than now to join this industry and there’s no better company than Carter Lumber.

Our Story
Carter Lumber was founded in 1932 by W.E. Carter. For 90 years, we have strengthened our company by staying true to our values, which include honesty, hard work, and putting people first. What started as a single lumberyard in Akron, Ohio, is represented today by seven brands servicing professional builders and homeowners across thirteen states with more than 160 locations. Despite our growth, we are still a family-owned company. Our core values and our people-first culture remain the same.

Description:
You will assist contractors and do-it-yourselfers with the selection and loading of their order, pull and stage materials to be picked up and/or delivered, help maintain the inventory in the Yard by conducting cycle counts, and keep the Yard organized and clean. Equipment used includes a forklift and if you haven't operated one previously, we will train you and help you attain certification.

Requirements

  • Customer service experience
  • Friendly personality
  • Familiarity with building materials is helpful
  • Ability to be a team player
  • Ability to work outside in all conditions

Benefits (full-time employees)

  • Health, Dental, Vision (Single and Family Plans) available after 30 days of employment
  • Short and Long-Term Disability
  • Company-paid life insurance and AD&D
  • Optional supplemental life insurance
  • Company-match 401(k)
  • Vacation time and paid holidays
  • Vendor incentives
  • Room for growth; we promote from within!
  • Military encouraged to apply!

description:

  • Good coordination, communication, follow-up and organisational skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Able to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines effectively.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving ability and ability to work independently.
  • Good documentation and record-keeping skills.
  • Preferably able to speak and write in both English and Chinese.
  • Candidates with experience in earthwork, construction, haulage or related subcontracting works will be an advantage.
  • Immediate availability is preferred.

title: Software Developer – CRM & Loyalty Systems
description:
Build scalable systems and shape the technical evolution of our Loyalty & CRM platform.

We are looking for a Software Developer who plays a key role in designing, building, and evolving our Loyalty and CRM solutions, working closely with product and business teams to deliver scalable and high-quality software.

You will be part of an ongoing transformation from legacy systems to a modern, cloud-native microservices architecture.

This position:

  • Works closely with product managers, analysts and business stakeholders
  • Focuses primarily on backend development, while being able to support frontend implementations when needed
  • Impacts system design, code quality, and platform scalability
  • Contributes to technical decisions and continuous evolution of the platform
  • Acts as a bridge between business requirements and technical implementation

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop backend services for our Loyalty & CRM platform
  • Contribute to technical design decisions and translate requirements into scalable and maintainable solutions
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code using modern engineering practices
  • Take ownership of the full development lifecycle: design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring
  • Collaborate closely with analysts and product teams to ensure accurate implementation of business requirements
  • Work with APIs, integrations, and distributed systems across multiple services
  • Support and extend existing frontend applications by modifying and integrating existing components when needed
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in development and production environments
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to improve delivery speed and reliability
  • Work on a scalable, multi-tenant Loyalty & CRM platform with complex business rules and ongoing microservices transformation

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or a related field
  • Minimum 4–5 years of hands‑on software development experience

title: Junior Security Engineer
company: ZALORA SOUTH EAST ASIA PTE LTD
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
Zalora is hiring a Junior Security Engineer to join its security team and support day-to-day security operations under the guidance of the Senior Security Lead. This is a hands-on, learning-oriented role: you’ll help execute security reviews, monitor and triage findings, support incident response, and assist with hardening cloud and application environments. You’ll work closely with the Senior Security Lead and Zalora engineering teams to build your skills across cloud security, application security, and AI/LLM security, while contributing directly to Zalora’s security posture.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Security Operations & Monitoring

  • Monitor security alerts, logs, and dashboards; triage and escalate findings to the Senior Security Lead as needed.
  • Support day-to-day cloud security hygiene checks (primarily AWS, also GCP) — e.g., IAM reviews, misconfiguration checks, and basic remediation.
  • Help maintain security tooling and automation scripts used across the team.

Application & Infrastructure Security Support

  • Assist with security architecture reviews for new and existing systems under senior guidance.
  • Run and interpret basic SAST/DAST scans, and help track findings through to remediation with engineering teams.
  • Support secure configuration of containerized environments (Docker).
  • Assist, where opportunities arise, with Kubernetes/CI-CD pipeline security and reviewing AI-driven features or LLM integrations for common risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage) under senior guidance — exposure to this work will grow over time, not expected on day one.

Incident Response & Testing Support

  • Support incident response activities — gathering logs, documenting timelines, and assisting with remediation tasks under the direction of the Senior Security Lead.
  • Assist with penetration testing and red-team exercises (internal or vendor-led), including evidence collection and findings tracking.
  • Coordinate logistics with external vendors and consultants when supporting pentesting or peak-demand engagements.

Collaboration & Growth

  • Work with engineering teams to communicate security findings clearly and help get fixes prioritized.
  • Take on structured learning goals (certifications, tooling, frameworks) with support and mentorship from the Senior Security Lead.
  • Document processes, runbooks, and findings to build the team’s institutional knowledge.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

General qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in security engineering, IT, software engineering, or a related technical field (internships and hands-on personal/academic projects count).
  • Genuine interest in security engineering and a desire to grow into a hands-on technical role.
  • Able to communicate findings clearly in writing, and comfortable asking questions and seeking guidance.
  • Degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, eJPT) are a plus, not required.

Technical Skills

  • Basic understanding of cloud fundamentals (AWS preferred; GCP a plus) — IAM, networking, and common services.
  • Familiarity with at least one scripting/programming language (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for automation tasks.
  • Exposure to or coursework in application security concepts (OWASP Top 10, common vulnerability classes).
  • Basic familiarity with containerized environments (Docker) and version control (Git); Kubernetes exposure is a plus.
  • Curiosity about AI/LLM security concepts is a plus — prior experience not required.

Team & Collaboration

  • Comfortable working under supervision, taking direction, and escalating issues appropriately rather than guessing under pressure.
  • Willing to learn Zalora’s and GFG’s security standards and apply them consistently in day-to-day work.
  • Able to work collaboratively with engineering teams across time zones and markets.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • The unique opportunity to have a serious impact on a growing organisation
  • A dynamic working environment shaping the face of fashion e-commerce in growth markets
  • Best practice scaled agile engineering
  • Amazing office and great culture! Massage chairs, table tennis, video game room, quarterly team events, yearly company trip, end of the year party
  • Hybrid working environment.
  • Clear career progression plan and support
  • Macbook or laptop when you start
  • Social insurance, medical insurance & health insurance
  • 13th month salary
  • 15 days of annual leave, 30 days of sick leave, 1 day of occasion leave

About ZALORA Engineering

ZALORA, the leading e-commerce company in fashion throughout Southeast Asia, operates engineering teams in Singapore and Vietnam to serve millions of users in Malaysia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Our regional diversity presents unique challenges you and your colleagues will tackle, providing valuable learning opportunities.

The ZALORA Story

As a pioneering large-scale e-commerce platform and part of the Global Fashion Group, ZALORA has established a robust regional presence, particularly in Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Brunei, the Philippines, Hong Kong. With over 50 million monthly visits, ZALORA is Asia's premier online destination for fashion, beauty, and lifestyle products.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Job Description – Senior AI Engineer (GenAI & Agentic AI)

Location: Hyderabad Experience: 5+ Years Total | 2+ Years Hands-on GenAI & Agentic AI Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to drive the design, architecture, development, and productionization of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI-driven automation solutions for enterprise cybersecurity products.
The ideal candidate should be able to independently own AI initiatives end-to-end—from understanding the business problem and defining the AI approach to architecture, implementation, integration, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong hands-on engineering capability rather than research-only or API-integration experience.

Key Responsibilities
•
Own AI/GenAI initiatives end-to-end, translating business and cybersecurity requirements into scalable AI solutions.
•
Design and implement Agentic AI and Multi-Agent systems for autonomous investigation, decision support, workflow automation, threat analysis, and security operations.
•
Architect and develop LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, conversational systems, and intelligent automation workflows.
•
Design agent orchestration including planning, tool/function calling, memory, state management, task decomposition, retries, human-in-the-loop, and guardrails.
•
Build enterprise-grade RAG solutions, including document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, metadata filtering, reranking, and contextual response generation.
•
Integrate AI agents with enterprise and cybersecurity systems through REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, databases, SIEM/EDR/security tools, & third-party services.
•
Establish AI evaluation mechanisms covering accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, tool-call accuracy, latency, reliability, & cost.
•
Optimize LLM applications for performance, scalability, reliability, token consumption, latency, and inference cost.
•
Design secure AI solutions addressing prompt injection, data leakage, access control, sensitive information handling, unsafe tool execution, and AI-specific security risks.
•
Develop production-ready AI services and APIs using Python/FastAPI, with appropriate logging, error handling, testing, observability, and monitoring.
•
Independently troubleshoot complex issues across LLM, RAG, agent orchestration, integrations, APIs, databases, and deployment environments.
•
Mentor AI engineers and contribute to AI architecture standards, reusable frameworks, engineering best practices, and technical decision-making.
Must-Have Skills & Experience
AI / GenAI / Agentic AI
•
5+ years total software/engineering experience, with at least 2+ years hands-on experience in GenAI and Agentic AI.
•
Strong practical experience building LLM-based production applications and AI agents.
•
Strong understanding of Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Systems, AI workflows, tool calling/function calling, planning, memory, state management, human-in-the-loop patterns and fine-tuning.
•
Hands-on experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph; experience with CrewAI, AutoGen, Agno, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks is a plus.
•
Strong expertise in RAG architecture, embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, reranking, and knowledge-base design.
•
Hands-on experience with vector databases such as Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma or OpenSearch.
•
Strong prompt engineering skills, including structured outputs, few-shot prompting, prompt optimization, and context engineering.
•
Experience with LLM evaluation, hallucination reduction, guardrails, AI observability, and production monitoring.
•
Experience with LLM providers/models such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral or equivalent.
•
Strong Python programming skills with FastAPI, Pydantic, async programming, REST APIs, and API integration.
•
Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, preferably MySQL/PostgreSQL
•
Experience with Docker and cloud-based AI deployment, preferably AWS.
•
Strong understanding of Git, CI/CD, testing, debugging, logging, and production support.

Cybersecurity – Preferred
•
Experience building AI solutions for SOC, SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, incident response, or attack surface management.
•
Understanding of CVE/CVSS, MITRE ATT&CK, threat intelligence, security alerts, vulnerabilities, and security operations workflows is highly desirable.

Good to Have
•
Basic understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and modern web application architecture.
•
Working knowledge of AWS services such as ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, Bedrock, RDS, OpenSearch, and CloudWatch.
•
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and modern agent/tool integration patterns.
•
Exposure to LoRA/PEFT, open-source LLMs, model serving, or inference optimization.

Requirements

What We Expect
The successful candidate should be able to take an AI initiative from “business problem → AI approach → architecture → POC → production implementation → evaluation → deployment → monitoring” with minimal supervision.
We are specifically looking for an engineer who can make architecture decisions, write production-quality code, integrate enterprise systems, troubleshoot independently, and continuously improve AI solutions—not someone limited to prompt writing or calling LLM APIs.

Education: B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or related discipline.

title: Lead Navigator
description:
Lead Navigator
Community Bridges, Inc. (CBI) is an integrated behavioral healthcare agency offering a variety of different programs throughout Arizona. CBI provides residential, outpatient, inpatient, physical health, medication-assisted treatment, and crisis services to individuals experiencing, substance use disorder, homelessness, and mental illness.

CBI is the premiere non-profit fully integrated healthcare provider of substance use and behavioral health programs in Arizona, including prevention, education and treatment using cutting-edge, nationally recognized, evidence-based models.

Job Summary
A Lead Navigator is an individual who is in recovery from AOD use and/or GMH for an appropriate period (greater than or equal to 1 year) and has at least 90 days experience as a Navigator or Peer Support Specialist. The Lead Navigator’s primary role is working with individuals who are homeless, providing outreach and supportive services to assist the member with ending their homelessness. The Lead Navigator serves as the bridge for the patient, in coordinating and monitoring RBHA and Non-RBHA community-based services and facilitates delivery of these services by supporting the individual. The Lead Navigator seeks out individuals with the highest acuity and greatest vulnerabilities, and will be responsible for conducting outreach, engagement, case management, and ongoing wrap around supportive services to the individual. The Lead Navigator is a mentor to the Navigator II to help them onboard, understand the program, and fulfill program requirements. The Lead Navigator has mastered the following processes: coordinated entry, housing referral, leasing up, wrap around services, and discharge. The Lead Navigator works as part of a multi-disciplinary team including specialty positions through the CBI continuum, such as, Patient Care Techs, Registered Nurses, Counselors, and Clinical Leads. The Lead Navigator serves as a nexus, coordinating care with community providers and stakeholders.

Skills/Requirements

Highschool diploma or GED is required. Associates Degree (or higher) in a field related to behavioral health is preferred but not required of this position.
1-3 years of full-time Health Care related work experience where his or her prior experience would provide adequate exposure to both behavioral and medical crisis situations is preferred but not required.

Behavioral Health Technician (BHT) in accordance with A.A.C. R9-10-101.33 and CBI Clinical Policies and Procedures
Arizona Fingerprint Clearance card, site specific

Very Competitive pay rates

We are experiencing tremendous growth in this time. As an essential service provider, we value all our employees and their careers.

Our staff experience tremendous professional growth through ongoing training and support. Our team is supported by strong and competent leadership. The leadership at CBI is committed to ongoing professional development for their staff. title: Head of Communications & Brand
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

About BW Group

BW Group is a leading global energy and maritime company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data centres.

BW is proud to be listed among Forbes World's Best Employers and Financial Times Best Employers Asia-Pacific 2025.

Are you ready to make an impact?

What drives us is our mission to deliver energy for the world today, and to find solutions for tomorrow. If you want to make lives better around the world by providing access to energy, while working on sustainability and decarbonisation, we'd like to hear from you. Working at BW you will feel the pulse of the world each day. If something happens in the world, we feel it, and you can play your part by anticipating and responding to it. Our high-performing teams are drawn to BW by the global nature of our work and the satisfaction of working with collaborative people who inspire each other to deliver exceptional results.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview

Based in Singapore and reporting to the Chief People Officer, BW Group, the Head of Communications & Brand leads communications and corporate brand activities across BW Group whilst also supporting BW LNG.

This is a highly visible role partnering closely with the Chairman, senior executives and Communications leaders across our affiliate companies to strengthen BW's reputation, shape its corporate narrative and foster greater collaboration across the Group.

Success requires far more than exceptional communications capability. You will be a commercially minded strategic thinker who anticipates issues, shapes narratives and influences outcomes through sound judgement, trusted relationships and collaboration in a federated organisation where credibility matters more than hierarchy.

Working with a lean team and external partners, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, helping shape executive communications, protect and enhance the BW brand, support organisational transformation and drive communications excellence across the Group.

Key Accountabilities

Corporate Communications

  • Develop and deliver BW Group's corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group's long-term vision and priorities.
  • Shape compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of BW's purpose, strategy and portfolio of businesses.
  • Advise leaders on communications strategy, executive messaging and stakeholder engagement.
  • Lead communications for strategic initiatives, organisational change, major announcements and corporate events.
  • Oversee BW Group's digital communications, including LinkedIn and other channels, delivering engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic objectives.

Executive Communications

  • Partner closely with the Chairman and senior executives on speeches, presentations, thought leadership and executive communications.
  • Develop executive communications that reflect BW's values and high editorial standards.
  • Lead the production of flagship Group communications, including World Horizon, the Annual Report, Sustainability Report, corporate website and key leadership updates.
  • Support senior executives at conferences, media engagements, investor events and industry forums through end-to-end communications planning and delivery.
  • Serve as a trusted communications adviser to the Chairman and senior leadership, providing sound judgement on messaging, stakeholder considerations and reputational matters.

Employee Communications

  • Lead Group-wide employee communications across digital channels.
  • Deliver engaging communications that connect shore-based and seafaring employees through platforms such as BW Connect.
  • Foster a culture of openness, pride and engagement across the Group.

Brand & Reputation

  • Act as steward of the BW corporate brand, ensuring consistency whilst respecting the autonomy of our affiliate businesses.
  • Evolve BW's corporate identity and positioning to strengthen the Group's reputation and create value across the portfolio.
  • Protect and enhance BW's reputation with employees, customers, investors, regulators, partners and the wider maritime and energy community.
  • Lead crisis and issues communications, partnering with senior management and external advisers as required for ongoing incidents and with post-communications.

BW LNG Communications & Marketing

  • Partner with the BW LNG leadership team to develop communications and marketing initiatives that strengthen the company's commercial positioning and reputation.
  • Lead communications supporting commercial initiatives, including vessel launches, technology innovations, customer campaigns and industry events.
  • Develop marketing content and digital campaigns that showcase BW LNG's capabilities, innovation and market leadership.
  • Ensure alignment between BW LNG's communications and the wider BW corporate brand.

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead BW's Communications Community of Practice, fostering collaboration, sharing best practice and identifying opportunities for greater alignment across affiliate companies.
  • Build trusted relationships with affiliate CEOs and Communications leaders, influencing through credibility rather than authority.
  • Foster collaboration across the Group whilst respecting the entrepreneurial culture and autonomy of individual businesses.

Digital Communications & AI

  • Harness AI and emerging technologies to improve the quality, consistency, efficiency and reach of communications.
  • Identify and implement new tools, channels and approaches that enhance engagement and communications effectiveness.
  • Measure communications impact using meaningful qualitative and quantitative insights.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop a small, high-performing communications team.
  • Manage external agencies and specialist partners to maximise quality, capability and value.
QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

We're looking for someone who combines strategic communications leadership with exceptional judgement and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. You'll ideally bring:

  • Significant experience leading corporate communications within a global organisation or consultancy.
  • Experience advising CEOs and senior executives on communications strategy and reputation management.
  • Strong understanding of corporate branding, stakeholder engagement and executive communications.
  • Experience leading communications during periods of organisational change, transformation or significant corporate activity.
  • Experience working across complex, matrixed or federated organisations would be advantageous.
  • Experience within the maritime or energy sectors would be beneficial, although not essential.

What Will Make You Successful

You'll be someone who naturally earns trust and credibility. You'll demonstrate:

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent judgement and discretion.
  • The ability to simplify complex issues into clear, compelling messages.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness.
  • High levels of curiosity and strategic thinking.
  • Comfort working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.
  • A collaborative style with low ego and high integrity.
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and deliver.
  • Demonstrates sound judgement in knowing when to follow established processes and when a pragmatic, flexible approach will deliver a better outcome.
  • A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and practical application of AI.

This role is unlikely to suit someone who prefers highly structured environments, relies on formal authority to get things done, or wants to specialise in a single area of communications. Success requires sound judgement, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to operate across a broad range of strategic and hands-on responsibilities.

OTHER INFORMATION

Why BW?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the voice and reputation of one of the world's most respected maritime and energy groups.

You'll work closely with visionary leaders who value integrity, long-term thinking and collaboration, while helping tell the story of a business investing in both today's energy needs and tomorrow's energy transition.

The role offers exceptional breadth, combining strategy, executive partnership, brand leadership, organisational change, employee engagement and external communications in an entrepreneurial international environment.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - BW Maritime

title: Cloud Security Researcher
description:
Snowbit is a cybersecurity technology innovator with a vision to empower organizations across the globe to quickly, efficiently, and cost-effectively ready themselves to address omnipresent cyber risk. Towards this end, Snowbit, built off years of Israeli cybersecurity experience, offers the broadest managed detection and response offering available today.

Snowbit is part of the Coralogix group. Coralogix is rebuilding the path to log observability by offloading the burden of indexing and providing deep insights to accumulated data, at an infinite scale, for less than half the cost.

We are looking for accomplished, passionate, and self-driven Security Researchers with a zeal for revolutionizing the enterprise cybersecurity domain to come and join the Snowbit Security Research Group.

This is a team of experts with vast cybersecurity experience focused on research on cloud and enterprise systems to identify emerging threat trends/vectors as well as gaps and opportunities within existing enterprise cybersecurity frameworks.

These insights will play a key role in evolving the Snowbit offering and maintaining its global leadership position in the enterprise-managed detection and response domain.

Joining this team provides a unique opportunity to both benefit from the best of Israeli cybersecurity talent and influence the direction of a new world-class offering in the cybersecurity domain.

What Will you do?

  • Research emerging technologies, threats, vulnerabilities in SaaS and enterprise products and create actionable alerting scenarios.
  • Investigate logs from security systems to detect intrusions or misconfigurations and create detections based on your findings.
  • Write detection rules documentation with actionable recommendations for mitigations.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility into network threats, security incidents, and operational status.
  • Publish your findings internally for customers and externally for blog / marketing needs.
  • Work with our customers to investigate anomalies and incidents and create custom detections and next step recommendations.

Responsibilities will include

  • ·On-going research on known and new attack vectors, including identification, with respect to novel attack vectors including their iteration/evolution and related mitigations across the enterprise IT landscape
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to leverage research findings to evolve Snowbit product and knowledge base.
  • Participate in security escalations support. Create security guidance and documentation.
  • Evaluate & recommend new security technologies and help shape the product going forward with your insights and expertise.
  • Regular updates to internal teams and customers on research findings.
  • Active participation in public cybersecurity media/forums/events.

Requirements

Job Location: Gurgaon - Work from office.

Basic Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in security research in large, complex or security organizations
  • Experience in Managing and securing enterprise IT environments with emphasis on cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience in securing cloud and SaaS environments and familiarity with cloud and SaaS attack vectors and misconfigurations.
  • Experience in enterprise security, hands-on experience with attacking or defending enterprise systems.
  • Experience in threat modeling (Attack kill chain, MITRE ATT&CK/D3FEND), identifying security vulnerabilities, common attacker exploit techniques, and related mitigations and remediations.
  • Hands-on experience with query languages (Kibana/KQL/Lucene/PromQL, Splunk), working with JSON files and writing complex queries and rules.
  • An innovative mind with keen attention to detail and the ability to set goals and parameters for success, investigate and implement solutions to catch threats according to defined goals.

Preferred Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of Cloud security principles

  • Knowledge in script writing, programming language (Python, JS etc)

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Security & GRC Engineer to design, implement, and operate security and access-control frameworks for complex SAP landscapes, including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, BTP, and SuccessFactors. In this role you will be responsible for SAP role design, user provisioning, segregation-of-duties analysis, audit support, and the technical operation of SAP GRC suites. The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in SAP authorization concepts with strong hands-on experience operating SAP GRC Access Control and Process Control, and will partner closely with audit, compliance, and business teams to deliver a secure, auditable SAP environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and maintain SAP authorization concepts and role structures aligned with business processes and least-privilege principles.

  • Configure and operate SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM), including ruleset management, mitigating controls, and emergency access management.
  • Perform segregation-of-duties analysis and remediation in collaboration with business process owners and internal audit.
  • Configure user provisioning workflows in SAP GRC ARM, including request types, approval paths, and integration with IDM/IAM platforms.
  • Operate SAP GRC Process Control for continuous controls monitoring and policy management.
  • Implement security for Fiori applications, including catalogs, groups, and front-end authorizations.
  • Configure and operate security for SAP BTP and cloud applications using XSUAA, IAS, and IPS.
  • Support SAP audits (SOX, GxP, PCI) and respond to audit findings with documented remediation plans.
  • Implement transport security, table logging, and audit logging in line with internal security policies.
  • Monitor and remediate SAP Security Notes in coordination with Basis and DBA teams.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior team members and support knowledge transfer across the security team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of SAP Security / GRC experience in enterprise landscapes.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP authorization concepts and role design.
  • Deep experience operating SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM).
  • Experience supporting SAP audits and remediation activities.
  • Hands-on experience securing Fiori, BTP, and cloud SAP applications.
  • Familiarity with SAP IDM or third-party IGA tooling.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Process Control.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GxP, and PCI.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Undergraduate Industry Placement

Location: UK & Ireland
Salary: £26,500

Duties

The Opportunity

This placement offers the chance to:

  • Join one of McDonald's key suppliers for a full year.
  • Rotate through multiple areas of McDonald's supply chain, from farm to restaurant.
  • Gain hands-on experience with supplier agriculture teams and progressive farms.
  • Work on projects focused on sustainability, technical efficiency, and agricultural innovation.
  • Visit key suppliers to gain insight into agricultural operations and supply chains.
  • Spend a short period working as a crew member in a McDonald's restaurant.
  • Act as an ambassador for McDonald's and its suppliers at industry events.

Qualifications

What Background Do I Need?

We are looking for passionate, curious, self-motivated, and driven undergraduates who can thrive in a fast-paced environment within the McDonald's supply base.

Students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds are encouraged to apply. An agricultural background is not essential, as diverse perspectives strengthen the industry.

Candidates should have:

  • A passion for food, farming, or supply chains.
  • The ability to work independently and within a team.
  • A willingness to learn about careers within food supply chains and farming.

Benefits

  • Competitive placement salary of £26,500.
  • Professional development and mentoring from industry experts.
  • Exposure to the wider agri-food sector across multiple businesses.
  • Flexibility to tailor the programme to your personal development goals.
  • Excellent networking opportunities within both the placement cohort and a global brand.
  • Insight Days with other McDonald's suppliers throughout the year.

Essential Criteria

Applicants must:

  • Hold a full UK or Irish driving licence.
  • Be willing to relocate and/or travel within the UK and Ireland.
  • Be currently undertaking full-time third-level education.
  • Have the legal right to work in the UK and Ireland.

Application Process

1. CV & Cover Letter Submission

  • Applications close at midnight on Monday, 16 November 2026.

2. Video Submission

  • Selected candidates will be invited to submit a video after CV and cover letter review.

3. Assessment Centre

  • Assessment Centre scheduled for Monday, 14 December 2026 in London.

Company Vision and Culture

Our Global vision is to build a better McDonalds and in the UK and Ireland we are working hard to be the UK & Irelands best-loved restaurant company.

McDonalds is defined by its culture. Our culture shapes and informs everything we think and everything we do. Our culture influences the way we interact with each other, and how we interact with customers, franchisees and suppliers. Our culture motivates and inspires us to attract and retain great talent, creating positive, energising, exceptional working environment for us all.

Our values drive our culture and shape our beliefs, our priorities and our actions. They influence the decisions we make, how we treat one another and how we show up as a brand to the world.

Serve: We put our customers and our people first

Inclusion: We open our doors to everyone

Integrity: We do the right thing

Community: We are good neighbours

Family: We get better together

At McDonalds we are People from all Walks of Life...

People are at the heart of everything we do, and they make the McDonalds experience. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture that means people can be their best authentic self in our restaurants and offices, which helps us to better serve our customers. We have a strong heritage of diversity and representation within our communities, which we are proud of. The diversity of our people, customers, Franchisees and suppliers gives us strength.

We do not tolerate inequality, injustice or discrimination of any kind. These are hugely important issues and a brand with our reach and relevance means we have a very meaningful role to play.

We also recognise our responsibility as a large employer to continue being active in our communities, helping to develop skills and drive aspirations that will help people to be more aware of the world of work and more successful within it, whether with McDonalds or elsewhere.

title: Senior/Lead GCP Data Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy turning complex data challenges into scalable, reliable solutions?

Are you passionate about building modern cloud-native data platforms that power analytics, AI, and machine learning products used by millions of customers?

At ING Hubs Türkiye, we're looking for a GCP Data Engineer who wants to build the data foundations behind advanced analytics, intelligent automation, machine learning solutions, and emerging AI products across ING's international network.

You'll work at the intersection of cloud engineering, data platforms, analytics, and AI, helping data scientists, ML engineers, and business teams access trusted, high-quality data at scale.

Role Summary

As a GCP Data Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable data platforms and pipelines on Google Cloud Platform.

Your work will directly support AI-driven products, machine learning initiatives, Agentic AI solutions, and advanced analytics capabilities across ING. You'll collaborate closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, ML Engineers, and Software Engineers to create reliable, production-ready data assets that enable business impact.

The data platforms you build contribute to solutions such as customer intelligence, financial crime detection, risk analytics, automation, and other advanced analytics products used across ING's European operations. Data quality, reliability, and platform performance have meaningful impact on real customer experiences.

Work Model

At ING Hubs Türkiye, flexibility is more than a benefit — it's part of how we work.

Our hybrid way of working is designed to balance collaboration, innovation, and personal flexibility. Team members typically come together at our Vadistanbul office for two days per week during three weeks of the month, while one week each month is fully remote.

We also offer additional flexibility during the summer period, with remote working opportunities throughout August, allowing colleagues to spend more time where they feel most productive while staying connected to their teams.

As part of a globally distributed organization, you'll collaborate with colleagues across multiple ING locations while contributing to solutions that create impact across the bank.

About the Team

You will join a globally connected team focused on delivering scalable data solutions across ING.

The team is passionate about innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, leveraging cloud-native technologies to create reliable and future-ready data products. Together, we enable business value through data, analytics, AI, and emerging intelligent automation capabilities.

You will work in a highly collaborative environment where engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product teams jointly build solutions that power ING's data-driven transformation.

About You

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we'll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in globally distributed teams
  • Hands-on experience building complex data pipelines using PySpark, Airflow, or similar technologies
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience designing data models and working with relational or distributed database systems
  • Understanding of software engineering best practices, including testing, CI/CD, version control, and code reviews

Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as:

  • BigQuery
  • Cloud Storage
  • Cloud Composer
  • Experience building scalable cloud-native data solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Curious mindset and passion for continuous improvement and knowledge sharing
  • Experience with infrastructure provisioning and deployment automation
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as ELK Stack
  • Familiarity with MLOps architectures and operational practices
  • Experience with large-scale data transformation and processing
  • Exposure to AI-powered products including Agentic AI systems, Chatbots, or Voicebots
  • Experience working with Vertex AI, Dialogflow, or other AI-related GCP services
  • Experience with event-driven or streaming data architectures
  • Familiarity with technologies such as Kafka, Pub/Sub, or Dataflow is a plus
  • Experience with dbt for data transformation and modelling is considered an advantage

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-native data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform
  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and storage solutions for large-scale datasets
  • Develop reliable and efficient data models supporting analytics, reporting, machine learning, and AI use cases
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Implement modern software engineering practices, including automated testing and CI/CD
  • Monitor and improve platform reliability, observability, and performance
  • Support AI, machine learning, and MLOps initiatives by delivering trusted and accessible data assets
  • Contribute to engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team

Data Platform Evolution

Our current platform is primarily focused on scalable batch-oriented data processing built on PySpark and Airflow within GCP. As our platform evolves, we continue exploring opportunities around event-driven architectures, AI-enabled data products, and modern cloud-native engineering patterns.

Engineers who bring experience with streaming technologies, real-time ingestion, or AI-enabled platforms will have opportunities to contribute to the future direction of our data ecosystem.

Equal Opportunity

Don't meet every single requirement? Don't let that hold you back. Studies show many talented professionals hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.

What We Offer at ING Hubs Türkiye

At ING Hubs Turkiye, we believe that your work should be fulfilling in every way. We pay attention to even the smallest details to ensure that your experience is rewarding. Here's what you can expect when you join our organization:

Be Yourself, Be an ING'er

  • Welcome Leave: Enjoy 14 days of welcome leave, even in your first year!
  • Career Opportunities: Self-driven career paths and growth opportunities.
  • Personal Growth: Challenging work and continuous development opportunities.
  • Dynamic Environment: Informal, vibrant, and collaborative working culture.
  • Innovation Culture: Opportunity to contribute ideas and work with PACE methodology.
  • Global Exposure: Participation in international projects and communities.
  • Health Care: Comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Card
  • Transportation Allowance
  • MultiSport Membership
  • English Language Development Support

About ING

With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business.

Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues?

Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING.

About ING Hubs

Following ING's strategic ambition to deliver a superior experience to its customers worldwide, the hubs network contributes to fostering efficiency and digitalization across ING. Providing concentrated expertise along with scalable and sustainable solutions, the hubs focus on straight-through processing, delivering automated services like software development, data management and retail operations.

Present in Poland, Romania, Slovakia, the Philippines, Türkiye and Spain, ING Hubs employ more than 13,000 professionals in domains such as software development, data management, operations and non-financial risk.

ING Hubs Türkiye core capabilities, Retail Analytics and Tech, have us looking for data experts, developers and other professionals to get onboard in our Istanbul office located in Technopark, Vadistanbul.

Discover ING Hubs Türkiye

ING Hubs Türkiye is looking for talents to join an international network of professionals. Building on an existing framework and shared mission, our up-and-coming team will bring its unique personality and skills set to provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities.

We value strong work ethics, knowledge sharing and flexibility in our way of working – it is both our promise to you and what we look for in new colleagues.

Let's meet!
