title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Senior Backend Developer to join our engineering team and take ownership of designing, building, and evolving scalable backend systems.


You will work primarily with Java and Spring Boot, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate closely with product, frontend, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable and maintainable software.


We expect senior engineers not only to write high-quality code, but also to understand the systems they build end-to-end, make sound technical decisions, improve engineering practices, and make effective use of modern AI and agentic development tools.



Key Responsibilities



  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable backend services using Java and the Spring ecosystem.

  • Take ownership of backend features and services from technical design through production operation.

  • Contribute to system architecture, API design, data models, and technical decision-making.

  • Design reliable integrations with internal and external systems and services.

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and continuously improve existing codebases through thoughtful refactoring.

  • Build and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, and API-level tests.

  • Review code and technical designs, provide constructive feedback, and mentor less experienced developers.

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues using logs, metrics, traces, and other observability tools.

  • Improve system performance, scalability, reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate closely with frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders.

  • Use modern AI-assisted and agentic development tools effectively for tasks such as implementation, refactoring, codebase exploration, testing, debugging, documentation, and technical analysis.

  • Review and validate AI-generated code and solutions with the same engineering rigor applied to human-written code.

  • Continuously evaluate new development tools and practices that can improve engineering quality and team productivity.



Required Qualifications



  • 6+ years of professional software development experience, with substantial experience building backend systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Java and a solid understanding of object-oriented design, clean code principles, and common software design patterns.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot and relevant Spring technologies such as Spring Data and Spring MVC.

  • Solid experience with JPA/Hibernate or similar persistence technologies.

  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design, HTTP, authentication, authorization, and integration patterns.

  • Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL or similar production-grade database systems.

  • Good understanding of transactions, concurrency, database performance, and data modeling.

  • Experience designing and operating production backend systems with attention to performance, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance.

  • Practical experience with automated testing using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, and integration-testing frameworks.

  • Strong proficiency with Git and modern collaborative development workflows based on branches, pull requests, and code reviews.

  • Comfortable working with Linux-based environments and command-line tools.

  • Experience investigating production problems using logging, monitoring, metrics, and tracing.

  • Ability to understand an existing codebase, identify architectural and technical issues, and propose pragmatic improvements.

  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools as part of the software development lifecycle.

  • Ability to critically review, test, and validate AI-generated implementations rather than relying on generated output without verification.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to work effectively in a fast-moving product development environment.



Preferred Qualifications



  • Experience designing distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or similar container and orchestration technologies.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.

  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools.

  • Experience with build and dependency management tools such as Maven.

  • Familiarity with observability platforms and concepts including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting.

  • Understanding of application and API security principles.

  • Experience with caching technologies such as Redis.

  • Experience working with high-volume or data-intensive backend systems.

  • Familiarity with LLM APIs, tool/function calling, MCP, agentic workflows, or AI-enabled backend applications is a plus.

  • Experience improving engineering workflows using AI-assisted development, automated code review, or agent-driven testing is a plus.



What We Value



  • Take ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

  • Think about the system as a whole rather than only the code they are currently working on.

  • Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

  • Can balance engineering quality with the need to deliver.

  • Question assumptions and contribute constructively to technical decisions.

  • Use AI and automation to increase productivity while maintaining responsibility for the quality of the final result.

  • Enjoy learning new technologies and adapting their development practices as software engineering evolves.

title: Kokoaikainen toimistosiivooja
description:

Työvuorosi ovat ma-pe klo 6-14 tai 7-15. Tämä työsuhde on kokoaikainen (37,5 h/vk) ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.
Tehtävästä maksetaan Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 2 mukaista palkkaa (12,59 €/h) sekä mahdolliset lisät.

ISS on paikka juuri sinulle! Meillä saat
- paikan, jossa voit kasvaa: meillä voit rakentaa oman urapolkusi ja hyödyntää monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksiamme.
- työyhteisön, jossa arvostamme monimuotoisuutta sen kaikissa merkityksissä, meidän tiimissämme voit olla oma itsesi.
- vakaan ja luotettavan työpaikan, jossa voit luottaa siihen, että palkkasi maksetaan oikein ja ajallaan. Erityisiä onnistumisia huomioimme ISS-palkitsemisohjelman mukaisesti.
- laadukkaat työterveyshuollon palvelut ja työhyvinvointiohjelmat.
- turvalliset työolosuhteet: suojavarusteet, työvaatteet, perehdytyksen työtehtäviin, ennakoivaan turvallisuuskulttuuriin ja säännölliset turvavartit.
- liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun vapaa-ajallesi.


Meillä viihdytään, koska täällä voi kasvaa, vaikuttaa ja onnistua. Tutustu taitaviin tekijöihimme: ISS töISSä

Sinulta me odotamme
- aiempaa kokemusta toimitilasiivouksesta vähintään 1 vuoden ajalta. Alan koulutuksen katsomme eduksesi.
- sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa. Suomen kielen taidon katsomme eduksesi.
- erinomaista palveluasennetta sekä ymmärrystä edustustason siivouksen ja palvelukulttuurin velvoitteista ja vaatimuksista.
- joustavuutta sekä oma-aloitteista ja tarkkaa työskentelytapaa.
- hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, sillä työpäivän aikana liikutaan paljon.


Tärkeissä paikoissa tarvitaan taitavimmat tekijät. Tule meille rakentamaan omaa ISS urapolkuasi ja tekemään kanssamme tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!
Täytä hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta viimeistään 6.10.! Voit kertoa osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi joko liittämällä hakemukseesi cv:n tai kirjoittamalla tiedot hakulomakkeen tekstikenttään. Käsittelemme kaikki hakemukset ja kerromme jokaiselle hakijalle prosessin etenemisestä.

Me, ISS Suomi, olemme osa maailman johtavaa kiinteistö- ja toimitilapalveluyhtiötä, joka toimii yli 30 maassa. Suomessa meitä ISS:läisiä on yli 7 000 ja toimimme valtakunnallisesti. Toimintamme tarkoituksena on luoda tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla. Luomme näitä tiloja siivous-, kiinteistö-, ravintola- ja työpaikkapalveluillamme. Siivous on palvelualoistamme suurin. Olemme luoneet puhtaita ja siten turvallisia, viihtyisiä ja tuottavia tiloja yli 100 vuoden ajan. Nykyisin siivoamme yhä useammissa kohteissamme kemikaalivapaasti, moderneja siivouskoneita käyttäen. Työparinasi saattaa olla robotti!

title: Transport Planner
description:
Due to continued growth, we are looking for a Network Transport Planner to help shape smarter, practical transport plans across our operational network. Using Solera Omnitracs Roadnet and other digital tools, you will maintain reliable planning data, build and test routes, and turn information into improvements for customers, drivers and site teams.
You do not need to be a transport expert from day one. We are looking for someone who understands systems and technology, enjoys solving problems and is motivated to learn.
This role will involve travel across our National Operational sites.

What are you responsible for

  • Learning and using Solera Omnitracs Roadnet to support daily, weekly and forward transport planning.
  • Maintaining accurate customer, location, driver, vehicle and route data, including geocodes, service times, service windows and vehicle capacities.
  • Using Excel, CSV files and agreed system processes to validate data, investigate errors and support reliable imports and reporting.
  • Building and reviewing practical route plans that balance customer requirements, available resources, operating constraints and cost.
  • Comparing planned and actual mileage, travel time, service time and route duration to improve future plans.
  • Working with site teams to understand how routes operate in practice and ensure system information reflects real conditions.
  • Travelling regularly to operational sites to observe processes, validate data, support users and help embed consistent ways of working.
  • Identifying opportunities to reduce unnecessary mileage, empty running, overtime and avoidable third-party transport use.
  • Supporting system testing, user adoption and continuous-improvement activity with operational colleagues, IT and system providers.
  • Producing plans within agreed legal, safety and company requirements and escalating risks through the appropriate process.

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • Previous experience in a Transport Planner, Logistics Coordinator or similar transport operations role.
  • Experience using transport management systems (TMS) and route planning software.
  • Experience working within a fast-paced logistics or distribution environment.

Knowledge

  • A strong understanding of systems and technology, with the confidence to learn new platforms.
  • Comfortable working with structured data, spreadsheets and digital tools, and understands the importance of data accuracy.
  • Transport-planning or compliance knowledge is desirable and can be developed in the role.

Skills

  • Logical, analytical and confident when investigating problems.
  • Good Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, lookups and basic data analysis.
  • Accurate and organised, with the ability to manage priorities and follow issues through.
  • Clear communicator who can work effectively with operational, technical and management teams.
  • Able to work independently, while asking questions and escalating when appropriate.

Personal Attributes

  • Customer-focused and results-driven.
  • Able to remain calm under pressure and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Proactive with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Strong team player with the ability to work independently when required.

title: Sviluppatore Full Stack
description:
Job skill profile: Programmatore Full Stack

Capacità di sviluppo autonoma e documentazione di progetto



Tutte le competenze, le qualifiche e l'esperienza necessarie per un candidato di successo sono elencate nella seguente descrizione.

OBIETTIVO DEL RUOLO

Il Programmatore Full Stack è responsabile della progettazione, dello sviluppo e della manutenzione di applicazioni web end-to-end. Opera con elevata autonomia su entrambi i livelli applicativi — frontend e backend — garantendo la qualità del codice, il rispetto delle scadenze e la produzione sistematica di documentazione tecnica e di progetto. Rappresenta un punto di riferimento tecnico all'interno del team, contribuendo attivamente alle decisioni architetturali.

Anni di esperienza: Minimo 3 anni

Conoscenza Stack: Minimo 2 stack

Autonomia operativa: Media-Alta

Redazione Documentazione: Livello di autonomi buona



COMPETENZE TECNICHE RICHIESTE

Frontend – Framework UI: React, Vue.Js, Angular Avanzato

Frontend – Stile e Layout: HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind, SCSS Avanzato

Backend – Linguaggi: Node.Js, Python, Java / C# Avanzato

Backend – API REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI / Swagger Avanzato

Database - PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis Avanzato

Cloud & DevOps - Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub) Avanzato

Versionamento: Git, GitFlow, code review Esperto

Sicurezza applicativa: OWASP Top 10, JWT, OAuth 2.0 Avanzato

Testing: Unit, Integration, E2E (Jest, Cypress) Avanzato

CAPACITÀ DI LAVORO IN AUTONOMIA

La piena autonomia operativa è un requisito fondamentale del ruolo. Il candidato deve dimostrare la capacità di:

Analizzare i requisiti funzionali e tecnici in modo indipendente, traducendoli in soluzioni architetturali coerenti.

Stimare effort e gestire il proprio backlog senza supervisione continua, rispettando le deadline concordate.

Individuare, diagnosticare e risolvere anomalie su stack complessi (frontend, backend, DB, infrastruttura) in autonomia.

Proporre miglioramenti tecnici, refactoring e ottimizzazioni delle prestazioni senza attendere input espliciti.

Interfacciarsi con gli stakeholder non tecnici per raccogliere le esigenze e tradurle in specifiche implementative.

Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita di una feature: analisi → sviluppo → test → deploy → monitoraggio.

Operare efficacemente sia in contesti di lavoro remoto sia in quelli ibridi, mantenendo alta la produttività.


CAPACITÀ DI REDAZIONE DOCUMENTAZIONE DI PROGETTO

La produzione di documentazione tecnica è considerata parte integrante del processo di sviluppo, non un'attività accessoria. Il candidato è tenuto a redigere e mantenere aggiornati i seguenti artefatti documentali:


Documentazione Tecnica

README completo di progetto: scopo, prerequisiti, istruzioni di setup, configurazione degli ambienti.

Architettura del sistema: diagrammi C4 o UML (componenti, sequenze, deployment), scelte tecnologiche motivate.

API Reference: specifica OpenAPI/Swagger di tutti gli endpoint, con esempi di request/response e codici di errore.

Guida alla configurazione: variabili d'ambiente, secrets management, dipendenze esterne.

Runbook operativo: procedure di deploy, rollback, monitoraggio e gestione degli alert.


Documentazione di Processo e Progetto

Analisi funzionale e specifiche tecniche: traduzione dei requisiti di business in documentazione strutturata.

Decisional log (ADR – Architecture Decision Records): tracciamento delle motivazioni delle scelte architetturali nel tempo.

Changelog strutturato: tracciamento delle versioni secondo lo standard Semantic Versioning (SemVer).

Post-mortem e incident report: documentazione degli eventi critici con root cause analysis e action items. xysqume

Knowledge base interna: guide, how-to, FAQ per il trasferimento di conoscenza al team.

Gestione proattiva delle priorità e delle aspettative


Approccio al lavoro

Problem solving strutturato e analitico

Cultura del continuous improvement e del feedback

Apprendimento continuo e aggiornamento tecnologico

description:

About Arden University:

We are an aspirational and multi-award-winning university, delivering rapid growth with ambitious plans to disrupt the HE sector through our passion for innovation and digital education. Our vision is to become the first-choice university for career-focused lifelong learners worldwide, ensuring that everyone, everywhere can access higher education, by leading the thoughtful integration of AI into teaching and learning and equipping our students to thrive in an AI-enabled world.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines, forge worldwide partnerships, and expand our locations.

About our Department:

The Analysis, Insights & Performance team plays a key role in shaping how Arden University uses data to make smarter decisions, improve performance and deliver better outcomes for our students. As the University continues to grow and expand globally, the team is at the forefront of turning data into meaningful insight and driving positive change across the organisation.

We're also embarking on an ambitious AI transformation, creating exciting opportunities to develop new data capabilities, unlock greater value from our information, and support innovative ways of working.

Joining the team means being part of a forward-thinking environment where data, technology and innovation come together to shape the future of Arden University.

About the Opportunity:

As a Geospatial Data Engineer within Arden University’s Data Practice, you’ll play a key role in designing, developing and delivering high-quality geospatial data pipelines and features that support evidence-based decision-making across the University.

Working closely with the Data Product Lead and Lead Engineer, you’ll take technical ownership of geospatial data curation and GIS-based analysis, developing reliable and scalable solutions that enable geospatial data to be efficiently managed, integrated and made accessible for analytical and decision-making purposes.

You’ll collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, analysts and business teams to ensure geospatial data flows effectively through our data environment and supports the development of valuable data products. You’ll have the opportunity to apply your technical expertise to large-scale datasets and help shape how geospatial information is used across the University.

While geospatial data engineering will be your primary focus, you’ll also contribute to wider data engineering priorities where required, including data governance, data quality and operational support. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing data practice and help develop robust, data-driven solutions that have a meaningful impact across Arden University.

About You:

Essential requirements:

  • Relevant degree or qualification, or equivalent professional experience, with strong competencies in geospatial data engineering and analysis.

  • Extensive relevant professional experience demonstrating broad and/or specialist knowledge of geospatial engineering and analysis.

  • Proven experience processing, cleansing and preparing geospatial data to ensure it is suitable for GIS production and analytical use.

  • Demonstrable experience using ArcGIS, QGIS or other GIS software, with a strong understanding of core GIS concepts including coordinate systems, projections, spatial joins, catchment analysis and network analysis.

  • Demonstrable experience using geospatial data and analytics to create business value and contribute to the development of data products.

  • Ability to communicate geospatial insights clearly and effectively to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with big data technologies and data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and Snowflake.

  • Experience programming with Python, R and/or SQL.

  • Good understanding of modern data engineering principles, practices and patterns.

  • Experience with version control (Git), code reviews, testing, CI/CD and deployment practices.

Desirable requirements:

  • Experience in the use of data and analytics tooling within Microsoft Fabric.

  • Experience with agile project management processes such as Scrum.

  • Experience in location planning methodologies including network location planning and catchment creation and analysis.

  • Knowledge of data science methodologies within geospatial fields e.g. gravity modelling, catchment prediction.

Why Arden:

At Arden, you will become a part of a passionate and dedicated team who are committed to removing unnecessary barriers to learning and making education more accessible. Our people work hard to ensure our students journeys are the best they can possibly be, as such we want to reward our people with fantastic benefits. Employees benefit from:

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines and locations.

title: Trainee Advocate
description:
Location: Field Based – County DurhamContract: Permanent, Part Time – 31.5 HoursSalary: £22,090.42DBS Check: Enhanced with Adults
At Rethink Mental Illness, we believe everyone deserves to have their voice heard. As a Trainee Advocate, you'll support people to understand their rights, express their views and take part in decisions that affect their lives, while gaining a nationally recognised qualification and developing a rewarding career in advocacy.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about empowering others and wants to develop specialist skills in independent advocacy.
About the role
As a Trainee Advocate, you'll begin your journey by working towards the Level 4 Independent Advocacy Practice Qualification, with dedicated study time and support from experienced colleagues. You'll learn through a combination of formal training, shadowing opportunities and hands-on experience, gradually building the confidence and knowledge needed to manage your own caseload.
You will provide non-statutory independent advocacy within the community or care settings for people affected by mental illness who are accessing or trying to access mental health services. This may include secure facilities, hospitals, care homes, supported living facilities and people within their own homes or temporary accommodation.
As a field worker, you will be based at home and will manage your own calendar, planning in client visits effectively as well all administrative tasks.
You will work across County Durham and therefore will need to have the ability to travel between multiple client appointment locations across the day, as well as travel to team meetings and training sessions as required.
No previous advocacy qualification is required. We're looking for people with the right values, transferable skills and a genuine commitment to helping others have their voices heard.
What you'll be doing
You'll learn how to:

Support people to understand their rights, choices and options.
Ensure people's views, wishes and preferences are represented.
Deliver both instructed and non-instructed advocacy.
Work within key legislation and advocacy frameworks.
Manage your own caseload and maintain accurate records.
Identify and respond appropriately to safeguarding concerns.
Promote advocacy services across local communities and professional networks.
Help people develop the confidence and skills to advocate for themselves wherever possible.

What we're looking for
You don't need previous advocacy experience, but you'll bring:

A passion for supporting and empowering people.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
The ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
A person-centred and non-judgemental approach.
Good IT and administrative skills.
A willingness to undertake the Level 4 Independent Advocacy Practice qualification and associated development modules.
The ability to travel across County Durham and occasionally elsewhere for training and work-related activities.

Experience gained through work, volunteering, caring responsibilities or lived experience will all be valued.
What you'll gain
This role is more than a job. It's a career pathway.
We'll provide:

Full training and development support.
Dedicated study time to complete your qualification.
Regular supervision and reflective practice sessions.
The opportunity to work alongside experienced advocates.
A structured route into a qualified Advocate position upon successful completion of your qualification.

We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Manual QA Tester – (India)
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented Manual QA Tester to execute frontend test operations with precision and consistency. This role sits at the client-facing UI layer of a complex web onboarding workflow and is responsible for validating form behavior, field-level validation logic, and error handling across browsers — all while following defined test runbooks and maintaining accurate, well-documented evidence of every defect or error state encountered.
The primary assignment is to execute structured walkthroughs across representative onboarding personas and document the observed frontend constraints that will become inputs to downstream FSM/state-model analysis and evidence set.

The ideal candidate thrives on process discipline and has a sharp eye for visual and functional inconsistencies in data-entry-heavy web applications.

Project Details

Title: Manual QA Tester - (India)

Rate: $3.5/hr

Start Date: 19th October

Duration: 3 Weeks

Commitment: 40 Hours per Week

Location: India (Remote)

Job Type: Freelance (with the possibility of full time employment based on performance and project needs in all opportunity)

Responsibilities

  1. Execute test cases strictly in accordance with documented test runbooks, ensuring no steps are skipped or altered without approval

  1. Perform cross-browser UI testing to validate layout, functionality, and boundary conditions across supported browsers and devices

  1. Validate client-side form field rules such as character-length limits, format/pattern (regex-style) validation, and required-field enforcement across form inputs (e.g., text fields, dropdowns, radio buttons)

  1. Verify UI state behavior driven by validation outcomes — for example, error banners appearing on malformed input, or action buttons remaining disabled until all fields pass validation

  1. Identify, capture, and log DOM-level screenshots and error states with clear, reproducible documentation

  1. Track and report test execution status, flagging deviations from expected runbook outcomes

  1. Maintain organized records of test evidence (screenshots, logs, error traces) for defect tracking and audit purposes

  1. Escalate boundary and edge-case UI failures to senior QA or development teams with sufficient supporting detail

  1. Collaborate with QA leads to refine and update test runbooks based on recurring issues or coverage gaps

  1. Execute structured walkthroughs across the defined onboarding personas.

  1. Document observed UI constraints, field limits, regex/pattern behaviour, conditional states, error states, and decision points.

  1. Consolidate findings into a structured frontend constraint dictionary and evidence set for downstream FSM validation.

  1. Maintain traceability between each observed behaviour, persona, test step, and captured evidence.

Required Qualifications

  1. Proven experience in manual QA testing, preferably in a frontend/UI-focused environment involving multi-field forms

  1. Demonstrated ability to strictly follow and execute structured test runbooks

  1. Hands-on experience with cross-browser testing tools and techniques (e.g., BrowserStack, native browser dev tools)

  1. Working knowledge of DOM structure and browser developer tools for inspecting and capturing error states

  1. Familiarity with client-side validation concepts (field length limits, format/regex validation, conditional UI states)

  1. Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation habits

  1. Basic understanding of UI/UX boundary conditions and how they manifest as defects

  1. Good written communication skills for clear, reproducible bug reporting

  1. Ability to produce structured evidence that can be reviewed and reused by senior QA/SDET resources.

  1. Experience testing complex onboarding, registration, account-creation, or other multi-step workflows is preferred.

title: Territory Partner
description:
Territory Partner
Own relationships. Drive performance. Help transform healthcare.



Location: TBC Hybrid (2 Days in the Cardiff Hub)
Salary: Up to £30,000 plus Performance Bonus
Hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours per week between 8am and 6pm


Build relationships. Solve workforce challenges. Make a real difference.



Healthcare is changing, and so are we.




At Newcross Healthcare, we're transforming the way healthcare organisations access, manage and retain their workforce. By combining over 30 years of healthcare expertise with market-leading technology, AI-powered insights and innovative workforce solutions, we're helping our clients deliver outstanding care across the UK.




This isn't about filling shifts.
It's about building trusted partnerships, understanding workforce challenges and creating smarter, more sustainable solutions that help healthcare organisations thrive.




We're looking for a Territory Partner to take ownership of a portfolio of clients, becoming their trusted advisor and helping them achieve better workforce outcomes. If you enjoy building relationships, solving problems and making a measurable impact, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.



A role with real ownership


As a Territory Partner, you'll take responsibility for a dedicated portfolio of healthcare clients, building strong, long-term relationships and becoming the person they rely on when they need support, advice or solutions.




You'll develop a deep understanding of each organisation, learning about their services, workforce challenges and future ambitions. Using those insights, you'll work proactively to ensure they have access to the right healthcare professionals at the right time, helping them deliver safe, high-quality care.
You'll also build strong relationships with the healthcare professionals who support your territory, understanding their skills, experience and career aspirations to connect them with opportunities where they can make the greatest impact.
This is far more than a traditional recruitment or customer service role.




It combines the best aspects of account management, workforce planning, relationship management, operational problem-solving and commercial development into one rewarding career.
Supported by specialist teams across Recruitment, Compliance, Workforce Engagement, Operations and Technology, you'll have the tools, expertise and AI-powered systems needed to spend less time on administration and more time building relationships, solving problems and delivering results.
If you enjoy taking ownership, making decisions and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll thrive in this role.



What you'll be responsible for
Building trusted partnerships

  • Developing strong, long-lasting relationships with healthcare organisations across your territory.
  • Becoming the first point of contact for your clients, providing expert advice and responsive support.
  • Understanding each client's workforce challenges, priorities and future plans.
  • Building confidence through consistent delivery and exceptional service.

Driving workforce performance

  • Planning and coordinating workforce solutions that meet client demand.
  • Improving fill rates, workforce utilisation and service performance.
  • Identifying opportunities to strengthen client retention and grow your territory.
  • Using CRM systems, performance data and business insights to make informed decisions.

Delivering solutions

  • Working collaboratively with internal specialist teams to achieve the best outcomes.
  • Resolving service challenges quickly and professionally.
  • Matching healthcare professionals with opportunities that align with their skills, experience and availability.
  • Following through on commitments and ensuring every issue reaches a successful conclusion.

Growing your territory


You'll have genuine ownership of your territory and the opportunity to influence its long-term success.
Your performance bonus will recognise the difference you make through strong client relationships, improved workforce performance, sustainable growth and the positive outcomes you deliver for both clients and healthcare professionals.



Why Newcross?

At Newcross, our people make the difference. We live our values every day, working together to deliver outstanding service for our clients and meaningful opportunities for our healthcare professionals.


As a Territory Partner, you'll play a vital role in helping clients succeed, supporting our workforce, and contributing to better healthcare outcomes across your region.
If you're ready to make an impact in a role where relationships, service, and success come together, we'd love to welcome you to Newcross.

We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they have the opportunity to contribute.

description:

JOB SUMMARY:

While training for advancement and certification in the Fire Department, the Firefighter/EMT I actively participates in fire suppression, rescue, emergency medical operations, and all duties associated therein, assuring that fire stations and equipment are ready for emergency and non-emergency situations.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responds to emergency calls including but not limited to fire suppression, salvage, overhaul, search and rescue, and pre-hospital emergency medical care, implementing actions necessary to save lives and property, assists Fire Marshal’s office in searching for evidence at suspicious fire scenes. Follows established safety procedures to achieve maximum benefits with the least risk of injury to firefighters or the public.

Maintains fire/emergency medical equipment and apparatus, assures that all equipment is functioning properly, checks communication equipment each morning, and reports all equipment malfunctions or missing supplies immediately to the officer in charge.

Conducts triage of multiple casualty incidents, determines severity of injuries, immobilizes patients, provided emergency medical care, transports patients to appropriate health care facility.

Assists in pre-fire planning, completes department forms and reports, and assists in instructing fire safety, prevention, and emergency medical care programs to the public.

Keeps station grounds clean and neat, cuts grass, paints where needed, cleans and maintains fire stations.

Learns the geography, roads, alternative routes, fire hydrant locations, and hospitals within the jurisdiction.

Participates in continuing education, training, and drills to maintain certifications.

Maintains health and physical strength required to complete job responsibilities.

Regular and predictable attendance is required.

Performs other related duties as required.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

High School Diploma or G.E.D.

No experience required

Must meet state firefighting minimum standards

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS:

GA. Basic Firefighter certification within 12 months, NPQ FF II certification within 24 months.

NREMT-A certification within 24 months.

Valid class C driver’s license, must obtain valid class F within 6 months of hire.

Must meet all in-house testing requirements.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Firefighting principles and techniques

Rescue principles and techniques

Emergency medical treatment and life support procedures

Symptoms of illness and traumatic injuries

Local geography, streets, roads, and hospitals

Department’s rules and regulations

Department’s standard operating procedures

Civil Service rules and regulations

State laws and local codes related to Fire & EMS

Oral and Written communication skills

Perform strenuous work under adverse conditions for a sustained period of time

Reacts calmly and quickly in emergency situations

ADA MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Physical Ability: Essential functions continuously require the ability to remain in a stationary position (sitting or standing); to move about by walking; move oneself by crawling on hands and knees; ascend and descend ladders, stairs, and ramps; maintain body equilibrium to prevent failing when walking, standing, crouching or navigating narrow, slippery or erratically moving surfaces; bend body downward and forward by bending spine and legs, twisting at the waist, hips or knees; and move about on hands and knees and feet; move/transport items over 100lbs. Incumbents constantly must think analytically; handle stress and emotion, concentrate on tasks, remember names and other details; examine and observe details; make decisions, and adjust to change. Additionally the essential functions require that incumbents be on-call and work irregular hours; attend regular work meetings and trainings;, handle confidential information, direct others; meet deadlines; operate equipment; use a computer/keyboard; use math/calculations; and stay organized.

Sensory Requirements: Essential Functions require the ability to use effective verbal and written communication; use of hand/eye coordination and fine manipulation to use tools and equipment; visually discern differences in color.

Environmental Factors: Essential functions are continuously performed with exposure to adverse environmental conditions, including inclement weather; extreme hot or cold temperatures; humidity and moisture; possible bodily injury from hazards including biological, chemical, sharp objects/tools, heavy machinery, traffic; falling from high or exposed places, and falling objects; constricted spaces; moving mechanical parts of equipment, tools, and machinery; fumes, gasses, odors, dust, grease, oil and mud; wet or slippery floors or surfaces and excessive noise. Incumbents will be required to work alone or with others continuously.

Additionally, essential functions are frequently performed with exposure to bodily injury from electrical or radiation hazards.

Essential functions may also require occasional exposure to extreme dry environments and hot temperatures from flame torches.

This class specification should not be interpreted as all-inclusive. It is intended to identify the major responsibilities and requirements of this job. The incumbents may be requested to perform job-related responsibilities and tasks other than those stated in this specification.

description:

  • Liaise and coordinate with external vendors in carrying out calibration / maintenance of lab equipment when necessary
  • Participate in new / existing analytical method transfer / validation and equipment qualification for the drug related testing and finished product release and ensure compliance toward Pharma GMP requirements
  • Write and develop protocol to support method transfer / validation, compendia method verification and equipment qualification when necessary

  • Manage laboratory investigation reports, analytical instrument qualification/calibration, test method validation, and maintain procedures to ensure up-to-date compliance.

Requirements

  • Good knowledge in GLP and analytical test methods.

  • Strong Interpersonal and communication skill and possess positive attribute
  • Ability to adopt to the fast-pace and high pressure laboratory environment

title: Ope+ liikuntapäiväkoti Pilke Hohtoon
description:
Pilke ohjaa lapsia lempeästi opintielle. Meillä varhaiskasvatukseen kuuluu leikin kautta oppiminen ja lempeä vuorovaikutus. Me näemme ja tunnistamme jokaisen lapsen ainutlaatuiset kyvyt ja tuemme hänen vahvuuksiaan. Pilkkeen tavoitteena on olla Suomessa varhaiskasvatuksen toimialan paras. Tämä tavoite saavutetaan työskentelemällä yhdessä.



Etsimme nyt varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa Ope+ tehtävään Pilke liikuntapäiväkoti Hohtoon Vantaan Kivistöön. Työ alkaa tammikuussa 2027.



Pilke Hohto on hyvien kulkuyhteyksien päässä sijaitseva päiväkoti, joka aukesi elokuussa 2018. Päiväkodissamme on liikuntapainotus, jonka tavoitteena on tukea lapsen fyysistä aktiivisuutta päiväkodin arjessa, vahvistaa lapsen kiinnostusta liikuntaan ja liikunnalliseen elämäntapaan, sekä opettaa lapselle terveellistä ja turvallista suhtautumista omaan kehoon ja ympäristöönsä.

Päiväkoti Hohdon ilmapiiri on turvallinen, lämmin ja välitön. Pidämme tärkeänä lasten kiireetöntä, yksilöllistä kohtaamista, kuuntelua sekä syliä, läheisyyttä ja hyvää mieltä. Olemme aidosti läsnä lapsille ja toisillemme. Kasvattajillamme on hyvä yhteishenki, mikä heijastuu lapsiin ja luo päiväkotiin lempeän tunnelman. Meille tarkeaa on luoda lapsille sellainen arki, jossa on lupa ilmaista kaikkia tunteita ja kokea olonsa turvalliseksi jokaisena päivänä.



Haluatko työlläsi vaikuttaa koko yksikön pedagogiikkaan, monen lapsen elämään ja varhaisiin vuosiin?



Uudessa Ope+ tehtävässä työskentelet varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana ryhmässä, lisäksi vastuullasi on koko yksikköä koskevia pedagogisia kehitystehtäviä.



Ope+ roolissa varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana tuet ja edistät lasten kasvua, kehitystä ja oppimista. Hallitset varhaiskasvatussuunnitelmien sisällöt ja osaat toteuttaa niitä käytännössä.

Suunnittelet, arvioit ja kehität yksikön/koko päiväkodin pedagogista toimintaa ja vastaat laadukkaan pedagogiikan toteutumisesta yksikössäsi yhdessä johtamistiimin kanssa. Sinulla on vahva pedagoginen työote, myönteinen ja aktiivinen asenne, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky kohdata lapset aidosti.

Talossamme työskentelee myös toinen opettaja Ope+ roolissa, joten saat jakaa työtehtäviäsi toisen ammattilaisen kanssa.



Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Uuden Ope+ roolin, jota pääset kehittämään yhdessä varhaiskasvatuksen asiantuntijoiden kanssa,

- kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään,

- kilpailukykyisen kuukausipalkan n. 3500-3850€ (sis. kuukausipalkka + kiinteä lisä + kokemusvuodet + tavoitteisiin sidotun projektibonuksen neljännesvuosittain),

- Tarjoamme tukea kouluttautumiseen ja pätevöitymiseen 2030 kelpoisuusvaatimusten mukaisesti,

- sydänkulttuurin mukaisen yrityskulttuurin,

- tukea ja aikaa kehittämis- ja suunnittelutyöhön,

- työtä tukevat oppimisympäristöt ja työvälineet,

- vaikuttamismahdollisuuksia varhaiskasvatuksen käytäntöihin ja toimintakulttuuriin,

- innostavan, ketterän ja lämpimän työn lapsiryhmässä, jossa aidosti arvostetaan varhaiskasvatuksen ammattitaitoa,

- monipuolisia koulutus- ja oppimismahdollisuuksia sekä erilaisia urapolkuja, myös kansainvälisesti,

- mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen verkostoitumiseen kotimaassa sekä Suomen rajojen ulkopuolella sekä

- monipuolisia työsuhde-etuja, kuten hyvät työterveyspalvelut sekä työsuhdepolkupyöräetu, hierontaetu sekä liikunta- ja kulttuurietu sekä joustavat vuosilomakäytännöt. Katso lisää [täältä](https://www.pilkepaivakodit.fi/pilkelaisten-tyosuhde-edut/).



Työhön valitulta henkilöltä vaaditaan varhaiskasvatuslain mukainen kelpoisuus varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan tehtävään sekä voimassa olevan rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä.



Kiinnostuitko?

Hae tehtävään lähettämällä hakemus viimeistään 18.10.2026



Haluaisitko tietää lisää Pilkkeestä ja tavastamme toimia?



Lempeyden voima ei ole vain Pilke-päiväkotien slogan – se kertoo meidän tavastamme tehdä töitä ja kohdata lapsia ja aikuisia. [Lue lisää siitä, mitä lempeyden voima meille pilkeläisille tarkoittaa.](https://pilkepaivakodit.fi/lempeys/)

- [Pilke työnantajana](https://www.pilkepaivakodit.fi/pilke-tyonantajana/)

- [Pilkkeen varhaiskasvatus](https://pilkepaivakodit.fi/tag/varhaiskasvatus/)


Pilke Hohto liikuntapäiväkoti

Pilkkeellä lasten oppimista ja kasvua tuetaan ja luodaan aktiivisuudella, ammatillisuudella, pedagogisella osaamisella, lapsen osallisuudesta huolehtimisella, muokkautuvilla oppimisympäristöillä sekä kannustavalla ja motivoivalla ilmapiirillä. Me olemme Suomen suurin yksityinen päiväkotiketju, ja päiväkodeissamme, esikouluissamme ja iltapäiväkerhoissamme työskentelee yli 2 500 pilkeläistä ammattilaista ympäri Suomea.

title: System Engineer
description:
What we are looking for:

Nova Systems Group is looking for a Systems Engineer to join the Integrated Metrology team, a multidisciplinary group of physicists and engineers working together to implement cutting-edge metrology technologies in the semiconductor industry from a unique and innovative perspective.

The role combines theoretical and experimental system engineering and provides the opportunity to work on advanced multidisciplinary optical measurement products throughout their lifecycle, from customer needs and early development stages through integration, product transfer to manufacturing, and support at customer sites.

Role Responsibilities

What you will be doing:

  • Perform theoretical and experimental systems engineering to support state-of-the-art new and existing multidisciplinary optical measurement products.
  • Drive the full system lifecycle, from understanding customer needs through feasibility and concept evaluation, translating them into cross-disciplinary system requirements, while defining and managing system KPIs.
  • Conduct laboratory and on-site system diagnostics, troubleshooting, and problem-solving, including root-cause analysis, mitigation plans, implementation of robust system calibration methods, and product transfer to manufacturing.
  • Work closely with multiple disciplines, including physics, optics, algorithms, mechanics, electronics, and software.
  • Translate customers’ high-level requirements into detailed technical specifications.
  • Support system integration, validation, and product maturity throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Travel to customer sites worldwide approximately 2-3 times per year.


Requirements

  • B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Engineering, such as Electronics, Electro-Optics, Optics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in multidisciplinary system engineering or an equivalent role.
  • Hands-on experience with Python and/or MATLAB - must.
  • Experience working on complex multidisciplinary activities in project and matrix environments, managing parallel tasks and interfaces.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

That special something you bring in:

We are looking for a dedicated, hands-on, out-of-the-box thinker who enjoys solving complex multidisciplinary challenges and, most importantly, is a great team player.

Get to know us better:

Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) is a global company and a leading provider of innovative metrology solutions for process control in semiconductor manufacturing.

With a team of ~1200 people in three R&D centers and 27 field offices, we bring insights into the world’s most advanced industry. We leverage multiple technology fields such as physics, optics, chemistry, and algorithms to develop hardware and software solutions that measure almost every advanced computer chip built in the world.

Nova dives deep into dimensions and layers at the atomic level to extract unique insights and provide our customers with crucial decision-making data, managing critical challenges by providing unique, differentiated solutions.

Our outstanding people-focused and innovative culture means every person at Nova has the power to make an impact and significantly redefine what people can achieve through technology.

Join us if you are

A dreamer and brilliant high aimer who sees the impossible as the starting point and loves working in a multidisciplinary global team to create innovative breakthroughs.

If you need assistance due to a disability, you may contact us at talent@novami.com

Fuodix, perakende ve lojistik sektörlerinde MDM, WMS, B2B, Mağaza Asistanı, OMS, HR ve Sadakat Uygulaması gibi çözümler sunan, yenilikçi ve güvenilir bir yazılım şirketidir. Bu yetkinliklerle fark yaratabilirsiniz:

  • Google servisleri, Google Play Services ve Google API'leriyle entegrasyon deneyimine sahip olmak,

title: Campus Principal | Melton VIC
description:
We are seeking an experienced and inspiring Campus Principal to lead our welcoming Melton Campus and make a lasting impact on our students, staff and community.

The Campus
OneSchool Global Melton is a thriving and well-established campus serving students from Years 3 to 12, the campus provides a modern learning environment supported by innovative technology, highly engaged students and a strong sense of community.
Melton is known for its commitment to delivering outstanding educational outcomes through OneSchool Global's unique self-directed learning model. The campus enjoys strong partnerships with families and provides students with the skills, confidence and character needed to thrive in an ever-changing world.
This is an exceptional opportunity to lead a successful campus with strong foundations while shaping its future direction.

The Position
As Campus Principal, you will provide strategic, educational and operational leadership across all aspects of campus life, ensuring exceptional outcomes for students while fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Reporting within the regional leadership structure, you will lead a high-performing campus while contributing to broader organisational priorities across the OneSchool Global network. While responsible for the strategic leadership of the Melton Campus, you will also work collaboratively with regional and national leaders to advance educational excellence and organisational performance.

What makes this opportunity different:

Lead a high-performing Victorian campus within a global network spanning 20 countries.
Shape the educational experience of students while fostering a culture of excellence, accountability and continuous improvement.
Develop and empower future leaders across teaching and professional staff teams.
Work in partnership with experienced regional, national and global leaders.
Drive innovation through OneSchool Global's Learning to Learn Framework and technology-enabled learning environments.
Influence organisational improvement and best practice through collaboration across the wider network.
Operate within a highly collaborative leadership environment where relationships, partnership and influence are critical to success.

In this role you will be expected to:

Lead the overall strategic direction, performance and operations of the campus.
Champion the School's Ethos, Values and Guiding Principles, fostering a high-trust, high-expectation culture.
Provide exceptional instructional leadership to drive excellence in teaching, learning and curriculum delivery across Years 3 to 12.
Continue strengthening teaching quality and student outcomes within OneSchool Global's innovative learning model.
Build leadership capability across teaching and professional staff, developing future leaders across the organisation.
Lead campus improvement initiatives that strengthen people, systems and culture, creating sustainable improvement rather than leader-dependent success.
Use data, evidence and strategic insight to improve student achievement, engagement, wellbeing and attendance.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Maintain strong governance, compliance, safeguarding and risk management practices.
Partner with central support functions to effectively manage budgets, resources and workforce planning.
Build trusted relationships with students, families, staff and broader stakeholders.
Balance campus priorities with regional and national strategic objectives.
Represent Melton Campus within the wider OneSchool Global network, contributing to regional, national and global initiatives while sharing best practice and driving continuous improvement.

Skills and Experience
The successful candidate will be an accomplished educational executive with substantial leadership experience within a school environment. They will demonstrate a strong track record of improving student outcomes, developing high-performing teams, leading organisational improvement and building cultures of excellence through people, systems and strategic leadership.

You will also bring:

Significant executive leadership experience within a school or educational environment.
A proven ability to improve student outcomes through high-quality teaching and learning.
Demonstrated success leading organisational improvement through people, systems and culture.
Experience developing high-performing leadership teams and building leadership capability in others.
Strong strategic, operational and financial leadership capability.
A successful track record of leading through influence rather than hierarchy.
Experience balancing local priorities with broader organisational objectives.
Strong stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to build credibility across diverse groups.
Experience operating within governance, compliance and safeguarding frameworks.
The ability to drive accountability, performance and continuous improvement.
A commitment to the values, ethos and educational philosophy of OneSchool Global.

Personal qualities that will enable success include:

Authentic and values-based leadership.
High levels of emotional intelligence, resilience and professional maturity.
Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills.
Strategic thinking combined with disciplined execution.
A genuine commitment to feedback, growth and continuous learning.
The ability to engage confidently with students, families, staff, governance groups and senior organisational leaders.

Why you'll love working with us
At OneSchool Global, we empower our leaders and educators to thrive and perform at their best. This role offers a rare opportunity to combine campus leadership with broader organisational influence while remaining connected to students, teaching and learning.
When you join us, you'll enjoy:

A market-competitive executive remuneration package.
The opportunity to lead a well-established and highly regarded Victorian campus within a globally connected educational organisation.
Strong organisational support, exceptional facilities and an engaged school community.
Great work-life balance with no after-school or weekend sporting commitments.
Small school communities supported by extensive national and global resources.
Access to the Global Teacher Academy and leadership development opportunities.
Pioneering educational technology and technology-enabled learning environments.
Highly engaged students with a strong culture of learning and achievement.
A collaborative network of experienced educational leaders across Australia and internationally.
A commitment to providing a safe and caring working and learning environment with a strong focus on safeguarding and wellbeing.

title: Team Lead Back Office
description:
Hoe ziet de rol van Team Lead Back Office eruit?

Als Team Lead Back Office speel je een cruciale en verbindende rol in het leiden van een team van 11 collega’s die de rol van Back Office medewerker vervullen. Deze medewerkers zijn verantwoordelijk voor het opvolgen van operationele inkoop- en salesprocessen in samenwerking met andere teams binnen de Customer Service Office. Jouw voornaamste verantwoordelijkheid is om ervoor te zorgen dat er op een effectieve en efficiënte manier wordt gewerkt.

Je zorgt voor de juiste ondersteuning, begeleiding en coaching van je teamleden ten aanzien van het optimaal bedienen van onze klanten. Door de planning te handhaven en processen te monitoren zorg je ervoor dat operationele activiteiten worden uitgevoerd volgens de standaard werkprocedures, in lijn met onze KPI’s en die van onze klanten. Hiervoor werk je nauw samen met alle afdelingen binnen MAG45. Jouw belangrijkste focus ligt op een hoge klant- en medewerkerstevredenheid welke bijdraagt aan het algemene succes van het team. Je legt verantwoording af aan de Manager Customer Service Office.

Als Team Lead Back Office ben je verantwoordelijk voor een breed scala aan taken, waaronder:

  • Dagelijkse aansturing, coaching en ontwikkeling van het Back Office team;

  • Bewaken van capaciteit, werkverdeling en operationele continuïteit;

  • Monitoren van KPI’s, processen en kwaliteit en tijdig bijsturen waar nodig;

  • Waarborgen van correcte uitvoering volgens standaard werkprocedures (SOP’s);

  • Ondersteunen bij escalaties, complexe en operationele vraagstukken;

  • Signaleren en realiseren van procesverbeteringen en efficiencyverbeteringen;

  • Bewaken van samenwerking en afspraken met andere afdelingen en leveranciers;

  • Waarborgen van een professionele, klantgerichte en gestructureerde werkomgeving.

Waarom zou je kiezen voor MAG45?

  • Een ambitieuze en sterk groeiende internationaal opererende organisatie die vanuit een unieke propositie dagelijks het verschil maakt op het gebied van integrated supply (logistieke dienstverlening);

  • Een organisatie met korte lijnen waar je de ruimte krijgt om jouw initiatieven te ontplooien;

  • Een afwisselende rol in een team van enthousiaste professionals;

  • Een open en informele werksfeer waarin je geregeld activiteiten georganiseerd worden voor het personeel;

  • Je bent creatief en beschikt over een innovatieve en ondernemende mindset en wil je verder ontwikkelen. Kortom: Do it better every day!


Een uitstekend arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket:

  • Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring, ontvang je maandelijks een aantrekkelijk salaris in de range van € 4.816 tot € 6.363 (gebaseerd op de cao Technische Groothandel);

  • Daarnaast secundaire voorwaarden met onder meer een 13e maand, 28 vakantiedagen en 8 ATV dagen en een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Aantrekkelijke extra voorwaarden zoals een gezonde lunch in ons bedrijfsrestaurant, de mogelijkheid om met korting te sporten en diverse trainingen en workshops te volgen middels onze eigen Academy.

Jouw kwalificaties als Team Lead Back Office:

  • Je hebt een hbo-opleiding afgerond en hebt affiniteit met techniek;

  • Je hebt ervaring in een complexe internationale handels- of productie omgeving;

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in een aansturende rol;

  • Je bent 40 uur per week beschikbaar en beheerst de Nederlandse én Engelse taal uitstekend;

  • Je bent zelfstartend, oplossingsgericht en assertief;

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en beschikt over analytisch vermogen;

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring in het werken met een ERP systeem en Microsoft Office;

  • Je houdt van de dynamiek van een internationale werkomgeving.

Overtuigd en interesse?

Als je klaar bent om de uitdaging aan te gaan als Team Lead Back Office, stuur dan je cv en motivatiebrief door op de knop "Solliciteer" te klikken. We kijken ernaar uit om je sollicitatie te ontvangen en de mogelijkheden voor jou om ons team te komen versterken te verkennen.

Heb je nog vragen of wil je meer informatie?
Neem dan contact op met Nicole van Maaren (HR Business Partner) via +31 6 49763796.
Het inwinnen van referenties, het doorlopen van een (digitaal) assessment en het aanvragen van een VOG zijn onderdeel van het sollicitatieproces.

title: PeopleSoft Integration Developer
description:
Peoplesoft Integration Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Peoplesoft Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced PeopleSoft Integration Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integrations connecting PeopleSoft applications to internal systems, cloud applications, and third-party platforms. This role focuses specifically on the integration layer, including service operations, queues, routings, transformations, security configurations, and error handling. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on Integration Broker experience with broader PeopleTools knowledge and a strong understanding of API and integration design patterns. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integration scenarios using PeopleSoft Integration Broker, including service operations, queues, routings, and handlers.
  • Build synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST and SOAP web services.
  • Develop transformations using XSLT, Application Engine, and PeopleCode handlers, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Configure security on inbound and outbound services, including WS-Security, OAuth2, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Build robust error-handling and retry mechanisms, including notifications, monitoring, and resubmission workflows.
  • Develop Component Interfaces and File Layouts to support hybrid integration scenarios.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations to standardized Integration Broker patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Optimize performance of high-volume integrations through queue tuning, parallel processing, and asynchronous design.
  • Integrate PeopleSoft with cloud applications (Oracle Cloud, Workday, ServiceNow) and middleware (OIC, MuleSoft, Boomi).
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with functional consultants and integration architects, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 12 or more years of PeopleSoft development experience, with a strong focus on Integration Broker.
  • Hands-on experience designing and developing REST and SOAP web services in PeopleSoft.
  • Solid PeopleCode and Application Engine experience.
  • Working knowledge of XML, XSLT, and JSON.
  • Experience with web service security standards (WS-Security, OAuth2).
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with the PeopleSoft data model.
  • Familiarity with middleware platforms (OIC, MuleSoft, Boomi) is a strong plus.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting PeopleSoft upgrades and patches.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to venkat.r@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer

title: NPI & Supply Chain Execution Specialist - APAC
company: CHAGEE SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT (SEA) PTE. LTD.
description:
Role Responsibilities

NPI Pipeline & Product Localization Coordination

  • Pipeline Visibility: Maintain regional end-to-end visibility of the APAC NPI and LTO pipeline, tracking upcoming launches, lead times, critical dependencies, and market readiness.
  • Regional Interface: Act as the operational liaison between product development teams and local APAC markets, translating market-specific consumer, commercial, and regulatory requirements into actionable product briefs.
  • Localization Proposals: Identify where global product formulations or packaging require localization for APAC markets (e.g., ingredient substitution, regulatory adjustments, packaging variation). Formulate data-driven proposals for stakeholders.
  • Pipeline Tracking: Maintain a structured status view (by stage, owner, risk, and target launch date per market); proactively flag potential timeline conflicts and capacity bottlenecks.

Launch Project Management & Critical Path Ownership

  • Critical Path Execution: Define and monitor the cross-functional critical path for each launch. Including spanning brief sign-off, ingredient/packaging procurement, sample approval, equipment readiness, regulatory clearance, and store delivery.
  • Stage-Gate Reviews: Facilitate structured launch reviews at defined milestones; track project progress, surface operational blockers, and coordinate resolution across functions.
  • Gatekeeper Governance: Enforce submission deadlines, approval gates, and escalation protocols to prevent late-stage scope changes from causing cost overruns or supply lead-time compression.
  • Process Standardization: Maintain and continuously update regional launch playbooks and checklists based on post-launch lessons learned.

Equipment Qualification & Rollout Coordination

  • Equipment Deployment: Coordinate the operational qualification and market rollout of new store equipment (brewers, printers, blenders, and related hardware), including testing alignment and phased market deployment.
  • Certification Dependencies: Align equipment rollout schedules with local market regulatory certification timelines (KC in Korea, SNI/TISI in Indonesia/Thailand, SIRIM in Malaysia, and local equivalents) in close alignment with the Import/Export (IMEX) and Compliance teams.
  • Transition Execution: Coordinate old-to-new equipment transition plans, including spare parts run-down timelines and operational communications to store teams.
  • Spec Validation: Validate that new food/beverage formulations align with store equipment capabilities prior to rollout.

Supply Chain Readiness & LTO Lifecycle Management

  • Demand Signal Alignment: Translate finalized launch plans into actionable supply signals for regional planning and procurement teams (initial buy sizing, buffer stock, supplier MOQs, and safety stock requirements).
  • LTO Lifecycle: Manage the operational transition and depletion phase for LTOs, including old-to-new SKU mapping, cutover timing, and stranded inventory mitigation.
  • Core Range Conversion: Support the transition of successful LTO SKUs into core menu items by coordinating specification finalization and long-term supply continuity.
  • Post-Launch Inventory Tracking: Monitor post-launch inventory health across markets, raising excess or stockout risks early to facilitate stock rebalancing where needed.

Regulatory & Compliance Tracking

  • Regulatory Milestones: Track market-level regulatory requirements for new launches (labeling, ingredient declarations, halal certification, food safety filings, and import documentation) in coordination with local market teams and dedicated compliance officers.
  • Timeline Integration: Incorporate regulatory approval lead times directly into the launch critical path.
  • Regulatory Reference: Maintain a consolidated reference guide of APAC regulatory requirements per market to flag potential impacts on current or future pipelines.

Post-Launch Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Launch Tracking: Track post-launch execution metrics against targets (product mix, sell-through, OTIF, forecast accuracy, and stockout frequency).
  • Post-Mortem Analysis: Lead structured post-launch reviews to identify root causes of operational gaps and convert findings into template or process enhancements.

Role Requirements

  • Experience: Professional experience in NPI execution, launch project management, or regional supply chain operations within F&B, QSR, FMCG, or consumer goods, preferably in a regional or multi-market capacity.
  • Project Management: Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional launch critical paths across product, procurement, logistics, and marketing workstreams.
  • Regulatory & Certification Familiarity: Working familiarity with food product and equipment certification landscapes in APAC (e.g., Halal requirements, KC, SNI, TISI, SIRIM).
  • Supply Chain Fundamentals: Solid understanding of demand sizing for new items, lead time dynamics, MOQs, and stock depletion planning.
  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to coordinate across diverse regional market teams and functional stakeholders without needing direct authority.
  • Systems: Proficient in project management tools, MS Office (Advanced Excel), and familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, NetSuite, or equivalent).
  • Travel: Willingness to travel across APAC markets as operational launches require.

title: IPS Employment Specialist
description:
IPS Employment Specialist

Grade or equivalent: Band 5 £32,073
Location: Covering all of Coventry and Warwickshire location
Responsible to: Team Leader
Accountable to: Service Manager

Role Purpose:
You will work with clients (managing a caseload) who have mental health support needs, to assist them in securing sustainable paid employment in line with their preferences. You will deliver the Individual Placement and Support (IPS) approach (for which training will be given); providing person centred advice and guidance to clients, whilst building positive relationships with local employers to enable clients to move into suitable employment.
You will work as part of a community mental health team, maintaining positive and integrated relationships, fostering a holistic approach to recovery through employment.
Responsibilities:

A basic understanding of IPS (Individual Placement Support) gained through experience or self-conducted research.
Experience in recruitment or employment along with advice and guidance on employment needs
Ability to engage with employers and build close, trusting, and productive relationships with people
Good understanding of the local area and it’s employers
Strong IT skills with the competency to use a range of complex systems and software

Good understanding of the principles and practice of supported employment
Experience of working in supported employment services is desirable
Good time management, diary organisation, be adaptable/flexible as no two days are the same and to be able to work with minimal supervision
Experience of working with people with mental health problems or a similar service user group is desirable

As you will be working within the community, we do need you to hold a full UK driving licence.

Core Responsibilities:

Manage a caseload of around 20 clients who have mental health support needs who are motivated to start/return to work.
Deliver the Individual Placement and Support (IPS) approach for which training will be given.
Meet and support clients to understand their key skills, aspirations and goals through completing a Vocational Profile and produce an Action Plan to help them obtain and sustain competitive employment. This includes support with their job search, CV production, application forms, interview techniques and career development.
Assess client’s support needs related to work which may include benefits/welfare advice, disclosure of mental health symptoms etc, and provide support & guidance.
Attend weekly clinical team meetings as an embedded IPS practitioner.
Source job opportunities for clients through tailored job search and regular contact with local employers to explore hidden as well as advertised employment opportunities.
Provide education and support to employers, as agreed with the individual, which may include negotiating adjustments, return to work strategy and on-going contact with the employer to ensure job retention.
Build relationships with colleagues in clinical teams to engage and generate referrals and create collaborative working partnerships with clinical staff (promoting employment as a positive intervention in the recovery journey).
Once employment has been secured continue to provide quality service through conducting regular visits, effective monitoring and in-work support to clients and employers to help sustain employment.

Relationship Management:
Establish positive and integrated relationships with clinical teams, employers and other service providers. This includes:

To build and maintain employer relationships and maintain employer engagement database.
Arrange regular meetings with clients to monitor and review progress pre and post-employment.
Spend time getting to know local employers, in order to negotiate job opportunities that meet each individual’s strengths, needs, abilities and preferences.
To challenge inequalities experienced by clients and address existing discrimination, whilst ensuring a process of learning for the organisation
Work with employers to promote the service, identify job opportunities and ensure appropriate strategies are in place to reduce barriers in the work place – this can include exploring ‘job carving’ i.e. carving small slices of work from the duties other staff do not have time to do.
To develop effective working relationships with a range of external agencies who can help individuals to achieve their employment goals. This may include local colleges and training providers.

Other:

To adhere to administrative and data capture protocols which record the progress of individuals, and to keep accurate and complete records of casework.
To work independently, reliably and deliver consistently to deliver effective IPS practice.
Ensure that effective monitoring and evaluation systems are adhered to and keep abreast of changing practice within vocational rehabilitation.
To co-produce service development with service users where possible.
To collect employment recovery stories from people accessing the service.
Ensure that all relevant policies are implemented such as information governance, safeguarding etc.
Partake in continuous learning about mental health conditions, their impact and how they can be managed and undertake mandatory training as required.
Work flexible hours as required.

Stakeholders:
Team Leader, Service Managers, HR, Occupational Health, Clinical Teams, User Groups, Voluntary Sector and Trust Training and Supported Employment Schemes, Local Colleges, Local Employment Service Disability Service Teams, Local Employers and other NHS User Employment Schemes.

Person Specification
Education and Qualification

Essential
Desirable

Qualifications and training

Educated to a degree level or equivalent experience

Trained in IPS approach
Level 3 Diploma in Employability Services Sector Qualification
QCF in Advice & Guidance (Level 3)

Experience

Experience/understanding of working with people with mental health support needs, or a similar client group within health, social services or the voluntary sector
Experience of working with someone on a one-to-one basis
Experience of managing multiple tasks at any one time
Experience of working assertively to influence decision makers

Experience of supporting people to obtain or keep work
Experience of working within mental health services
Own personal lived experience of recovery from mental health difficulties
Previous experience of delivering a service using the IPS model is a bonus
Proven experience of meeting and exceeding outcomes and targets

Knowledge

An understanding of the employment needs, and challenges faced by people who experience mental health difficulties
Developing a knowledge of a broad range of occupations and jobs
Able to use IT and tools such as MS Word, PowerPoint and Excel

Knowledge of the benefits agency and all disability/ employment related benefits

Skills

Good motivational, communication and listening skills
Outstanding interpersonal skills and ability to build rapport with a range of people
Good organisational ability
Natural ability to build close, trusting and productive relationships with people
Team orientated and works collaboratively within a mixed-disciplinary team
Ability to work independently and use initiative to develop and promote a service

Personal qualities

Non-judgemental and trustworthy
Empathy with the needs of those with mental health support needs
Passion and drive to make a positive difference to people's lives
Highly motivated with a genuine belief that someone with a mental health condition can find paid employment
Resilient and tenacious to not give up despite setbacks and frustrations
Self-aware of personal strengths and weaknesses and actively invest in personal and professional development
Willingness to travel within the region

title: Cybersecurity and Risk Engineer
