title: UX/UI Social Brand Lead (6-Month Contract)
description:
Established in 1973 with headquarters in Seoul, South Korea, Cheil Worldwide is one of the world's leading integrated marketing communications networks, with more than 7,200 employees globally in more than 54 offices in 46 countries.

For more information, visit us at: www.cheil.com.

We are inviting candidates for the position of:

UX/UI Social Brand Lead (6-Month Contract)

We are seeking an experienced lead to drive UX/UI design and delivery of a large-scale corporate website revamp and develop social design system and act as brand guardian for a Social CoE. Working closely with the project team and client stakeholders, you will translate user needs, business requirements and brand guidelines into clear, intuitive and accessible digital experiences.

Your day-to-day work will involve leading the end-to-end UX/UI design process: from user research to defining information architecture, user journeys and wireframes for responsive interface design, component specifications and design-to-development handover. You will collaborate with internal teams, client stakeholders and developers to ensure that designs are clearly documented, implementation-ready and delivered consistently across the website.

Responsibilities

  • Design Ownership: Own the end-to-end UX/UI design of the website, from concept through to launch.
  • UX Research & Analysis: Lead discovery activities and the analysis of user and business requirements. Translate findings into actionable UX recommendations and design decisions.
  • Stakeholder Leadership: Lead stakeholder workshops and present design rationale to senior client stakeholders.
  • Generative and adaptive UI: interfaces and content modules that assemble dynamically based on context, personalisation or AI output. Designers set the rules, guardrails and component logic rather than fixed screens.
  • Information Architecture & User Flows: Own and drive the development of sitemaps, navigation models, user journeys and task flows to improve content discovery and create an intuitive website experience.
  • Wireframing & Prototyping: Lead the creation of page-level wireframes and interactive prototypes that clearly communicate content hierarchy, functionality, interaction logic and responsive behaviour.
  • Responsive UI Design: Lead the creation of high-fidelity, responsive interface designs for agreed page templates and components, with consideration for accessibility, usability and consistency across desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
  • Design Systems & Components: Own and evolve the project's design system, including UI components, design tokens, responsive rules, interaction states and usage guidelines.
  • Brand Guidelines & Playbooks: Apply brand guidelines consistently across all digital touchpoints, and drive the creation of brand playbooks, digital style guides and usage guidelines.
  • Design Documentation & Functional Requirements: Own the preparation of detailed, implementation-ready documentation, including template specifications, component behaviours, bilingual layout considerations and functional requirements documentation (FRD).
  • Design-to-Development Handover: Drive handover with developers to communicate design intent, clarify functional requirements, review implementation and ensure that the final output aligns with the approved designs.
  • Collaborative Design Process: Work closely with the project team, developers and client stakeholders to review requirements, present design solutions and incorporate feedback throughout the project.
  • Quality Assurance: Lead design QA during development by reviewing layouts, responsive behaviour, component usage, accessibility and overall visual consistency.
  • Team Guidance: Mentor and guide designers on the project, reviewing work for quality and consistency.
  • Stay Updated: Keep up with the latest UX/UI practices, accessibility standards, design-system approaches, tools and digital technologies.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI design, including large-scale corporate website projects.
  • Experience leading or mentoring designers and managing design delivery across multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong research, usability testing and synthesis skills.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating experience in information architecture, user flows, wireframing, prototyping and high-fidelity interface design.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout, prototyping and design-system libraries.
  • Experience working with and developing brand guidelines, brand playbooks or digital style guides, and translating brand identity into digital experiences.
  • Strong understanding of responsive web design, accessibility, usability and user-centred design principles.
  • Experience creating clear design specifications and preparing files for developer handover.
  • Experience creating functional requirements documentation (FRD) for website projects.
  • Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into practical, user-friendly design solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when documenting component states, interaction behaviours and responsive rules.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced project environment, manage priorities and deliver work according to agreed timelines.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly explain design decisions and respond constructively to feedback.
  • Familiarity with front-end development principles, including HTML, CSS and component-based implementation, is an advantage.
  • Experience building or leading design systems, component libraries or detailed implementation documentation is preferred.
  • Experience working on bilingual websites or multilingual layout requirements would be an advantage.
  • Experience designing social media assets or developing social media guidelines would be an advantage.

title: Food & Beverage Supervisor
description:
About State Sport Centres
The Victorian State Sport Centres Trust (SSCT) operates and maintains over $1 billion in assets, including four of Australia's largest multi-sport venues: the Melbourne Sports and Aquatic Centre (MSAC), the State Netball and Hockey Centre (SNHC), Lakeside Stadium incorporating the State Athletics Centre, and Knox Regional Sports Park including the State Basketball Centre (SBC).
Unlike other major international-standard venues that host sport and entertainment events, SSCT venues also provide access for users at all levels, from elite and professional athletes to school and community participants, seven days a week, up to 16 hours a day.
Through the provision of access for all, SSCT makes a unique and significant contribution to Victoria's sport sector.
Four Workplace Values underpin the work we do: Teamwork, Safety, Excellence and Respect.
About the Role
As the Food & Beverage Supervisor, you will play a key leadership role in delivering exceptional customer service while overseeing the day-to-day operation of SSCT's food and beverage outlets across our venues. Working closely with the Food & Beverage Manager, you will lead and support team members on shift, ensuring high standards of service, food safety and operational excellence are maintained at all times.
Your primary responsibilities will include:

Leading and supervising food and beverage team members in a fast-paced environment.
Delivering exceptional customer service to venue patrons and guests.
Training, mentoring and supporting new and existing team members.
Coordinating shift staffing and allocating resources to meet business requirements.
Processing food and beverage transactions through POS systems and balancing receipts.
Assisting with catering operations, including event preparation, delivery and pack-down.
Ordering, receiving and monitoring stock levels across outlets.
Ensuring food safety, hygiene and workplace safety standards are consistently maintained.
Supporting café and function operations, including preparation of food and beverages.
Adhering to Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) requirements and venue policies.
This role requires flexibility, including availability to work weekends and during major events.

Required Skills and Qualifications
To be successful in this role, you will bring:

Demonstrated experience supervising and leading teams in a hospitality, catering or food and beverage environment.
Strong customer service skills with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.
Excellent communication, leadership and time management skills.
Ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Experience with point-of-sale (POS) systems and cash handling.

Essential Qualifications

Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) Certificate.
Current Working with Children Check.
Current First Aid and CPR Certification.
Food Safety Supervisor Certificate.
Minimum two years' experience in a supervisory role within a similar environment.

Desirable

Barista qualification or demonstrated experience operating commercial coffee equipment and preparing quality coffee beverages.

Shortlisted candidates may be subject to pre-employment screenings, including criminal record, social media, and adverse media checks.
Why is this a great place to work?
Our Patrons and Teams

You'll be surrounded by elite athletes daily and supporting a wide range of elite sports and world-class events, as well as community sport and recreation.
You'll be challenged daily and can develop yourself as a person as well as gaining valuable career skills.
You'll be part of a dynamic and supportive team of people who are great to work with.

Our Venues

Free parking.
MSAC Gym and Performance Membership including family and friends' discounts.
Discount at SSCT food & beverage and retail outlets.
Complimentary court hire for casual bookings across SSCT venues.

Our Workplace

Training and professional development.
Flexible working arrangements.
Employee Assistance Program providing free confidential support for your mental health.
Inclusive environment recognising our diverse workforce and community.
Employee recognition through our Values in Action program.

Join us in our mission to help people be excited about sport, engage in healthy activity and feel inspired to be their best.
How to Apply
Please send through a resume and cover letter supporting your application for this exciting role with State Sport Centres.
We will be reviewing applications and commencing interviews as they come in, so please don't delay in applying.
For further information please contact Jake Hitchcock-Yoo, Talent Acquisition, on (03) 9926 1440.
SSCT values diversity, is an equal opportunity employer, and encourages applications from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people with disabilities.
The State Sport Centres Trust (SSCT) is committed to the safety and wellbeing of children and young people. We seek to prevent harm of any kind impacting children and young people and have a zero tolerance for racism, child abuse, discrimination and inequality. We aim to foster a culturally safe, child safe and child friendly environment for all children and young people we have contact with, deliver services to, or are visitors to our venues and facilities.
Successful applicants will be required to provide a current Working with Children Check before commencing employment.

description:

As part of SES S.A., a global leader in satellite-enabled communications, we combine capabilities across all orbits with extensive global ground infrastructure, managed networks, hosted payload solutions, and mission integration services to support communications, sensing, data transport, and operational resilience worldwide.

Our vertically integrated space and ground capabilities bring together satellite capacity, terrestrial infrastructure, advanced network technologies, and deployed user terminals to support mission-critical government operations around the world. We are a trusted partner to the U.S. Federal Government and national security community, allied governments, NATO, NASA, and other civilian agencies, delivering reliable, high-performance solutions when mission success is critical.

At SES Space & Defense, our people are our competitive advantage. You’ll work alongside a mission-driven team committed to integrity, innovation, accountability, and delivering real-world impact for customers whose missions matter most.

#LI-Remote

Title: SATCOM Planner - Engineer III Communications

Location: Tampa, FL

Summary

The SATCOM Planner will provide communications planning for deployed SATCOM terminals for commercial and MILSATCOM networks including but not limited to iDirect, ViaSat, KuSS, BGAN, WGS, AEHF, and VHF, UHF networks. Planning will require engaging with SATCOM Engineers in the design and implementation of special operations forces (SOF) global satellite networks. The planning will include, but is not limited to, reviewing satellite access requests (SARs); determining the optimal network for each request; completing the configuration planning; coordinating configuration(s) with applicable SOF strategic entry points; and the distribution of Satellite Access Authorizations (SAA), cut-sheets, and configuration files for SOF and MILSATCOM networks. Analyzes moderately complex communication systems including planning, designing, evaluating, selecting operating systems and protocol suites, and configuring communication media with concentrators, bridges, and other devices. May include local and wide area networks, data, and voice communications. Networks may be one or a combination of terrestrial, wireless, or satellite.

Primary & Essential Accountabilities

  • Performs network systems monitoring/management/troubleshooting, incident tracking, coordination, and reporting (e.g., performance, problem, change, capacity, security); escalate incidents to administrators/engineers and management teams for resolution; submit change requests, submit trouble tickets, alert support teams to issues and tickets in the cue; track and provide updates to support SLA's
  • Ensures full interoperability and a seamless connection between all internal and external systems to include but not limited to DISN Video Services-Global (DVS-G), NIPRNET, SIPRNET, JWICS, BICES, CENTRIX, etc…
  • Performs monitoring, management, troubleshooting, technical advisement, and reporting status of program of record systems (e.g., SDN-L/M/H, SCAMPI, SOFTACS, TACLAN)
  • Real-time monitoring of bandwidth management utilization on terrestrial and satellite links
  • Proactive tracking and reporting protocol usage statistics (e.g., identify top talkers by protocol)
  • Analyzes network topologies and traffic and capacity requirements
  • Analyzes voice, video, radio-frequency, and/or data communications networks including planning, designing, evaluating, selecting, and upgrading operating systems and protocol suites and configuring communication media with concentrators, bridges, and other devices
  • Monitoring and coordination with public carriers and other circuit providers to perform any operations activities (e.g., provisioning, problem management)
  • Attend appropriate engineering, customer or business meetings
  • May lead/train less experienced SATCOM Planners
  • Performs satellite bandwidth management
  • iDirect hub administration, Q/C, and service desk duties
  • Attend appropriate engineering, customer or business meetings
  • ASI impact notification
  • MILSATCOM planning
  • JIST SAR submission
  • GAR submission – CONEX
  • EBEM/ESEM IP management
  • ARSTRAT waivers for antennas not covered by SOCOM SDB
  • SAA/GAA denial tracking
  • SOFLE Planning
  • COCOM coordination
  • PIM management
  • Commercial SATCOM beam change requests
  • Processes and manage AISR requirements
  • Process and manage L-TAC requirements
  • Disseminates and enforces customers policies
  • Analyzes moderately complex communication systems, including planning, designing, evaluating, selecting operating systems and protocol suites and configuring communication media with concentrators, bridges and other devices
  • Resolves interoperability problems to obtain operations across all platforms including e-mail, files transfer, multimedia, teleconferencing and the like
  • Configures systems to user environments
  • Supports acquisition of hardware and software as well as subcontractor services as needed
  • May contribute to proposal efforts
  • Support, communicate, reinforce and defend the mission, values and culture of the organization

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field and a minimum of five years applicable information systems or network systems engineering experience or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Fluency in technologies and application domain
  • Active U.S. Government Department of Defense (DoD) TS/SCI level security clearance

SES Space & Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $[95,699] to $[131,500]. The final base salary offered will be determined based on factors such as the position’s location, the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

Where applicable, this position may also be eligible for an annual bonus. Employees are eligible to participate in SES Space & Defense’s benefits programs, which include paid vacation, sick and personal leave; medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; a 401(k)-retirement plan; and others.

title: Automationsingenjörer, AstraZeneca - Sweden Biomanufacturing Center (SBC), Södertälje
description:
Är du en självständig problemlösare som drivs av tekniska utmaningar och tvärfunktionellt samarbete? Vill du ta en ledande roll med stora utvecklingsmöjligheter, nära kärnverksamheten i ett av världens ledande läkemedelsföretag? Då kan Sweden Biomanufacturing Center (SBC) vara rätt plats för dig.

SBC i Södertälje är en central del av AstraZenecas strategi för biologiska läkemedel och vår primära lanseringssite. Här arbetar vi i innovativa, högteknologiska miljöer där vi utvecklar och tillverkar biologiska läkemedel som förändrar liv. Vardagen präglas av stark laganda, coachande ledarskap och nyfikenhet. Tempot är högt, utvecklingsvägarna många och vi verkar hållbart – för varandra och för planeten.

Vi erbjuder en möjlighet att bli en del av Engineering & Facilities inom SBC. Funktionen ansvarar för OT Automation, investeringsprojekt, underhåll, fastighetsförvaltning samt SHE och hållbarhet.

Vi söker en senior automationsingenjör till teamet OT Automation SBC. Arbetstiden är förlagd till dagtid.

Din spelplan:

SBC OT Automation ansvarar för teknisk support till produktionsanläggningarna i Södertälje och driver service-, underhålls- och utvecklingsarbete. Du får en avgörande roll i att säkerställa hög teknisk tillgänglighet i våra anläggningar – en utmärkt möjlighet för dig med starkt teknikintresse, särskilt inom styrsystem, som vill bidra i ett engagerat team med fokus på ständig utveckling och förbättring.

Din roll:

Du kommer att arbeta i en grupp med fokus på industriell IT, automation samt styr- och reglerteknik. Som automationsingenjör hos oss fungerar du som tekniskt stöd till underhållsorganisationen genom att utföra avhjälpande och förebyggande underhåll på våra automatiserade system och processer samt vara drivande i framtida utvecklingsprojekt.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar bland annat:

  • Felsöka, förbättra och optimera automations- och styrsystem.
  • Samarbete med leverantörer för att utveckla funktioner i befintliga styrsystem.
  • Analysera och förbättra fältbusskommunikation (t.ex. Profibus, Profinet, Modbus).
  • Installera och testa automationslösningar i nya eller befintliga miljöer.
  • Optimera processer för ökad effektivitet, tillgänglighet och kvalitet.
  • Delta i driftsättning och kvalificering av ny utrustning.
  • Arbeta nära Track & Trace/vision-teamet, ingenjörer, gruppchefer och tekniker.
  • Dokumentera system samt genomföra riskbedömningar och/eller valideringar.
  • Medverka i förbättringsarbete och projekt.
  • Medverka vid myndighetsinspektioner och besiktningar.

Kvalifikationer:

· Högskoleutbildning inom relevant område och kompetens förvärvad genom mångårig erfarenhet.

· Bred teknisk kompetens inom automation samt flera års erfarenhet av Automation och Industriell IT (OT).

· Mycket goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.

Teknisk erfarenhet vi förväntar oss att du har:

· PLC-plattformar (t.ex Siemens STEP7 Classic, Siemens TIA Portal, B&R Automation Studio, Schneider, Beckhoff).

· SCADA/HMI (t.ex. InTouch, WinCC, iFIX).

· Motion/drives (t.ex. SIMOTION/SINAMICS, Beckhoff, B&R).

· Robotik (t.ex. KUKA, Stäubli, ABB).

· Databaser (t.ex. SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

· Vision/Track & Trace samt industriprotokoll (t.ex. Profinet, OPC UA).

Meriterande:

· Dokumenterad erfarenhet inom el och elkonstruktion.

· Erfarenhet av GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) och processindustri.

Framgångsfaktorer:

Drivande och samarbetsinriktad ingenjör med stark analytisk förmåga. Van att arbeta självständigt och i team, bygger goda relationer och tar initiativ i högt tempo. Erfarenhet av GMP och processindustri är meriterande. För denna roll krävs även B-körkort.

Beredskap kommer att ingå i tjänsten.

Kärnkompetenser:

Du är analytisk och lösningsorienterad och tar dig an komplexa problem på ett effektivt sätt. Samtidigt arbetar du noggrant och med starkt säkerhetsfokus, särskilt när tekniken måste fungera utan avbrott. Du är kommunikativ och van vid att samarbeta med många olika roller och intressenter. Ditt teknikintresse gör att du kontinuerligt följer utvecklingen inom industrin och digitalisering. Du är dessutom flexibel och ansvarstagande, och kan växla mellan långsiktiga projekt och akuta insatser när det behövs.

Det här är en roll för dig som gillar att kombinera teknik med funktion och göra skillnad i praktiken.

Varför AstraZeneca?

När vi ser chansen att förändras tar vi den. Varje möjlighet, oavsett hur liten, kan vara början på något stort. Att leverera mediciner som förändrar människors liv handlar om entreprenörsanda, att se ögonblicken och förstå deras potential. Hos oss trivs du som vill arbeta både självständigt och i team. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du varje dag till att produktionen av livsviktiga läkemedel kan fortlöpa.

title: Glitter Itis etsii myymäläpäällikköä
description:
Oletko luonnollinen johtaja, joka rakastaa saada sekä ihmiset että tulokset kasvamaan?

Myymäläpäällikkönä Glitterissä astut rooliin, jossa et pelkästään johda myymälää vaan myös innostat, johdat ja rakennat vahvaa tiimiä, jossa korostuvat myynti-ilo, yhteishenki ja kehittyminen. Vastaat kokonaisvaltaisesti sekä henkilöstöstä että tuloksesta, ja arkipäiväsi koostuvat energisen myymälän rakentamisesta, jossa teette yhdessä töitä kunnianhimoisten tavoitteiden eteen – ja pidätte samalla hauskaa! Työskentelet tietenkin myös arvojemme mukaisesti: Otamme oman vastuun, olemme omistautuneita, me välitämme ja kaikki on mahdollista!

Mitä tulet tekemään meillä?

Myymäläpäällikkönä Glitterissä sinulla on vaihteleva ja vastuullinen rooli, jossa painopiste on sekä myynnissä että henkilöstöjohtamisessa. Pääasialliset työtehtäväsiovat:

* Aktiivinen myyntityö ja markkinoiden parhaan asiakaskokemuksen tarjoaminen

* Vastuu myymälän päivittäisestä toiminnasta

* Tiimin johtaminen, valmentaminen ja kehittäminen

* Varmistaminen, että myyntitavoitteet ja tunnusluvut saavutetaan

* Työvuorojen suunnittelu ja aikataulutus liiketoiminnan tarpeiden mukaan

* Vastuu ohjeistusten noudattamisesta koskien tuotteiden käsittelyä, esillepanoa ja kampanjoita

Oletko sinä tämä henkilö?

* Sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta kaupan alalta, myynnistä tai asiakaspalvelusta

* Sinulla on johtamiskokemusta

* Olet sitoutunut myyjä, joka rakastaa asiakaskohtaamisia ja motivoituu tulosten saavuttamisesta

* Sinulla on palava kiinnostus muotiin ja trendeihin

* Olet liiketoimintalähtöinen ja sinulla on taloudellista ymmärrystä ja kiinnostusta

* Johdat ja innostat tiimiäsi esimerkillä

* Sinulla on positiivinen asenne, joka tarttuu myös muihin

* Olet itsenäinen, työskentelet järjestelmällisesti ja tavoitehakuisesti

Tarjoamme sinulle

* Inspiroivan ja innostavan työpaikan sekä mukavat kollegat

* Esimiesvastuun ja tuen tehtävässä

* Hyvän perehdytyksen työhön, haasteellisen työn ja mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi

* Hyvät työsuhde- ja henkilökuntaedut

Etsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa tehdä töitä noin 30 h/vko ja aloittaasopimuksen mukaan lokakuussa. Paikka on vakituinen. Meillä Glitterissä on 6. kuukauden koeaika. Huomioitahan, että täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Voit lukea meistä lisää kotisivuiltamme www.glitter.fi [http://www.glitter.fi/], hakemukset jätetään allaolevan linkin kautta, viimeinen hakupäivä on 7.10.2026. Valitettavasti emme voi vastata yhteydenottoihin puhelimitse.

Voit erittäin mielellään jättää hakemuksesi jo tänään!

title: Principal Managed Services Consultant
description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit .

About the role

As a Principal Managed Services Consultant, you will be the foremost technical expert and thought leader within our Managed Services team. You will help enterprise customers get the most from their Atlassian ecosystem by solving complex challenges, improving system stability, guiding architecture decisions, and identifying opportunities to increase adoption, alignment, and return on investment.

This is a senior consulting role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with a strategic, client-facing mindset. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, Managed Services colleagues, Customer Success, Sales, Delivery, Transformation Consulting, and Enterprise Technology & Innovation teams to deliver measurable value and raise delivery standards across the organization.

What you will do

  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor to enterprise customers, connecting Managed Services with Valiantys’ broader offerings to support growth, retention, and long-term value creation.

  • Lead complex problem diagnosis and resolution across customer environments, using deep Atlassian architecture knowledge, trend analysis, and scalable solution design.

  • Improve client system stability by proactively identifying patterns, anomalies, recurring issues, and risks before they become incidents.

  • Design and implement scalable frameworks, best practices, and solutions that improve operational excellence across multiple tools, teams, or customer environments.

  • Lead high-level value conversations with customers, including roadmap planning, executive briefings, optimization programs, and transformation initiatives.

  • Build consultative relationships with senior client stakeholders, including department heads, program managers, IT leadership, and transformation leaders.

  • Coach Managed Services team members to adopt a proactive, consultative mindset and strengthen client communication, stakeholder engagement, and value realization.

  • Establish and roll out standards for knowledge management, enablement content, onboarding, and knowledge transfer within Managed Services.

  • Collaborate across Sales, Delivery, Transformation Consulting, Customer Success, and regional teams to scale frameworks and improve customer outcomes.

  • Contribute to Valiantys thought leadership through webinars, blogs, events, and internal or external knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Do you have what it takes?

To succeed in this role, you bring:

  • Senior-level consulting experience in Managed Services, Atlassian consulting, enterprise technology, digital transformation, or a similar client-facing technical environment.

  • Deep technical expertise across the Atlassian ecosystem and a strong understanding of enterprise architecture, system stability, integration patterns, and operational best practices.

  • Proven problem-solving skills to diagnose complex issues, identify root causes, and design scalable, sustainable solutions for enterprise customers.

  • Experience leading strategic customer conversations, value roadmap planning, executive briefings, or optimization initiatives.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence senior business and IT leaders through insight, credibility, and clear communication.

  • A consultative mindset, connecting technical recommendations to business drivers, transformation goals, and measurable customer value.

  • Mentorship & coaching experience, sharing knowledge and raising standards across a technical delivery team.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills in a fast-moving, international environment.

    • Your strengths:

    • Client Partner: You understand customer goals and translate them into practical, value-led solutions.

    • Effective Communicator: You simplify complex technical topics and adapt your message for technical teams, business stakeholders, and executives.

    • Relationship Manager: You build trust with senior stakeholders and develop long-term, consultative customer relationships.

    • Solutions Developer: You identify patterns, design scalable approaches, and create solutions that improve performance and adoption.

    • Innovator: You challenge the status quo, bring forward new ideas, and contribute to continuous improvement.

    • People Developer: You enjoy coaching others, sharing knowledge, and helping teams grow their consulting and technical capabilities.

      • Languages & Location:

      • Location: This role can be based anywhere in Germany, with remote or hybrid working options.

      • Languages: Native-level or bilingual German is mandatory, along with strong professional English communication skills.

Your team and partners

  • Managed Services Director (your line manager)

  • Managed Services team members

  • Customer Success Management team

  • Delivery team

  • Transformation Consulting team

  • Sales team

  • Enterprise Technology & Innovation team

Why join Valiantys?

At Valiantys, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

  • Meaning: Drive strategic transformation initiatives and influence outcomes for enterprise customers.

  • Learning: Continuous development through training, certifications, communities, and knowledge sharing.

  • Flexibility: Benefit from a remote or hybrid work model that supports work-life balance.

Additional benefits:

  • International and multicultural environment

  • Flexible remote work policy

  • Optional company pension plan

  • Gym membership / gym pass

  • Statutory vacation entitlement + 5 additional days

  • Opportunities to contribute to thought leadership, communities, and cross-regional initiatives

  • Collaboration with experienced experts across consulting, delivery, sales, and transformation teams

Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

title: Controller
description:
Are you a hands-on construction accounting leader who enjoys solving problems and driving growth? If so, read on!

About Moltus Building Group
Moltus is a commercial general contractor headquartered in Hemlock, Michigan, serving clients across the U.S. and Canada. We specialize in complex industrial and commercial projects, delivering operationally sound, high-performing facilities through disciplined planning and execution. We value accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement - and we look for people who take ownership, solve problems, and deliver results.

About the Opportunity
The Controller will oversee the Company’s accounting operations and financial reporting functions, ensuring accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and sound fiscal management. This position works closely with the CFO to drive financial strategy, support operational decisions, and improve processes to support the company’s continued success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the Company’s day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll, job costing, general ledger, cash management, and financial reporting.
  • Lead, mentor, develop, and evaluate accounting department personnel while establishing clear responsibilities, accountability, cross-training, and effective workflows.
  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes and ensure the timely preparation of accurate financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Develop, document, implement, and enforce accounting policies and procedures to improve accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Oversee the administration and financial controls of the Company's commercial credit card and expense programs.
  • Manage financial relationships and reporting requirements with banks, bonding companies, and external CPA.
  • Manage and evaluate the Company’s accounting and financial systems and identify opportunities to improve system utilization, integration, automation, and reporting.


About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field required.
  • Several years of accounting experience including experience in a supervisory and accounting leadership role; construction industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting, job cost accounting, percentage-of-completion accounting, and WIP reporting.
  • Strong proficiency with ERP/accounting systems and Microsoft Excel, with demonstrated ability to evaluate processes, improve system utilization, and leverage technology and automation.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Proactive, dependable, and accountable with demonstrated ability to take ownership of responsibilities and follow issues through resolution.

title: Staff Software Engineer (AI-Native)
description:
𝗪𝗲’𝗿𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗿𝗼𝗰𝗸𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘀.

We are looking for Staff Software Engineers who have stopped measuring their impact by how much code they personally write and started measuring it by how much better the entire engineering system performs.

Gradion is hiring a Staff Software Engineer, AI-Native to work across systems, teams and technical domains. Your scope is bigger than one product or one technical layer. You will shape systems spanning web, desktop and mobile front ends, back-end services and APIs, data pipelines, infrastructure, testing, security and operations.

You are a software engineer first. AI is how you work.

The working rule on this team is 𝘇𝗲𝗿𝗼 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗱-𝘄𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗻 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗰𝗼𝗱𝗲. You work through Claude Code, Codex and whatever replaces them next, and you own every line that lands even though you do not type it. Your job is to turn outcomes into specifications, give agents the context and constraints they need, direct the implementation, and prove the result before it ships.

At Staff level, that leverage extends beyond your own work. You shape how other engineers work with agents, establish technical standards, identify where the real difficulty sits, and create patterns that help teams move faster without lowering the engineering bar.

The implementation may be generated. The engineering judgement is yours.

You decide the boundaries, data models, failure behaviour, trade-offs, security controls, migration paths and operational concerns that AI will not decide for you. You know when to build, when not to build, and when a plausible answer from an agent is still the wrong answer.

If your best work still comes from writing the hardest code yourself, this is probably not the right role. If you want your technical judgement to influence systems, teams and the way software gets built, keep reading.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁

  • Setting technical direction across systems and teams. Turn ambiguous problems into architecture, constraints and an approach that engineers can execute against.

  • Owning architecture and delivery for complex systems. Stay involved from specification and design through implementation, testing, deployment and production operation.

  • Designing how engineers work with AI agents. Establish the conventions, repository context, tooling, evaluation methods and quality gates that make agents reliable on real production work.

  • Making the decisions AI will not make for you. Shape boundaries, data models, failure behaviour, scalability, security, migration paths and the trade-offs that are expensive to reverse.

  • Raising the quality of engineering output. Review the implementations carrying the most risk, set standards others can review against, and build mechanisms that catch bad output before it reaches production.

  • Working across the full engineering surface. Move comfortably between application architecture, APIs, front ends, infrastructure, CI/CD, testing and production issues when the problem demands it.

  • Removing recurring problems at the source. When several teams keep hitting the same issue, look beyond the immediate fix and change the architecture, platform, tooling or engineering practice behind it.

  • Leading technical conversations with clients and stakeholders. Take an unclear business problem, challenge assumptions, identify the important constraints and turn the conversation into a technical direction people can act on.

  • Multiplying other engineers. Raise the technical bar through reviews, architecture discussions, written guidance, pairing and better engineering practices rather than relying on formal authority.

  • Creating reusable leverage. Turn successful solutions into patterns, tooling, documentation or practices that other teams can adopt instead of solving the same problem repeatedly.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗲’𝗿𝗲 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿

  • Around nine years or more building and running production software, including systems you have supported well beyond their initial release.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex on real production work. You understand what to delegate, how to provide the right context and constraints, and how to verify what comes back.

  • Comfort with zero hand-written production code as the normal way of working. Your leverage comes from specification, architecture, context, review, evaluation and verification rather than manually typing implementation code.

  • Strong system-design capability across scalability, performance, reliability, security and operational resilience, with the judgement to identify failure modes that only become visible in production.

  • Breadth across the engineering stack: web, desktop and mobile front ends, back-end services and APIs, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, testing strategy and security, with deep expertise in at least one area.

  • No specific stack required. You should be able to understand an unfamiliar codebase, architecture or technology quickly and make useful technical decisions without a predefined playbook. Our current projects use TypeScript, React, Flutter, Python, Go, Java, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes and Terraform, among others.

  • A track record of technical leadership beyond your own codebase, whether across several teams, a large programme, a platform or a technically complex product.

  • English strong enough to lead technical discussions with clients, challenge requirements, write architectural direction and communicate decisions clearly enough for teams to execute without you in the room.

  • A strong product and commercial mindset. You understand that engineering exists to solve a business problem, and you weigh technical decisions against value, risk, time and what the client is actually paying for.

  • Experience across multiple business domains, including at least one where mistakes are expensive, such as fintech, health tech, logistics or enterprise systems.

  • Strong judgement about when to build, when not to build, when to pay down technical debt, and when an agent has confidently gone in the wrong direction.

  • The ability to influence without relying on hierarchy. People trust your technical direction because the reasoning is clear, the trade-offs are understood, and the result holds up.

𝗡𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲

  • Experience building and operating production AI systems at scale, including evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, regression testing, and cost or latency optimisation.

  • Experience building AI agents as a product, including tool calling, planning, RAG and human-in-the-loop design.

  • Experience defining or evolving AI-native engineering practices across a team or organisation.

  • Platform or internal tooling work that measurably improved the productivity, quality or reliability of other engineering teams.

  • Depth in data platforms, cybersecurity, robotics or enterprise systems.

  • Open source contributions, conference talks, technical writing or other evidence of sharing technical knowledge beyond your immediate team.

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗼𝗻

This is not a Staff role where you spend your time protecting one architecture diagram or reviewing pull requests all day.

Gradion works across AI, data, cybersecurity, robotics and enterprise platforms, so the problems change and the engineering surface stays broad. You will work across teams and domains, influence how difficult technical problems are approached, and help define what modern software engineering looks like as AI changes the way software is built.

We have been engineering for 23+ years, with 300+ specialists across 7 countries and more than 100 enterprise clients. You will work with strong engineers on global projects, stay close to technology, and have real room to shape both the systems we build and the way we build them.

If you want Staff-level scope without leaving engineering behind, we should talk.

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝘆𝗼𝘂’𝗹𝗹 𝗹𝗼𝘃𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲

  • You’ll work in a global engineering environment where AI and emerging technologies are part of real delivery, not side projects or demos. We keep technical autonomy high and unnecessary bureaucracy low, so good engineering ideas can move.

  • You’ll have the scope to influence architecture, engineering practices and AI-native ways of working across teams rather than being limited to one product or technology stack.

  • Gradion has been recognised by ITviec for 8 consecutive years, including Winner for the past 2 years. You’ll collaborate across countries, work on technically challenging projects, and have access to continuous learning and tech communities.

  • We also offer competitive compensation, up to 2 months’ bonus, twice-yearly performance reviews, premium healthcare, 15 days annual leave, full salary during probation, and a hybrid working model.

  • Locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hanoi and Bangkok

title: Software Engineer II, Content Quality - Quick Commerce
description:
**Company Description**

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

**Job Description**

We are on the lookout for a Software Engineer II to join the Content Quality team within our Quick Commerce department. We own how millions of customers interact with our product content in real time - the accuracy, completeness, and trustworthiness of the products behind our dark stores and local-shop partners around the globe (groceries, pharmaceuticals, flowers, and more).

As a Software Engineer II, you won't just write code: you'll own real production services, help shape how we validate and enrich content at scale, and grow your engineering craft alongside a senior, distributed team. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on high-traffic challenges, is passionate about engineering excellence, and takes extreme ownership of their work.

What You'll Do

  • Build & Ship: Design and implement high-traffic services and APIs that transform how we handle product content at scale — delivering well-scoped features end-to-end, from design input through to production.
  • Contribute to Evolution: Take part in the architectural evolution of our Content Quality systems, balancing immediate business needs with long-term system health, with guidance from senior engineers — and proactively propose improvements in your area.
  • Collaborate Broadly: Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data) to solve complex challenges in the content domain.
  • Optimize at Scale: Monitor and fine-tune system performance to ensure a seamless experience for our global users. Own the Content Lifecycle: Help manage the end-to-end journey of product content — from ingestion and validation to enrichment and customer-facing exposure — keeping content quality a dependable pillar of the entire QC ecosystem.
  • Champion Quality: Practice modern methodologies like TDD, Continuous Delivery, and Scrum, and grow your peers through insightful code reviews.
  • Own the Lifecycle: Take ownership of the services you build — from design and debugging to post-deployment monitoring and scaling — accountable beyond the merge.

**Qualifications**

  • Python Experience: at least 4+ years of professional experience building robust applications in Python. (Exposure to Golang is a plus!)
  • Scale Awareness: Experience with — or a genuine drive to build — large-scale, distributed systems that handle high request volumes.
  • CS Foundations: A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns. Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on exposure to AWS or GCP and a "Configuration as Code" mindset (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Helm), with a willingness to deepen it.
  • Modern DevOps: Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (ArgoCD, Drone) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, distributed tracing).
  • Data Skills: Solid knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis) databases.
  • Ownership & Pragmatism: You're a collaborative problem-solver who makes data-driven decisions, takes extreme ownership of your work, and drives problems to resolution without waiting to be told. Communication: Quality-first mindset in giving and receiving feedback.

**Additional Information**

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

  • We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
  • We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
  • Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
  • Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
  • The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
  • Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together[ 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin ](https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our [relocation hub](https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

Check out the list of the [5 most common interview questions and answers ](https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements)created in collaboration with our recruiters.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Quality Inspector II - Weekend Night Shift
description:
Inspectors are key personnel in the Accurus Quality Department and their duties are integral to our overall quality management system and customer satisfaction. Inspectors perform inspections on newly received goods, work-in-process, and are responsible for final inspections of machined aerospace parts and assemblies to ensure compliance with engineering requirements and work instructions. Inspectors are required to document specific information regarding approvals and non-conforming parts and may be involved in problem-solving internally to identify re-work requirements. Inspectors may provide quality and/or manufacturing process training for manufacturing personnel.
Essential Functions
To accomplish this job, an individual must be able to perform each essential function. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Determines and utilizes appropriate inspection methods and instruments (micrometers, height gauges, air gauges, radius gauges, calipers, etc.) to complete in-process and final inspection of machined aerospace parts and assemblies, including simple to moderate layouts and setups on a surface plate
Initiates nonconformance records and disposition of parts not meeting requirements
Performs simple CMM inspections as required
May perform FAI inspections and complete associated documentation
Continually strives to improve inspection effectiveness and efficiency by recommending and supporting the implementation of process improvements
Communicates effectively and professionally with internal and external personnel to identify root causes, troubleshoot and address errors and trends, and negotiate the resolution of non-conforming parts and necessary re-work or re-inspection
Completes other duties as required
Regular attendance on-site at the workplace is required

This role is identified as requiring ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) compliance; therefore, qualified candidates must meet the definition of a U.S. Person (per EAR Part 772 and ITAR 120.15):

An individual who is granted U.S. citizenship, or
An individual who is granted U.S. permanent residence (i.e., a "Green Card" holder), or
An individual who is granted status as a "protected person"

Required Education and Work Experience

A high School Diploma or GED equivalent
An associate degree or similar post-secondary or vocational training in a related field is preferred
A minimum of two (2) years of experience in inspection for machined parts and/or assemblies in the aerospace industry is required

Other Required Skills and Abilities

Demonstrated accuracy in reading and interpreting blueprints, planning and engineering documents, quality standards, customer specifications, and other technical design standards
Advanced mathematical skills (add, subtract, multiply, and divide using fractions and decimal equivalents)
Experience in accurately reading precision measuring instrumentation, including mics, calipers, height gauges, tape measures, and other similar devices
Completion of assigned internal training for Level II Inspectors, and periodic retraining or recertification is required
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing (English)

Physical Demands and Work Environment
To perform the essential functions of the role, employees must be able to perform the following activities with or without reasonable accommodations:

Regularly stand and walk throughout the facility, including all buildings and the manufacturing areas
Regularly lift, carry (short distances), and push/pull up to 50 pounds
Regularly climb steps, stairs, or ladders
Occasionally bend, crawl, stoop, squat, or kneel
Constantly communicate verbally and in writing (English) using a phone, texts, or other messaging
Visual acuity to accurately read mics, calipers, or other precision measuring instruments; accurately distinguish colors
Use hands and fingers to operate computer keyboards, measurement instruments, and manually examine parts

Working Conditions
Work is performed in a manufacturing shop environment where working conditions may vary significantly; the employee will be exposed to:

Excessive noise (hearing protection required)
Dust, smoke, fumes/vapors (occasionally)
Extreme temperatures (occasionally)
Hazardous equipment, including forklifts, hand tools, cranes or other lifting devices, and other equipment used in a machine shop environment

The use of PPE, including hearing protection, eye and hand protection, and safety footwear is required

title: Research Assistant (Natural Sciences & Science Education Department) [NIE]
description:
The National Institute of Education invites suitable applications for the position of Research Assistant on a 6-month contract at the Natural Sciences & Science Education Department.

Project Title: Multiplexed fluorescent nanosensor array for AI-enabled rapid gut health biomarker detection

Project Introduction: We are seeking a highly motivated Research Assistant to join our team on a medical technology translation project. Our work focuses on the technical and commercial advancement of a breakthrough optical nanosensor platform, moving it from the laboratory into a practical clinical, AI-enabled diagnostic tool. By developing and deploying multiplexed sensor arrays that rapidly screen for critical gut health and inflammatory biomarkers simultaneously, we aim to achieve functional assessment of gut health. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of deep tech nano-biotechnology, while actively participating in real-world commercialization pathways and venture design. Strong performance opens future pathways ahead including potential contract renewal, direct involvement in spin-off venture conversion, or mentorship towards PhD graduate study in chemical biology and biosensing.

Requirements:

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Biology, Biochemistry, Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related field.

  • Careful and systematic in conducting laboratory work.

  • Reliable and able to adhere closely to established experimental protocols.

  • Proactive and willing to learn, with the ability to work independently after appropriate training.

  • Demonstrates a strong interest in and passion for deep-tech commercialization and venture design.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience working in a Biosafety Level 2 (BSL-2) laboratory environment, including the operation and maintenance of Class II Biological Safety Cabinets (BSC).

  • Prior experience with biological assays, biofluids, or metabolite biosensing.

  • Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Origin, Python, etc.).

  • Familiarity with spectroscopic techniques (e.g., fluorescence, Raman spectrophotometry, and UV-Vis spectrophotometry).

  • Prior experience or exposure to deep-tech commercialization and translation, such as participation in entrepreneurial bootcamps, technology transfer projects, or startup environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Assay & Nanosensor Testing: Conduct systematic optical assays, including fluorescence and absorbance measurements, to evaluate nanosensor array responses to target gut health biomarkers and metabolites.

  • BSL-2 Laboratory Operations: Perform biofluid and chemical preparation, routine biological sample assays, while maintaining strict BSL-2 biosafety protocols and proper use of Biosafety Cabinets (BSC).

  • Data Analysis & Protocol Optimization: Record, analyze, and document experimental dataset reproducibility to support device optimization and translational milestones.

  • Venture & Clinical Integration: Assist with translating bench data for venture design workshops, startup commercialization activities, and clinical partner updates.

  • Lab Maintenance: Assist with baseline equipment setup, reagent inventory, and biosafety compliance in the laboratory.

  • Any other administrative duties as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

Application

Applicants (external and internal) will apply via Workday. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

🛒Jos kaipaat enemmän viikkotyötunteja, voit halutessasi tehdä lisätöitä joko kotimyymälässäsi tai SSO:n muissa toimipisteissä. Samalla kerrytät eurojen lisäksi osaamista ja saat uusia työkavereita.
🤩Harvinaisen hyvät työkaverit! 88 % työntekijöistämme suosittelee SSO:ta työnantajana. Perniössä sinua odottaa 30 hengen tiimi valmiina hommiin kanssasi!

💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 25 h/vko
Työt alkavat: sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian
Haku päättyy: 11.10.2026. Toivomme kuulevamme sinusta pian, sillä haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla ja valintapäätös tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

📞Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa marketpäällikköAnssi Lahti sähköpostitseanssi.lahti@sok.fi.

Työnantajakuvaus
Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. Työllistämme noin 1200 ammattilaista neljällä eri toimialalla, 80 eri toimipaikassa läntisellä Uudellamaalla ja Salon seudulla. Lue lisää ihan tavallisista töistä ja epätavallisen hyvistä eduista osoitteessasso.fi/toihinmeille.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Oncode Srl è un’azienda di consulenza specializzata nella progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni software dedicati ad aziende nel settore industriale e dei servizi IT.

Descrizione della posizione

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Full Stack Developer per la nosta sede di Bologna con esperienza nella progettazione e programmazione software, che possa seguire in modo indipendente la realizzazione di progetti di sviluppo in tutte le fasi del suo ciclo di vita, dalla raccolta dei requisiti alla messa in produzione.

Il ruolo prevede la gestione delle attività dei task assegnati e l'interfacciamento diretto con clienti.

Nel dettaglio la persona inserita si occuperà di:

  • Progettare e gestire piattaforme software complesse in più contesti di sviluppo, in particolare piattaforme software dove interagiscono più (micro) servizi tra cui applicazioni web, servizi client/server e servizi di statefull stream processing (kafka) o di indexing (stack ELK)
  • Entrare a far parte del nostro team di specialisti del settore, affrontando tematiche di Data Science, Big Data Analytics, Cloud Computing, Deep Learning & Machine Learning;
  • Occuparsi dello sviluppo di progetti occupandosi di tutte le fasi del suo ciclo di vita, dalla raccolta requisiti alla messa in produzione;

Cosa vi offriamo

  • RAL fino a 45.000 in base alla seniority
  • Contratto a tempo indeterminato
  • Buoni pasto da 8 euro / giorno
  • Welfare aziendale
  • Orario di lavoro flessibile e smartworking
  • Possibilità di crescita professionale in un ambiente dinamico e meritocratico
  • Assicurazione medica integrativa
  • Premio annuale in linea con i risultati aziendali
  • Budget per l'acquisto di libri relativi al mondo software/automazione
  • Formazione specifica
  • Partecipazione a conferenze in Italia ed Europa
  • Eventi di team building

Requisiti richiesti

  • Laurea triennale/specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica e/o discipline attinenti (Automazione, Telecomunicazioni, Elettronica);
  • Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo software e di lavoro in team
  • Esperienza di almeno 5 anni di programmazione generalepurpose (preferibilmente Python, Java oppure C#)
  • Buona conoscenza Database SQL e NoSQL
  • Conoscenze di basi di Ingegneria del Software, metodologie di sviluppo e OOP;
  • Conoscenza di strutture dati e algoritmi;
  • Spiccate capacità di problem solving e reverse engineering;
  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese
  • Capacità relazionali e gestionali

Due parole su di noi

I nostri team con forti competenze software ed automazione si occupano di progetti complessi in diversi ambiti. Per il settore IT: Healthcare, Banking, Energy, Ticketing, Automotive. Per il settore Automation: building, packaging, aeronautics, logistics.

Ci occupiamo di progettazione e sviluppo software per le aziende che puntano alla digitalizzazione e interconnessione dei processi. Al centro di ogni progetto mettiamo le competenze, costantemente aggiornate dei professionisti. Grazie al nostro approccio “Skills as a Product”-che si fonda su un asset fondamentale ovvero che le capacità uniche e distintive dei singoli membri del team sono il punto fondamentale per costruire un vantaggio competitivo - supportiamo i clienti nell’intraprendere attivamente un percorso di crescita.

Vision

Avere un impatto significativo nel mondo ed essere parte attiva nel generare progetti che emozionino le persone, una riga di codice alla volta.

Mission

Crediamo che ognuno debba esprimere a pieno il proprio potenziale. Per questo, creiamo un ambiente di lavoro ideale in cui coltivare con passione le nostre competenze per lo sviluppo di software, al fine di supportare e affiancare i nostri clienti rendendoli più competitivi, efficienti e autonomi. Stabiliamo con i clienti un rapporto a lungo termine per agevolarli nello sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business future.

Valori

  • Crescita
  • Responsabilità
  • Trasparenza
  • Coraggio
  • Eccellenza
  • Attenzione al cliente
  • Collaborazione e condivisione

Note

L'offerta è da intendersi nel rispetto delle norme sulle parità di trattamento in materia di occupazione e di condizioni di lavoro (L.903/77, L.125/91, D.Lgs. 216/03 e D.Lgs. 198/2006).

title: Data Engineer
description:
Per uno dei principali player del mercato assicurativo italiano, realtà di primo piano e brand riconosciuto a livello internazionale, stiamo selezionando un/una Data Engineer.

La persona sarà inserita in un team dedicato alla progettazione, realizzazione e gestione di soluzioni dati e analytics in contesti enterprise.


Responsabilità principali:

  • Analizzare i requisiti funzionali e tradurli in soluzioni dati scalabili ed efficienti.
  • Progettare e sviluppare pipeline dati in ambiente Google Cloud
  • Definire e implementare modelli dati a supporto di reporting, analytics e use case avanzati di Machine Learning
  • Gestire il ciclo di vita delle soluzioni in produzione, garantendo qualità, affidabilità e monitoraggio dei processi.
  • Applicare pratiche di DataOps e MLOps per l’automazione dei processi di sviluppo, rilascio e gestione operativa
  • Collaborare con team multidisciplinari per la realizzazione di prodotti analitici e iniziative data-driven.
  • Coordinare attività progettuali, pianificare avanzamenti e gestire le relazioni con fornitori esterni e stakeholder interni
  • Supportare le attività di troubleshooting e ottimizzazione delle performance/costi delle soluzioni implementate


Requisiti richiesti:

  • Esperienza in ruoli di Data Engineering o affini.
  • Conoscenza dei principali servizi di data management della piattaforma Google Cloud Platform, in particolare: BigQuery, Dataform, Dataflow, Vertex AI
  • Conoscenza di Python per lo sviluppo di prodotti e modelli analitici (ML)
  • Esperienza nella progettazione, sviluppo e gestione di pipeline dati in ambienti di produzione.
  • Conoscenza delle metodologie e degli strumenti DataOps e MLOps.
  • Competenze di data modeling e progettazione di architetture dati moderne (DWH, Data Lake, Data Mesh)
  • Capacità di analisi funzionale e definizione delle soluzioni tecniche
  • Esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti analitici e delle piattaforme dati
  • Capacità di coordinamento e monitoraggio delle attività progettuali
  • Capacità di comunicazione e documentazione tecnica/funzionale
  • Buone capacità relazionali nella gestione di fornitori e partner tecnologici
  • Laurea


Requisiti preferenziali:

  • Esperienza su ambiente Oracle Database.
  • Buona conoscenza dello sviluppo PL/SQL.
  • Familiarità con processi di integrazione dati e ottimizzazione delle performance su database relazionali.
  • Esperienza/conoscenza dell'ambito assicurativo
  • Eventuali certificazioni Google Cloud
  • Precedenti esperienze in contesti enterprise caratterizzati da elevati volumi di dati e requisiti di affidabilità in produzione


Completano il profilo attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione con diversi stakeholder, autonomia operativa, orientamento al risultato e capacità di problem solving.


Sede di lavoro: Roma (modalità ibrida, a regime)


Range retributivo annuo previsto: 43.000 – 53.000 euro, in funzione del livello di autonomia, seniority tecnica e ampiezza delle responsabilità.


EgoValeo è tra i pionieri dell’head hunting tecnico in Italia, specializzata esclusivamente in profili IT e Engineering dal 2010.


EgoValeo offre servizi di ricerca e selezione del personale – Aut. Min. n. 39/0014503 – ed è iscritta all’Albo delle Agenzie per il Lavoro.


L’offerta è rivolta a tutte le persone, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. 198/2006 e dei D.Lgs. 215/2003 e 216/2003.

I dati personali saranno trattati ai sensi del Reg. UE 2016/679 (GDPR). Informativa privacy

title: Senior Investment Analyst
description:
About the Role.
This role is within the Avant Investments team and has responsibility for analysing and reviewing the investment strategies for Avant’s portfolios covering Strategic Asset Allocation, Dynamic Asset Allocation and Manager/Fund Selection.
This role is tasked with building, utilising and maintaining models and conducting research to support the investment strategy review and monitoring processes as well as providing analytical support to the broader team. This role also mentors and supports analysts in the team and provides back-up coverage for other team members' responsibilities as required.
Key Responsibilities
Conducting research and analysis to support the SAA, DAA and investment manager selection processes

  • Run, maintain and enhance internal models used to support SAA reviews (including Asset/Liability analysis), DAA tilts, manager and fund recommendations, and investment trades.• Conduct research and analysis to support investment strategy reviews.• Review and enhance investment research processes.

Developing investment strategy recommendations

  • Develop investment recommendations covering SAA, DAA and manager selection.

Primary or secondary responsibility for monitoring and reviewing managers for designated asset classes

  • Set up regular meetings with managers.• Resolve investment-related issues with managers.• Review and monitor manager performance and prepare commentary for performance reports.• Assist with the tracking of investment fund/strategy information.• Assist with the review of annual due diligence material provided by managers.

Ensuring performance reporting is accurate and insightful

  • Prepare performance and risk reports for management and the Board Investment Committee.• Enhance performance and risk reporting.

Preparing Investment Committee papers

  • Prepare high quality, concise papers for the Board Investment Committee.• Prepare ad hoc papers for the Board Investment Committee and senior management as required.• Contribute to building the confidence and trust of the Board Investment Committee and senior management in the internal Investments team.

Mentoring and assisting others

  • Mentor and assist analysts in the team• Provide back-up for other members of the team• Provide peer review of investment models, papers and strategy recommendations• Assist other team members as required.• Assist internal stakeholders on investment-related queries.

About You
Key Capabilities Required (Qualifications, Experience and Skills):

  • Tertiary qualifications in a finance or related discipline• Minimum of 5 years investment/finance related experience• Hands-on experience with financial analysis and quantitative modelling to support investment decision making covering at least one of the following: Strategic Asset Allocation, Dynamic/Tactical Asset Allocation, portfolio management or manager selection• Excellent Excel skills• Demonstrated understanding of investment markets, asset class characteristics, portfolio construction and investment risk concepts.• Attention to detail• Demonstrated ability to show initiative and be curious• Demonstrated ability to influence constructively• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Capabilities (Qualifications, Experience and Skills):

  • Post graduate studies (e.g. CFA, FIAA, CIMA)• Previous experience writing board and committee papers• Experience in the management of investment assets for an insurance company or asset/liability management• Experience with programming or statistical tools (e.g. Python or R)• Experience with investment reporting• Experience managing or mentoring investment analysts• Awareness of ESG integration or responsible investment practices

About Avant
Avant is Australia's leading medical defence organisation with a proud heritage of protecting Australian medical professionals for more than 130 years.Established by doctors in 1893, Avant now supports over 95,000 health practitioners and medical students across Australia. As a member-owned organisation, everything we do is focused on supporting, protecting and advocating for our members throughout their careers and lives.Beyond delivering market-leading products and services, we play an important role in improving healthcare quality, safety and professionalism through education, research and advocacy initiatives.

Why Join Avant
At Avant, you'll be part of an organisation with a strong sense of purpose and a commitment to supporting Australia's healthcare professionals.You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work alongside experienced risk, finance and actuarial professionals.• Gain exposure to a diverse and complex financial services environment.• Contribute to key strategic, regulatory and prudential risk initiatives.• Build your expertise across a broad range of financial risk disciplines.• Be part of a collaborative and values-driven culture focused on continuous improvement and member outcomes.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Avant supports doctors so they can serve Australia's diverse communities. We believe diversity of thought, background and experience strengthens our organisation and the service we provide to our members.We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people from culturally diverse communities, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities and people with caring responsibilities.We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and making reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

title: Yard Worker
description:

The yard worker is responsible for month end physical inventories as well as the loading and unloading of inbound/outbound orders.
