Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Event Executive (Logistics and Operations)
description:
Primary Function:

To direct the procurement, technical support and operations/logistics activities of the Exhibitions department

Main Responsibilities:

1. To provide operational coordination, technical support, audio-visual services, security, fire regulation compliance, cleaning services, exhibitor services, and overall client satisfaction during exhibitions and conferences.

2. To consult with management and Event Managers concerning physical set-up needs and requirements for exhibitions and conferences.

3. To work closely with the project team by answering queries and complaints, and monitoring services provided by vendors.

4. To source and inspect venues and site facilities to ensure they are adequate and being maintained properly for specific events.

5. To act as the key liaison between clients, event managers, in-house designers and third party vendors leading up to the event, ensuring that both client and event requirements are met.

6. To establish cooperative working relationships with partners, venue owners/managers, service contractors, government bodies, clients, etc.

7. To apply for licences and permits required with the relevant authorities.

8. To source, inspect, negotiate for the best price and appoint contractors and vendors for the following, among others :

· Exhibition space

· Meeting and function rooms

· Registration and Housing

· Food and Beverage

· Audio-visual equipment

· Entertainment/Theme functions

· Exhibition operations e.g. registration management, equipment rental, stand construction, freight forwarding/courier, temporary/casual workers, security etc.

· Promotion and publicity e.g. design and production of sales kits, newsletters, websites.

· Conference/exhibition kits and other marketing/promotional collaterals.

9. To prepare Purchase Orders for purchases of all services and products used by the department for submission to Finance department.

10. To create and maintain event timelines and schedules.

11. To direct and manage the floor plan and floor management, registration procedures, on-site operations and pre/post event operations of each event.

12. To oversee and continuously improve the department’s event management software and database operations, and to source for the latest technology and software for more efficient work processing.

13. To provide updates and regular reports on operational matters and post-event reports.

14. To liaise with the project team and Finance department for logistics/operational requirements and expenditure.

15. To assist in any other duties assigned from time to time

title: Counselor
description:
Counselor

Community Bridges, Inc. (CBI) is an integrated behavioral healthcare organization offering a full continuum of care, including variety of programs throughout Arizona, Oklahoma and District of Columbia. CBI provides residential, outpatient, inpatient, patient-centered medical homes, medication-assisted treatment, and crisis services to individuals experiencing crisis, opioid use disorder, homelessness, and mental illness.

CBI is the premiere non-profit fully integrated healthcare provider of substance use and behavioral health programs in Arizona, including prevention, education and treatment using cutting-edge, nationally recognized, evidence-based models.

Job Summary
The Community Bridges, Inc. (CB) Counselor is responsible for ensuring, with the assistance of other treatment team members, that each participant is provided the services necessary to achieve the goals of treatment as outlined in their individualized treatment plan. Counselors familiarize themselves with each new assigned participant to provide appropriate counseling services based on best practices models as well as providing educational presentations to participants and/or their families as needed.

Skills/Requirements

  • Master’s degree in counseling, marriage and family therapy or social work from a CSWE-accredited program required.
  • Minimum of one (1) year of full-time behavioral health experience is required of this position. LIC
  • Must be licensed at the independent or associate level with the Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners (AZBBHE) as Psychologist, Social Worker, Counselor, Marriage and Family Therapist or Addiction Counselor (Addiction Counselor applicable to Residential Programs only).
  • Must be in good standing with the AZBBHE and meet requirements to provide clinical supervision toward licensure.
  • Valid identification required.
  • Holds AZ Fingerprint Clearance card.

CBI Offers an excellent benefits package!

Generous PTO accrual (5 weeks!),
Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life, Supplemental plans
Hospital indemnity/ Critical Illness,
Pet Insurance,
Dependent Care Savings, Health Care Savings,
401K with employer match - 100% vested upon enrollment,
Wellness programs,
Tuition Reimbursement and Scholarship Programs, incentives, and more!
Reimbursement options for Licensure
Very Competitive pay rates

CBI is growing and expanding our services!

We are experiencing tremendous growth currently. As an essential service provider, we value all our employees and their careers.
*For the past four years, The Phoenix Business Journal has recognized CBI as one of the top ten healthiest mid-size employers in the Valley! *

CBI Values your Career and have lots of growth opportunities!
Our staff experience tremendous professional growth through ongoing training and support. Our team is supported by strong and competent leadership. The leadership at CBI is committed to ongoing professional development for their staff. Come join our team of passionate individuals who are serious about making a difference in the lives of our patients and the communities we serve.

About our Culture, commitment to employees!

We are looking for driven and compassionate individual’s that thrive in an upbeat and safe working environment. We dedicate a lot of thought and effort into work life balance as well as our competitive composition structure.
We know life happens, that’s why we all start with a 5-week PTO plan as well as a wide range of unique benefits!

Our Facilities.
Our locations are all state-of-the-art facilities that provide top notch integrated care. We are proud to adhere to a “no wrong door” treatment approach that allows our staff to dramatically improve the quality of life for the patients in their care.

CBI treats patients from all different walks of life and believes in maintaining the dignity of human life. Recovery is possible!

title: Head of Software Development
description:
Loodos is one of the first established companies in the industry, providing end-to-end mobile solutions since 2004.

Who we are:

Loodos’s utmost motivation is Mobile Excellence. We build end-to-end solutions with best technical and business approaches. Bringing human behavior understanding and deep technical abilities together carry the mobile application to level of excellence.

In our R&D center office we have awesome teammates that we can safely incorporate into our mobile application and infrastructure projects, which have a direct R&D-oriented vision and reach over 25 million monthly active users.

Excellence is not only a station to arrive, but also a way of journey! We open our doors to every method and idea that will help our self-development.

We are a team that ‘loves their job’, ‘builds strong infrastructures’, ‘high-tech oriented employees’ and ‘always entertained’.

If you want to be a part of the beloved culture of Loodos, your place is ready!

Would you like to join us?

What we’re looking for:

  • 15+ years of technical experience, including 5+ years in an engineering management role, with a strong, hands-on technical foundation
  • Experience in delivering high quality consumer facing web and mobile applications, applying software engineering best practices throughout the development lifecycle
  • Strong technical depth and credibility — able to review and challenge architecture and design decisions, set engineering standards, and get hands-on with architecture or code when the team or project needs it
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate, empower, and hold accountable a team of software development engineers
  • Excellent project management skills including estimation, planning, risk management, and resource allocation
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, cross-functional teams and stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle and Agile practices
  • Continuously improve existing processes for Software Development Lifecycle and also establish systems and best practices to increase efficiency and technical quality
  • Genuine passion for staying current with new technologies and applying them where they add real value
  • Ability to quickly learn, unlearn and adapt
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Strong problem solving and critical and analytical thinking skills

What you’ll do?

We are looking for a leader who will be hands-on in leading and taking ownership of a team of software development engineers (HC: 35+) driving the timely delivery of high-quality mobile applications and maintaining the overall technical excellence and best practices of the software development process.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of software development engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, agency, and accountability
  • Own the entire software development lifecycle in coordination with cross-functional teams, from design and development to testing and deployment, from project planning to deployment and maintenance

title: Intern, Knowledge & Insights (Project - DOVES Foreigners)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

NVPC is the national agency dedicated to growing a culture of volunteerism and philanthropy in Singapore. By engaging individuals, organisations, communities and leaders across the people, private and public sectors, we seek to create a more caring, inclusive, and compassionate society. Together, we envision Singapore as a City of Good, where everyone is able to give every day and everywhere (3Es), contributing their time, talent, treasure, ties and testimony (5Ts). Learn more at nvpc.org.sg.

The Knowledge & Insights team conducts research studies in the non-profit sector, investigating trends and uncovering insights around volunteering and philanthropy. The team aims to be the subject-matter expert in the giving space, providing robust research evidence to support strategic planning for NVPC and the sector.

Project Overview:

The intern will be attached primarily to a qualitative research study under the Drivers and Outcomes of Volunteer Experiences in Singapore (DOVES) programme. DOVES is an ongoing series of studies at NVPC that examines different aspects of Singapore's volunteering landscape.

The DOVES Foreigners study examines the volunteering experiences of foreign residents in Singapore, including their motivations for volunteering, experiences within volunteer settings, and outcomes arising from their participation.

This will be a learning-based qualitative research attachment that combines hands-on involvement in a research study with supervised learning and shadowing. The intern will support the DOVES Foreigners study throughout its data collection phase, while gaining exposure to how qualitative research is designed, conducted, analysed and translated into practical insights.As qualitative research involves methodological and interpersonal skills that are best developed through practical experience, the intern will have opportunities to observe and discuss how qualitative interviews are conducted, including rapport-building and probing techniques, as well as how researchers interpret participant accounts and develop themes.

Over the six-month attachment, the intern will also undertake a small-scale qualitative research exercise under supervision, applying the research concepts and skills developed during the internship. The exercise will give the intern an opportunity to translate their learning into practice, from formulating a research question and designing an appropriate approach through to conducting interviews, analysing data and communicating findings.

The key deliverables include:

DOVES Foreigners

  • Well-coordinated participant recruitment, communication and interview schedules for the DOVES Foreigners study
  • Accurate, quality-checked and appropriately translated interview transcripts

Qualitative research exercise

  • A completed small-scale qualitative research exercise demonstrating the application of qualitative research principles and methods

A final presentation or written summary communicating the research process, findings and methodological reflections from the small-scale study

RESPONSIBILITIES

Duties & Responsibilities

The intern will support their RO in the DOVES Foreigners study.

Core responsibilities will include:

  • Quality-checking English transcripts generated through a transcription software against interview recordings
  • Translating Mandarin-language interview transcripts into English (there is in house support for Malay and Tamil translations)
  • Liaising with research participants and relevant organisations on interview arrangements
  • Scheduling interviews and managing participant communications
  • Supporting participant voucher distribution and other research administration

Research learning opportunities

Subject to research protocols, confidentiality requirements and the intern's capabilities, the intern will also have opportunities to:

  • Shadow interviewers during qualitative interviews to observe interviewing, rapport-building and probing techniques
  • Gain exposure to qualitative coding and thematic analysis, learning how researchers move from individual participant accounts to broader themes and findings
  • Where appropriate, develop preliminary qualitative observations or themes under the supervision of the RO
  • Observe how findings are synthesised and translated into actionable recommendations for policy, programme design and practice
  • Participate in weekly check-ins to discuss qualitative research methods, such as interview design, fieldwork considerations and researcher reflexivity

Small-scale qualitative research exercise

During the attachment, the intern will develop and complete a small-scale qualitative research exercise under the supervision of their RO. This will involve:

  • Formulating a feasible research question
  • Developing an interview guide and considering sampling and ethical consideration
  • Conducting a small number of qualitative interviews with supervision
  • Organising and analysing interview data
  • Identifying and interpreting key themes
  • Presenting findings and reflecting on the research process and methodological choices

The scope of the exercise will be appropriately sized for an internship and is intended primarily as a consolidation and application exercise of the intern's learnings rather than as an independent research study for publication or organisational decision-making.

QUALIFICATIONS

Pre-requisites:

  • Background in Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, or related social science disciplines
  • Interest in social research methodologies (e.g., qualitative interviews, focus-group discussions, cognitive interviews)

Good to have, but not required:

  • Prior exposure to qualitative research methods, such as one-on-one interviews, focus groups or cognitive interviews
  • Basic understanding of qualitative data analysis or thematic analysis
  • Experience working with interview transcripts or qualitative data
  • Domain knowledge or interest in volunteering, migration, foreign residents, acculturation or related social issues
  • Proficiency in Mandarin would be an advantage
OTHER INFORMATION

Please state your availability in your resume. Those who are able to commit full-time immediately and for at least 3 months will be prioritised.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - National Volunteer & Philanthropy Centre

title: Myyjiä- Stadium Outlet Laajalahti
description:
JOS SINULTA LÖYTYY TAHTOA, MEILTÄ LÖYTYY LOPUT!

Oletko sinä seuraava tähtipelaajamme?
Ovatko asiakaspalvelu ja aktiivinen elämäntapa intohimosi? Oletko energinen ja palveluhenkinen tiimipelaaja, jolla on erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot? Mahtavaa, saatat olla seuraava tähtipelaajamme!

Sitoutuminen ja vastuullisuus luovat perustan Stadiumin toiminnalle. Päivittäinen työmme pohjautuu näihin arvoihin sekä energiseen asiakaspalveluun ja tiimityöhön. Nämä ovat meidän intohimojamme – mikä sinua inspiroi?

Mitä joukkueemme tarjoaa sinulle?
- Merkityksellisen työn - Olemme alkujaan pieni perheyritys, joka on kasvanut yhdeksi Pohjoismaiden suurimmista urheilukaupan ketjuista – alkuperäämme unohtamatta. Olemmekin edelleen yhtä suurta perhettä, ja teemme tuloksia tiiminä intohimo, energia, kehittyminen ja yksinkertaisuus ohjenuoranamme. Tarjoamme paikkaa tiimissä, jossa sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa ja olla osa missiotamme: aktivoida maailmaa! - Voittavan joukkueen yhteisöllisyyden ja ilon – Me uskomme työympäristöön, jossa tunnet olosi kotoisaksi ja arvostetuksi. Olemme tiivis tiimi, joka tekee töitä yhdessä ja pitää hauskaa matkan varrella! Järjestämme aktiviteetteja ja tapahtumia, jotka vahvistavat yhteisöllisyyttä, niin kentällä kuin sen ulkopuolella. - Kehittymisen mahdollisuuksia - Meillä kehittyminen tapahtuu arjessa, saat tukea ja koulutusta omaan kehittymiseen. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia vahvistaa osaamistasi myynnin parissa, ottaa lisää vastuuta ja edetä uusiin tehtäviin Stadiumin sisällä. Saat työkalut, sparrauksen ja joukkueen tuen, jotta onnistut ja löydät oman seuraavan pelipaikkasi.
Katso lisää työstä Stadiumilla urasivuiltamme, Instagramista @workatstadiumfinland tai LinkedInistä Stadium Finland.

Mitä tarkoittaa olla tähtipelaaja Stadium Outletilla?
Stadium Outletin ansiosta urheilu ei ole koskaan ollut halvempaa. Myyjänä edustat Stadium Outletia ja teet urheiluvarusteet ja urheilumuodin kaikille saatavaksi. Meille on ensiarvoisen tärkeää, että työntekijämme nauttivat työstään ja haluavat aktivoida maailmaa kanssamme. Haluamme, että asiakkaamme tuntevat olonsa tervetulleiksi Stadium Outletille, ja että asiakaskokemus on yhtenäinen läpi koko myymälän.

Myyjänä Stadium Outletin joukkueessa:
- Luot olosuhteet myynnille täyttämällä myymälän tuotteilla ja laittamalla ne esille selkeästi. - Palvelet asiakkaita iloisesti ja energisesti tehden asiakaskohtaamisesta inspiroivan ja aktiivisen. - Liikut ympäri myymälää ja työskentelet erilaisissa tehtävissä yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Myyt vaatteita, kenkiä ja urheiluvarusteita, toimit kassalla sekä purat kuormia ja huolehdit myymälän täyttämisestä. - Pääset hyödyntämään kiinnostustasi ja osaamistasi urheilumuodista ja -varusteista. Kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksi.
Toivomme, että jaat ajattelutapamme ja näkemyksemme mahdollisuuksien löytämiseen haastavissakin tilanteissa. Nautit vastuusta ja mahdollisuudesta kasvaa myyjänä. Pystyt työskentelemään sujuvasti suomen kielellä, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi. Palkkaamme pääsääntöisesti täysikäisiä eli 18 vuotta täyttäneitä työntekijöitä.

title: Vastaava HR asiantuntija, strategisen ohjauksen yksikkö
description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa Kelan tulevaisuuden osaamista?Innostutko strategisesta kehittämisestä ja yhteistyöstä eri toimijoiden kanssa? Oletko tavoitteellinen kehittäjä, joka yhdistää strategisen ajattelun käytännön toimeenpanoon? Jos vastasit kyllä, meillä on sinulle kiinnostava mahdollisuus.

Haemme vastaavaa HR asiantuntijaa Kelan strategisen ohjauksen yksikköön. Tehtävä on vakituinen.

Kelan toimintaympäristö muuttuu jatkuvasti, ja henkilöstön osaamisen kehittäminen on keskeinen osa strategiamme toteuttamista ja uudistumiskykyämme. Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten henkilöstö, osaaminen ja oppiminen tukevat Kelan strategian toteutumista myös tulevaisuudessa. Työskentelet osana strategisen HR:n asiantuntijatiimiä ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä henkilöstöjohtajan kanssa.


Vastaavana HR asiantuntijana pääset
* rakentamaan Kelan tulevaisuuden osaamista kehittämällä osaamisen johtamisen toimintamalleja, käytäntöjä ja mittareita organisaatiotasolla
* ennakoimaan tulevaisuuden osaamistarpeita sekä tuomaan nämä näkökulmat osaksi strategista henkilöstö- ja osaamissuunnittelua
* johtamaan ja koordinoimaan osaamisen kehittämiseen liittyviä strategisia kehittämiskokonaisuuksia, työryhmiä ja verkostoja
* kehittämään osaamisen ja oppimisen vaikuttavuutta organisaatiotasolla sekä varmistamaan, että osaamisen kehittäminen tukee Kelan strategisten tavoitteiden toteutumista
* kehittämään johtamisosaamista, henkilöstökokemusta ja jatkuvan oppimisen käytäntöjä osana Kelan uudistumista
* tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä esihenkilöiden, HR:n, asiantuntijoiden ja johdon kanssa
* tuottamaan tietoa, analyysejä ja kehittämisehdotuksia päätöksenteon tueksi.


Edellytämme sinulta
* soveltuvaa ylempää korkeakoulututkintoa
* vähintään kolmen vuoden työkokemusta osaamisen johtamisesta
* osaamista strategisesta henkilöstöjohtamisesta tai organisaation kehittämisestä
* kykyä yhdistää strateginen ajattelu käytännön kehittämiseen ja toimeenpanoon
* kokemusta kehittämiskokonaisuuksien johtamisesta ja verkostomaisesta työskentelystä
* vahvoja viestintä-, fasilitointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja
* sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.


Arvostamme lisäksi
* ennakoivaa ja tulevaisuussuuntautunutta otetta osaamisen kehittämiseen
* voimavarakeskeistä, oma-aloitteista ja tavoitteellista työskentelytapaa
* englannin kielen osaamista.


Tarjoamme sinulle
* mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa koko Kelan tulevaisuuden osaamiseen ja uudistumiskykyyn
* tehtävän, jossa yhdistyvät strateginen kehittäminen, yhteistyö ja käytännön vaikuttaminen
* innostavan asiantuntijayhteisön sekä laajat verkostot eri puolilla Kelan organisaatiota
* mahdollisuuden kehittää uusia toimintamalleja ja olla mukana merkittävissä strategisissa muutoksissa
* joustavat työskentelytavat, joissa yhdistyvät etä- ja lähityö. Työpisteesi sijaitsee Helsingissä
* kattavat henkilöstöedut ja työhyvinvoinnin tuen
* palkkaus määräytyy tehtävän vaativuuden ja henkilön työsuorituksen perusteella. Tehtävän palkka sijoittuu arviolta välille 5122 - 5768 e/kk. Voit esittää hakemuksessasi palkkatoiveesi.



Me Kelassa kehitämme henkilöstökokemustamme jatkuvasti. Panostamme itse- ja yhteisöohjautuvaan työhön ja arvostamme henkilöstöämme. Teemme työtä monipaikkaisesti, mutta rakennamme myös yhteisöllisyyttä. Kela on perheystävällinen työpaikka (Väestöliiton myöntämä tunnus 2021 ja 2024).

Kelassa työskentelee monenlaisia ihmisiä ja meillä jokainen saa olla oma itsensä. Panostamme yhdenvertaisuuteen ja tasa-arvoon. Valitsemme tehtäviin ne henkilöt, joiden osaaminen ja kokemus vastaavat parhaiten haussa olevan työtehtävän vaatimuksia. Tervetuloa joukkoomme sellaisena kuin olet!

Kiinnostuitko? Hae tehtävää osoitteessa www.kela.fi/rekrytoi viimeistään 12.10.2026. Liitä hakemukseen hakemuskirje ja ansioluettelo. Kun hakemuksesi on saapunut meille, lähetämme vahvistuksen sähköpostiisi. Tehtävässä sovelletaan koeaikaa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antavat 9.10. mennessä henkilöstöjohtaja Pasi Lankinen tai ryhmäpäällikkö Juha Turpeinen (pasi.lankinen@kela.fi ja juha.turpeinen@kela.fi).

Henkilöstömme, asiakkaidemme ja käsittelemämme tiedon turvaaminen on meille ensiarvoisen tärkeää. Siksi teetämme valitusta hakijasta turvallisuusselvityksen ja huumausainetestauksen.

title: Director, CRM Strategy
description:
CourtAvenue is a company of industry experts accelerating digital transformation for the world’s most ambitious companies.
At CourtAvenue, you will be a part of a culture powered by entrepreneurs, technologists, data scientists and the habitually restless dedicated and energized to design products and services that transform businesses while optimizing them for growth. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow within a culture that values innovation while focusing on redesigning the experience between consumer and service (or product) by leveraging a fluid, seamless, and thoroughly transparent engagement.

The Director, CRM Strategy is the day-to-day owner of CRM strategy execution on one or more of CourtAvenue's largest accounts, translating the broader program vision — set together across accounts — into activation-ready specifications: audience segmentation, journey logic, suppression rules, and campaign requirements. This is a hands-on role: you'll be building segmentation frameworks and journey maps yourself, not only directing others to build them, while also representing CRM strategy credibly in client meetings.

This role requires strong CRM strategy fundamentals — lifecycle segmentation, journey orchestration, and data-informed personalization. Automotive or dealer-network CRM experience (OEM, dealer group, or other distributed-retail model) is preferred given current client needs.

Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day CRM strategy execution for assigned client accounts, translating program-level direction into activation-ready specs: audience segmentation, journey logic, suppression rules, and campaign requirements

  • Lead the cross-functional journey orchestration pod for each account — coordinating the client experience-journey owner, CRM platform owner, data-requirements owner, channel owners, creative, analytics, and consent/legal — to ship journeys on time and to spec

  • Build and maintain lifecycle-based audience segmentation frameworks (e.g., acquisition, active, lapsing, lapsed stages) tailored to each client's business model and customer base

  • Partner with data and analytics teams to define entry, exit, and progression triggers, suppression and prioritization logic, and measurement plans for each journey

  • Translate strategic recommendations into deliverables that client teams can review, approve, and build against

  • Provide day-to-day direction and mentorship to other CourtAvenue strategists, platform leads, and campaign managers on the account team

  • Contribute to new business pitches by developing CRM strategy points of view, proposed team structures, and program roadmaps

  • Stay current on CRM platform capabilities and personalization/decisioning trends — Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud experience preferred — and bring relevant recommendations back to the practice

  • Develop and refine reusable CRM frameworks and deliverable templates (segmentation models, journey maps, measurement approaches) that can be applied across accounts, not just the account they originated on

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or related field; MBA a plus

  • 8+ years of experience in CRM strategy, lifecycle marketing, or customer journey design — agency-side or in-house

  • Automotive or dealer-network CRM experience (OEM, dealer group, or similar distributed-retail model) strongly preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and/or Data Cloud preferred; comparable platform experience (e.g., Braze, Adobe, Iterable) will be considered

  • Proven experience building audience segmentation and lifecycle journey frameworks from research through activation

  • Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional teams (data, platform, creative, analytics, legal/consent) to ship CRM programs

  • Strong client-facing communication skills, with experience presenting strategy and results directly to client stakeholders

  • Experience mentoring or directing junior strategists and coordinating with technical/platform teams

  • Comfortable operating hands-on — building specs, decks, and segmentation logic — while also representing CRM strategy credibly in client and internal meetings

Work Environment

Our organization follows a structured-hybrid work model, where employees work in the office 2-3x’s a week and remotely on Monday and Friday.

Candidates for this position will ideally be located near one of our offices:

  • Chicago, IL
  • Cincinnati, OH
  • Los Angeles, CA
  • Minneapolis, MN
  • San Diego, CA

Candidates located in Dallas, TX, Austin, TX or Bentonville, AR will also be considered.

CourtAvenue, INC. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. CourtAvenue recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or genetic information.

CourtAvenue, INC. participates in the E-Verify program. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form (I-9) upon hire.

title: BPM Evidence Associate (fixed term/secondment)
description:
BioPharmaceuticals Medical (BPM) ensures the best patient outcomes by providing healthcare decision-makers around the world with the evidence and confidence they need on AstraZeneca (AZ) therapies and support our internal stakeholders with medical insight and expertise. BPM provides medical leadership with market participation and connectivity while also impacting the life cycle planning and execution of all our products. BPM aims to lead AZ in achieving scientific leadership, being a great place to work, and keeping patients at the core of everything we do.

The BioPharmaceuticals Medical Global Evidence Portfolio Delivery organization is accountable for the operational delivery of global strategic studies required to generate the evidence to build the confidence on AZ therapies and additional observational, interventional and externally sponsored research required by Global Product Teams and Global Medical Teams.

The BPM Evidence Associate (EA) supports and coordinates Evidence Generating Activities (EGA) and contributes to the operational activities to ensure consistency of BPM Evidence deliverables to time, cost, and quality.

EGA portfolio supported includes Company Sponsored Observational and Interventional Research, Externally Sponsored Research and Early Access Programs. The EA, by supporting specific processes and workflows, acts as a point of contact for the administrative, technical and execution support towards the assigned study teams, stakeholders, functions and/or systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist the study team and contribute towards start-up, execution, close out and reporting of studies
  • Coordinate administrative tasks during study process, governance, audits and regulatory inspections, according to company policies, SOPs and regulations
  • Lead the collection, review and tracking of Essential Documentation, key correspondence and other relevant study documentation ensuring storage, formatting and version control is compliant with Company Procedures, document retention guidelines, industry standards and the applicable laws
  • Interface with Strategic Partners and other Contract Research Organisations (CROs) & External Service Providers (ESPs) as well as internal cross-function teams to complete activities relating to the assigned processes, systems and projects
  • Support study teams in monitoring and overseeing the operational and financial aspects of CRO/ESP collaboration (i.e. invoice reconciliation, Purchase Order management) to ensure they are effectively undertaken, studies are delivered to plan and study conduct documented
  • Lead the set up, maintenance and archiving of the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) in line with the Company SOPs and applicable laws
  • Support import of applicable documentation into the Company Global Document Electronic Library (ERV) according to the relevant procedures, publishing standards and the applicable technical requirements associated with Submission Ready Standards (SRS) for delivery of documentation to regulatory authorities
  • Set-up, ongoing maintenance and closure of all study related Company tracking systems and communication tools (i.e. Veeva Clinical Vault, Veeva Quality Vault, collaborative study folders on SharePoint, TRIALSCOPE DISCLOSE) ensuring the Company compliance requirements are met, and supporting the Study Team in management and use of other study specific systems (i.e. ACCORD, COUPA)
  • Ensure project status reports reflect on the complete and current project information in company systems like Veeva Clinical Vault
  • Provide administrative support towards the review of ESR proposals that enables timely and consistent approach to evaluation
  • Support achieving quality and accuracy of data within the ESR registry and management tool (Veeva Clinical Vault) daily and completeness of documentation to enable teams to make effective business decisions
  • Lead the administrative support of key governing bodies (GRC and ERT) and other relevant meetings, ensuring efficient execution of the meeting and creation of documented evidence of decisions, actions and participation
  • Provide the operational support for studies post database lock, prior to CSR finalisation
  • Provide administrative and operational support during study close out and lead the archiving activities in line with the Company SOPs and requirements
  • Where required input into functional work including training activities and development of procedures
  • Company Sponsored Observational and Interventional Research Projects:
    • Assist the study team with the planning of projects by providing a range of options, risk assessment and local insight that feed into the study feasibility assessment
    • Lead operational set-up and delivery for your area of responsibility; either defined studies or a sub-set of study responsibilities
    • Ensure the development and implementation of study risk mitigation plan and actions for your area of responsibility
    • Manage activities to the agreed KPI’s: time, cost and quality
    • Manage effective collaboration with internal stakeholders such as the Operations Lead (OL), Delivery Director (DD), Epidemiologist/Global Medical Affairs Leader (GMAL) and other internal functions, for example, to assess the impact of project changes on KPI’s.
    • Collaborate with External Service Providers (ESPs) and Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) on the implementation and delivery of studies, ensuring an effective communication plan is implemented and that roles and responsibilities between parties are understood.
    • Monitor the operational aspects of ESP/CRO collaboration within your study remit to ensure they are effectively undertaken and studies are delivered to plan, managing issues and changes to the scope of projects (e.g. time and cost) as they occur.
    • Act as point of contact for AZ Marketing Company (MC) stakeholders, ensuring their commitments are delivered.
    • Report on project status (using Company System such as Veeva Clinical Vault, ACCORD) and participate in project planning and control activities to ensure project plans remain up to date
    • Manage project finance within agreed threshold limits, keeping track of project budget on a continuous basis, maintaining financial management systems (such as ACCORD and OPAL) and ensure transparency with budget holders by obtaining approval for any proposed budget changes.
    • Monitor compliance and ensure reporting of issues as necessary.
  • Externally Sponsored Scientific Research (ESR) Projects:
    • Responsible for the local management and coordination of ESR studies for a given country or region.
    • Acts as a point of contact for MC operational research enquiries, signposting MC to appropriate guidance.
    • Supports the review of ESR proposals to enable a timely, consistent and thorough approach to evaluation e.g. gathering required data from MC, and review committee members such as Patient Safety, Regulatory, Supply chain, Medical etc.
    • Lead the development, baselining and maintenance of project milestones, revising all project planning, in conjunction with MC when necessary, in light of changing needs and requirements to ensure that deliverables continue to be efficiently and effectively met.
    • Leads operational aspects of ESR projects in conjunction with the clinical teams, ensuring compliance with project management guidelines, external regulations and internal processes and policies to enable the delivery of high quality Externally Sponsored Collaborative Research (ESCR)
    • Tracks all project KPI’s from a time, cost and quality perspective, providing progress reports to stakeholders.
    • Identify risks and escalating issues of non-performance and non-compliance to the appropriate person.
    • Maintain quality and accuracy of data within the ESR registry and management tool (Veeva Clinical Vault) on a daily basis and completeness of documentation to enable teams to make effective business decisions.
  • Early Access Programs (EAP)/Named Patient Supplies(NPS):
    • Coordinate the NPS cross functional team interactions, including any ESPs, required for granting Early Access to Investigational Medicinal Products within a defined market, region, institution and/ or therapeutic area(s).

Requirements:

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in biological science or healthcare-related field
  • Knowledge of the clinical study and drug development processes, GCP/ICH guidelines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills as well as proven collaboration and organizational skills
  • Excellent knowledge of spoken and written English
  • Team oriented and flexible; ability to respond quickly to shifting demands and opportunities

Desirable:

  • Consistent demonstration of the AZ Values and Behaviours
  • Develop working knowledge across the BPM Evidence EGA and an understanding of the range of working procedures relating to them
  • Ability to develop advanced computer skills to increase efficiency in day to day tasks
  • Demonstrate ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment

title: Buying Trainee - Emiratisation
description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Buying Trainee with Tryano, you'll step into the commercial world behind some of fashion's most exciting luxury and contemporary brands.

Working across Womenswear, Handbags and Shoes, you'll gain hands-on exposure to an international and regional brand portfolio spanning ready-to-wear, accessories and footwear, including names such as Zimmermann, Chloé, Fendi, Self-Portrait, Jimmy Choo, Aquazzura and Alaïa. This opportunity is designed for someone who wants to understand both the creative and commercial sides of fashion and build a long-term career in Buying.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Support the Buying team across Womenswear, Handbags and Shoes.

  • Prepare presentations and commercial data for weekly trade meetings.

  • Participate in trade meetings reviewing weekly sales, brand and category performance, and in-season actions.

  • Maintain Buying trackers and Excel sheets, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.

  • Work with sales and product data to develop your commercial understanding of different brands and categories.

  • Support seasonal Buying cycles, including Spring/Summer collections.

  • Participate in weekly market visits to build your understanding of products, customers and the retail environment.

  • Gain exposure to brand-facing activities and learn how Buying teams work with luxury and contemporary fashion brands.

  • Develop an understanding of the wider Buying process and how commercial decisions translate into the products our customers discover in-store.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

We're looking for someone who is genuinely excited about fashion, products and the commercial thinking behind what makes it into the Tryano store.

You will ideally bring:

  • UAE National with a Family Book.

  • A background in Finance, Economics, Business Management, or another relevant field.

  • A genuine interest in luxury fashion, womenswear, handbags and footwear.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, particularly VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

  • Confidence working with data, trackers and administrative tasks.

  • Strong attention to detail and organization.

  • A proactive mindset and willingness to take initiative.

  • Comfort working in a brand and client-facing environment.

This traineeship is particularly suited to someone who sees Buying as more than a first role and wants to build expertise within the function. As you develop your career, Buying can offer exposure to international markets and buying trips to fashion capitals such as Milan and Paris.

What the Group can Offer

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

Emirati Talent & Inclusive Opportunities

At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to empowering UAE Nationals and fostering local talent as part of our vision for a thriving workforce. We welcome applications from Emirati candidates who are eager to grow, innovate, and contribute to the success of our organization. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures equal opportunities for all, regardless of gender, age, race, religion, or ability.

title: MLOps Specialist
description:
Czym będziesz się zajmować?

Stanowisko: MLOps Specialist (MID)

Ilość poszukiwanych osób: 1

Zakres obowiązków:

  • Tworzenie i utrzymanie platformy AI w branży ubezpieczeniowej:
  • Projektowanie i budowa infrastruktury MLOps/LLMOps: Tworzenie skalowalnego środowiska do trenowania i serwowania modeli przy użyciu Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry oraz Kubernetes (AKS).
  • Automatyzacja procesów CI/CD/CT: Implementacja potoków (pipelines) CI/CD dla rozwiązań ML, obejmujących automatyczne testowanie, wersjonowanie danych i modeli (DVC, MLflow) oraz Continuous Training (CT).
  • Konteneryzacja i orkiestracja: Przygotowywanie obrazów Docker dla modeli AI/GenAI oraz zarządzanie ich wdrożeniami na klastrach Kubernetes w architekturze hybrydowej (integracja z systemami on-premise).
  • Monitoring i Observability: Wdrożenie zaawansowanego monitoringu modeli (wykrywanie Data Drift/Model Drift), logowania i alertowania, aby zapewnić wysoką dostępność usług AI.
  • Wsparcie techniczne dla AI Act: Implementacja narzędzi do audytowalności modeli, lineage (śledzenie pochodzenia danych) oraz bezpieczeństwa (zarządzanie dostępem, szyfrowanie) zgodnie z wymogami regulacyjnymi.

Oferta:

  • Lokalizacja: Warszawa/ Wola– praca hybrydowa – 1x w tygodniu w biurze
  • Stawka: do 170zł netto/ h
  • Współpraca: długofalowa


Kogo poszukujemy?

Wymagania:

  • Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w obszarze DevOps, MLOps lub Inżynierii Oprogramowania, w tym praktyka w pracy z modelami ML na produkcji.
  • Biegłość w konteneryzacji i orkiestracji: Zaawansowana znajomość Docker i Kubernetes (zarządzanie klastrami, Helm charts, Ingress).
  • Doświadczenie z chmurą Publiczną: Głęboka znajomość Azure (w szczególności Azure ML, AKS, Azure Container Registry) lub GCP/AWS z gotowością do szybkiego wejścia w Azure.
  • Praktyka w CI/CD: Doświadczenie w budowaniu pipeline'ów (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) uwzględniających specyfikę ML (np. trenowanie modelu jako krok w pipeline).
  • Programowanie i skryptowanie: Dobra znajomość Python (niezbędna do pracy z SDK narzędzi ML) oraz Bash/Shell.
  • Znajomość narzędzi MLOps: Praktyczna obsługa MLflow, Kubeflow lub rozwiązań natywnych chmury do zarządzania cyklem życia modelu.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Znajomość Terraform, Bicep lub Ansible.

Mile widziane:

  • Certyfikaty Azure: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) lub Azure AI Engineer (AI-102).
  • Doświadczenie we wdrażaniu modeli LLM (Large Language Models) i architektur RAG.
  • Znajomość narzędzi do monitoringu (Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor).


Czego wymagamy?

3 lata doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku
Znajomości:
  • Azure
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Azure AI
  • AKS
Mile widziane:
  • Azure Active Directory
  • CI/CD
  • DVC
  • MLflow
  • Python
  • bash
  • Terraform
  • Bicep
  • Ansible
Języki:
  • Polski
  • Angielski


Jakie warunki i benefity otrzymasz?
  • 25.2k–28.6k PLN netto/m (B2B)
  • B2B - Elastyczne godziny pracy (100%)
  • Praca zdalna: Hybrydowo
  • Pakiet medyczny, Pakiet sportowy


Kim jesteśmy?

apreel został założony w kwietniu 2010 roku przez przyjaciół, których marzeniem było stworzenie własnego software house'u. Wraz z rozwojem firmy i jednocześnie wzrostem zaufania klientów, rozszerzyła swoją działalność o usługi takie jak leasing ekspertów IT. Dziś ten obszar stanowi główny filar działalności apreel.

Nie oznacza to jednak, że założyciele apreela porzucili swoje marzenia. Naszą pasją zawsze będzie tworzenie autorskich rozwiązań informatycznych, a celem, do którego dążymy, jest ciągłe ich doskonalenie. W połączeniu z wyjątkową atmosferą i profesjonalizmem stworzyliśmy w apreelu wyjątkowy klimat.

Zapraszam do aplikowania, jeżeli zależy Ci na pracy wśród dobrych specjalistów, w stabilnych organizacjach oraz z jasnymi warunkami finansowania.

title: Materials Program Manager I
description:
Position Summary
The Material Program Manager leads material strategy, execution, and cross-functional coordination for complex aerospace and defense programs operating under strict contractual, regulatory, and quality requirements. This role ensures material readiness, manages supply risk, supports cost and schedule performance, and serves as a key interface across program management, supply chain, engineering, manufacturing, quality, contracts, and finance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end material management activities from contract award through production, delivery, and sustainment.
  • Develop and execute material strategies aligned to program schedules, customer requirements, and financial objectives.
  • Serve as the material focal point for program reviews, customer discussions, internal operations reviews, and executive updates.
  • Partner with program management to translate demand, schedule changes, engineering updates, and risk into executable supply chain plans.
  • Drive material readiness for development, production, repair, and field support requirements.
  • Monitor shortages, allocations, long lead items, inventory health, and supplier performance to protect schedule commitments.
  • Lead material risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalation for obsolescence, sole-source exposure, quality issues, and capacity constraints.
  • Coordinate with procurement, planning, manufacturing, warehouse, quality, and engineering teams to resolve material constraints quickly and effectively.
  • Support subcontract management, make-buy decisions, and material strategies in compliance with customer and internal requirements.
  • Ensure adherence to contractual flow-downs, FAR/DFARS requirements, export control obligations, traceability rules, and quality documentation expectations.
  • Prepare concise material status reporting, recovery plans, and risk summaries for leadership and program stakeholders.
  • Lead development, validation, and continuous maintenance of material Estimates at Complete (EACs), ensuring accuracy, traceability, and alignment with program financial baselines.
  • Analyze cost variances between actuals, commitments, and forecasts to identify key drivers, root causes, and required corrective actions impacting material EAC performance.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Supply Chain, and Engineering to gather cost inputs, assess risks and opportunities, and deliver timely, high‑quality EAC updates.
  • Validate supplier quotes, purchase orders, and subcontractor inputs to ensure alignment with EAC assumptions and program financial objectives.
  • Provide material cost insight and data‑driven recommendations during monthly program reviews and quarterly EAC reviews.
  • BOM maintenance

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in materials management, supply chain, program support, or operations within aerospace, defense, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex programs with strict delivery, quality, compliance, and configuration control requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of material planning, procurement, inventory control, supplier management, and ERP/MRP execution.
  • Ability to analyze data, assess risk, prioritize issues, and drive decisions in fast-paced program environments.
  • Effective leadership, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and brief senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. government, defense, or foreign military funded programs.
  • Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS, ITAR, EAR, AS9100, and configuration-controlled production environments.
  • Experience with subcontract management, supplier corrective actions, and long lead material planning.
  • Knowledge of earned value principles, EAC support, cost/schedule integration, and program financial drivers.
  • APICS/ASCM, PMP, CPSM, or similar professional certification.

Core Competencies

  • Program material leadership
  • Risk management and mitigation
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Schedule-driven execution
  • Supplier performance management
  • Regulatory and contractual compliance
  • Data-driven decision-making
  • Executive communication

Success Measures

Material availability to support program milestones

Reduction in shortages and expedited recovery cycle time

On-time delivery performance

Inventory health and cost performance

Supplier responsiveness and execution

Compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements

Role is open to onsite, hybrid or remote

Vi søger en teamm8, der

Har solid erfaring med dataarkitektur og trives med at tage ansvar for komplekse tekniske løsninger.

Du trives i en udadvendt rolle, hvor du er en central rådgiver for både kunder og dine kolleger. Du kan lide at stå forrest, facilitere workshops, præsentere løsningsforslag og skabe tillid hos kunderne.

Du motiveres af at sætte retning, skabe struktur og være den faglige sparringspartner, som både kunder og kolleger går til. Du trives i dialogen med beslutningstagere og kan omsætte forretningsmæssige udfordringer til konkrete tekniske løsninger.

  • Trives med kundedialog, workshopfacilitering og teknisk rådgivning.

  • Kan præsentere komplekse tekniske emner på en letforståelig måde for både teknikere og forretningen.

Det vigtigste er ikke din uddannelse, men din erfaring, nysgerrighed og evne til at skabe relationer, drive dialoger og omsætte teknologi til løsninger, der skaber værdi.

title: SAP Data Migration Consultant
description:
SAP Data Migration Consultant - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Data Migration Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute SAP data migration strategies for S/4HANA implementations, including conversion and greenfield scenarios.
  • Perform data extraction from legacy systems using SAP-provided and custom tools and prepare data for ingestion into SAP.
  • Configure and utilize SAP LTMC (Legacy Transfer Migration Cockpit), including custom migration objects where required.
  • Implement real-time replication scenarios using SAP SLT (System Landscape Transformation), including transformation rules and filter conditions.
  • Manage logical system setups and replication configurations for hybrid SAP environments.
  • Support system refreshes and landscape virtualization activities using SAP LVM (Landscape Virtualization Management).
  • Design and execute data transformation, cleansing, and enrichment processes prior to migration.
  • Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, and orphan records prior to go-live.
  • Support mock migrations, dress rehearsals, and the final cutover, including detailed runbook execution and rollback planning.
  • Optimize performance for large-volume data loads, including parallelization, package sizing, and database tuning.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to validate master and transactional data against business expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance, audit, and privacy standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 12 or more years of SAP data migration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC and S/4HANA migration tools.
  • Experience with SAP SLT replication scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of SAP LVM for system refresh and landscape management.
  • Strong understanding of SAP master and transactional data structures.
  • Experience performing data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working in enterprise SAP landscapes during major implementations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP Data Services or other ETL platforms.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-source data migrations.
  • Working knowledge of SAP HANA database structures.
  • SAP S/4HANA certification.
How to Apply

For immediate consideration, please send your resume to venkat.r@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

title: Sosiaaliohjaaja, vanhusten palvelujen neuvonta ja asiakasohjaus
description:
Vammaisten ja vanhusten palvelujen toimiala, Kotona asumisen palvelut
Neuvonta ja asiakasohjaus, Alue 3
Katriinankuja 4 , 01760 Vantaa

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Haemme määräaikaista vahvistusta sosiaaliohjaajien tiimiimme loppuvuodeksi 2026.

Vanhusten palvelujen neuvonnassa ja asiakasohjauksessa työskentelee kolme sosiaaliohjaajaa. He toteuttavat sosiaaliohjausta Katriinan sairaalan ja akuuttihoidon (AKOS 1-3) osastojen sekä palliatiivisen poliklikan ja kotisairaalan asiakkaille. Sijaisuuteen haettava sosiaaliohjaaja työskentelee Katriinan sairaalan osastoilla.

Sosiaaliohjaajat tekevät tiivistä yhteistyötä osastojen, sairaalan palveluohjaajien, asiakkaiden ja omaisten kanssa. Sosiaaliohjaajat auttavat asiakkaita ja omaisia etuus-, edunvalvonta- ja lakisääteisiin vakuutuksiin liittyvissä asioissa. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös muun muassa asunnottomien asiakkaiden asunnonhaussa ohjaamista, raha-asioiden hoitamiseen liittyviä asioita, kodin siivoustarpeen arvioimista, mielenterveys- ja päihdepalveluihin ohjaamista, yksinäisenä kuolleen henkilön asioiden selvittelyä ja psykososiaalista tukemista. Tarvittaessa sosiaaliohjaajat tekevät kotikäyntejä. Sosiaaliohjaajat kirjaavat Apotti-asiakas- ja potilastietojärjestelmään terveyssosiaalityön roolissa.

Edellytämme kelpoisuusvaatimuksen lisäksi hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Luemme eduksi

- Aikaisemman kokemuksen sosiaaliohjauksesta (terveyssosiaalityön näkökulmasta)
- Apotti-asiakastietojärjestelmän käyttökokemuksen
- Lainsäädännön, etuuksien ja palvelujen tuntemuksen
- Monialaisen verkostotyön osaamisen

Odotamme sinulta innostunutta otetta työhön, uuden oppimiseen ja kiinnostusta oman työn ja työyhteisön kehittämiseen.

Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja, ammatillisuutta ja aktiivista työotetta sekä kykyä selviytyä ja palautua painetilanteissa.

Työssä menestyminen edellyttää asiakaslähtöistä ja palveluhenkistä työotetta, kykyä hallita useita samanaikaisia tehtäviä ja priorisointikykyä kiiretilanteissa.

Vanhusten palvelujen neuvonta ja asiakasohjaus on tehtäväalue, jossa on neljä toimintayksikköä ja noin 100 työntekijää. Tehtäväalueella työskentelee palveluohjaajia, sosiaaliohjaajia, erityissosiaaliohjaajia, sosiaalityöntekijöitä, toimistosihteereitä, asiakasneuvoja, sairaanhoitajia, lähihoitajia, asiakasvastaava, johtava sosiaalityöntekijä, neljä esihenkilöä ja tehtäväaluepäällikkö. Tehtäväalueemme henkilöstö työskentelee eri toimipisteissä Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueella.

Neuvonnan ja asiakasohjauksen alue 3 on keskitettyjen palvelujen toimintayksikkö. Alueella 3 on tehtäväalueen asumisen arviointi, tukipalvelut, etsivä vanhustyö ja vapaaehtoistoiminta, sairaalan palvelu- ja sosiaaliohjaus, liikuva palveluohjaus ja toimistosihteerityö.

Meillä on mahdollisuus työtehtävien sen mahdollistaessa osittaiseen etätyöhön. Liukuva työaika tuo myös joustoa työn ja arjen yhteensovittamiseen.

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 400 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.

title: Senior Android Developer / Platform
description:
About AppNation

We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide.

Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries.

We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Android Developer to help us build and scale world-class mobile experiences.

You'll work across our portfolio of AI-powered and consumer mobile apps, taking ownership from architecture decisions to production releases. You'll solve challenging engineering problems, improve app performance, and help shape the technical standards of our mobile team.


What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain scalable, high-quality Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
  • Take ownership of the native Android layer in our Flutter apps, including architecture, integrations and platform-specific capabilities
  • Build and ship Android-native features in our apps, such as home screen widgets with Glance, Live Updates and rich notifications, push notifications with FCM, Credential Manager and Sign in with Google, Google Play Billing and modern Material 3 experiences
  • Bring AI capabilities to the native side where they make sense, using technologies such as ML Kit, on-device models with LiteRT, Gemini Nano through AICore, and Android speech and camera APIs
  • Design and evolve maintainable Android architectures, reusable components and clear boundaries between native and Flutter layers
  • Debug and resolve Android-specific production issues such as crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, performance regressions, networking problems and Flutter engine behavior on Android
  • Profile and optimize app startup time, memory usage, rendering performance, battery usage and responsiveness using Android Studio Profiler and production monitoring tools
  • Ensure our apps run reliably across the Android device ecosystem, including different OEMs, OS versions, screen sizes, tablets and foldables
  • Improve engineering practices around testing, code review, CI/CD, release processes and mobile observability
  • Act as the team's Android mentor by reviewing native code, writing internal guidelines, running knowledge-sharing sessions and helping our Flutter developers become confident on Android
  • Keep a close eye on Android platform updates and Google Play requirements, such as target SDK deadlines and platform policy changes, and turn relevant developments into concrete technical and product proposals

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of professional Android development experience, including apps you have shipped and maintained in production on Google Play.
  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin and hands-on production experience with Jetpack Compose
  • Strong knowledge of Android application architecture, application and process lifecycle, modular design and platform APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of the Android platform beyond the main app, including app widgets, services, WorkManager, push notifications, Google Play Billing, permissions and background execution.
  • A solid understanding of Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, structured concurrency and thread safety.
  • Strong understanding of Android memory management, lifecycle-related leaks and performance profiling.
  • Comfortable using Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto and production diagnostics to identify and resolve performance, memory and ANR issues.
  • Hands-on experience with Gradle configuration, dependency management, app signing, CI/CD and the full Google Play release process.
  • Experience connecting native Android code with a cross-platform framework, or a strong willingness to learn Flutter.
  • Familiarity with iOS and Swift is a plus.
  • Experience working with Java or legacy Android codebases is a plus.
  • Experience with Wear OS, Android TV or other Android form factors is a plus.
  • Experience with Firebase, crash reporting, analytics, Play Integrity or mobile observability tools is a plus.
  • Working proficiency in English.
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why AppNation?

  • Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally.
  • Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment.
  • Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build.
  • Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions.
  • Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options.

Our Hiring Process

Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews

At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Production Clerk
description:
Pay: $23.00-25.25 per hour

Jaylor Fabricating is looking for a Production Clerk to join our team.


What We Do:

We are a global manufacturer for the beef and dairy industry. We are known for our superior quality and innovation, and it’s our team that makes that possible. We are looking for people with a positive attitude who want to grow their career in a healthy, family-oriented environment — where you are truly valued.

At Jaylor, we deliver true TMR (total mixed ration), helping every dairy and beef farmer maximize profitability. Our high-quality mixers ensure superior mix quality and performance, supported by the Jaylor team’s unmatched service.


Why Work for Jaylor Fabricating?

Here at Jaylor, we are not just a company; we are a family-owned business where your work is truly valued, appreciated, and recognized. If you value building connections, doing meaningful work, and making a real impact on the farming community, come work with us.


Our Work Culture

We do not just work hard; we work with purpose. The team here at Jaylor brings energy and passion to everything we do, ensuring that farmers can depend on our equipment and our team.

At Jaylor, we have each other’s backs. We look out for each other, our customers, and our suppliers — knowing that teamwork drives success. We take pride in our work and never stop looking for ways to improve. From engineering and manufacturing durable mixers to providing top-notch service, we are constantly driving to deliver results that make a difference.

We value connection and team building here at Jaylor. We host multiple team and family events for our employees throughout the year such as barbecues, team lunches, quarterly events, and holiday events.


Key Responsibilities

  • Producing cutting programs for the Plasma operator(s) (custom & generic)
  • Assisting with closing jobs and confirming part availability from the plasma jobs.
  • Running fulfillment on jobs, analyzing parts shortages and notifying the appropriate department of such shortage.
  • Ensuring job completion and investigate any discrepancies for resolution.
  • Assisting with scheduling, job creation, and closing of jobs for sub-assembly operations and sub-contract operations.
  • Following up/expediting job status’ with Production Lead Hands.
  • Assisting with inventory control and quality assurance as required


Requirements

Required Skills

  • Experience: Must possess skills, training or knowledge in ERP systems, welding, press operation, and metal cutting machinery
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • The ability to coordinate and plan work activities and the ability to problem solve
  • The ability to work as a member of team.
  • Capable of reading and interpreting production and assembly drawings.
  • The ability to use a computer, including ERP systems
  • The physical ability to work in a manufacturing environment, including but not limited to light and heavy lifting.
  • Forklift and crane experience


We take our values seriously and we offer training, support and tangible benefits that raise the bar within our industry. We want to provide an exceptional working experience and attract the right people and reward them accordingly.


Benefits

Here at Jaylor, we offer a competitive health benefits plan that kicks in after only one month. The package includes life insurance, long-term disability and AD&D, medical, dental and vision care.

title: Year in Industry O&M Infrastructure
description:
RWE Renewables UK Management Ltd.
Start date in July 2027, full time, fixed term (12 months)

From here, you can join us at RWE Offshore Wind for a Year in Industry placement and gain invaluable insight into this truly unique and innovative sector. We’re one of the largest developers of offshore wind globally on a journey of significant growth determined by our Growing Green investment strategy as well as commitment to net zero.     • How we develop the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Infrastructure concepts for our future wind farms.

  • You're an enrolled student in one of the following degree courses: Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Construction Project Management.

  • You have very good verbal and written communication skills.

Please refer to the UK Government's National Security Vetting guidance for further details and eligibility requirements.

Advantageous, but not essential

  • You are trained or/and experienced in the following: Infrastructure projects, Construction management, Project management, Infrastructure design/architecture, site-based work.

Your benefits

  • Your salary will be in-line with the Real Living Wage.

  • Professional Development: Comprehensive training is provided, including Global Wind Organisation Certificate to work offshore, Wind Turbine Safety Rules Training, and In-house technical training.

This position is aimed at those currently studying who are eligible for a Year in Industry Placement. For those who will be graduating Summer 2027 we encourage you to apply for our graduate programme which will be advertised in January 2027.

An offer of employment in this role may require holding active or ability to pass National Security vetting to SC level. Failure to obtain and or maintain National Security Vetting to SC may result in the removal of job offers and or existing employment.

With over 20 years’ experience in developing, building, operating and maintaining offshore wind farms we have established long-term partnerships, working hand in hand with local businesses and communities. title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:

You will be responsible for keeping multiple recruitment processes running smoothly — from managing candidate information and coordinating interviews to handling time-sensitive requests across different stakeholders and time zones.

This role is ideal for someone who is meticulous, highly organised and comfortable managing a large volume of information and moving parts at the same time. You should enjoy creating structure, keeping things tidy and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Sounds great – what will I do?

  • Manage and maintain accurate candidate information across internal systems, ensuring data is complete, up to date and correctly captured.
  • Work closely with recruiters and other team members to support a high volume of candidate processes on a daily basis.
  • Prepare and present accurate candidate information to clients, ensuring all relevant details are captured and communicated clearly.
  • Coordinate a high volume of interviews, technical assessments and other recruitment activities across multiple candidates, stakeholders and time zones.
  • Manage calendars and scheduling changes, proactively resolving conflicts and ensuring all parties have the correct information and meeting details.
  • Track candidate progress throughout the recruitment process and follow up on outstanding actions, deadlines and feedback.
  • Consolidate and manage information received through different channels, including email, messaging platforms, internal systems and documents.
  • Conduct other candidate-related administrative processes where required.
  • Support the team with ad hoc administrative and operational tasks.
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies or potential issues in the recruitment process and take ownership of resolving them before they become problems.
  • Manage competing priorities effectively while maintaining a high level of accuracy and responsiveness.

Ideal Experience

  • Meticulous and detail-oriented — you naturally double-check information and take pride in getting the details right.
  • Organised and structured in the way you manage information, tasks, calendars and documentation.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple priorities simultaneously without losing track of deadlines or follow-ups.
  • Strong ability to coordinate schedules across different time zones, calendars and stakeholders.
  • Able to manage and organise a significant amount of information from multiple sources and channels.
  • Proactive and able to anticipate what needs to be done rather than waiting to be told.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability — if something is on your plate, you make sure it gets done.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, lean environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Independent and resourceful, while also being a strong team player.
  • Positive, service-oriented and customer-focused, with the ability to communicate professionally with candidates, clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office / Google Workspace and comfortable learning and using different software and systems to work efficiently.

  • Inspection Support:
    Conduct routine inspections of kitchen suppression systems, helping to identify any issues and catch up on past-due work orders.
  • Maintenance and Repairs:

  • Coverage for Absences:

  • Shop Support:
    Occasionally assist in the shop with inventory or other tasks as required.
  • Documentation:

title: Viestintä- ja yhteiskuntasuhteiden johtaja
description:
Helsingin yliopisto hakee

VIESTINTÄ- JA YHTEISKUNTASUHTEIDEN JOHTAJAA

vastaamaan yliopiston viestintä ja yhteiskuntasuhteiden toimialan johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä sekä toimimaan johdon strategisena kumppanina.

Tehtävästä

Viestintä- ja yhteiskuntasuhteiden johtaja toimii rehtorin, vararehtoreiden ja muun yliopiston johdon strategisena kumppanina viestinnän, vaikuttamisen ja yhteiskuntasuhteiden kysymyksissä. Johdat yliopiston viestinnän ja yhteiskuntasuhteiden toimialaa ja vastaat siitä, että sen toiminta tukee yliopiston strategiaa, vahvistaa yliopiston kansainvälistä tunnettuutta sekä edistää tieteen yhteiskunnallista vaikuttavuutta.

Johdat yli 100 asiantuntijan toimialaa ja sen tavoitteellista kehittämistä. Viestintä- ja yhteiskuntasuhteiden toimiala vastaa muun muassa strategisten hankkeiden viestinnästä, yliopiston brändistä, mediayhteyksistä, markkinoinnista, yhteiskunnallisesta vuorovaikutuksesta, alumnitoiminnasta, varainhankinnasta, Tiedekulman toiminnasta ja yliopiston päätapahtumien järjestämisestä.

Toimit osana yliopistopalveluiden johtoryhmää ja raportoit hallintojohtajalle. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja se alkaa 1.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Millaista johtajaa etsimme?

Etsimme kokenutta ja näkemyksellistä johtajaa, jolla on kyky johtaa viestinnän ja yhteiskuntasuhteiden kokonaisuutta strategisten tavoitteiden mukaisesti. Ymmärrät, miten tutkimukseen perustuva tieto, yhteiskunnallinen keskustelu ja päätöksenteko kytkeytyvät toisiinsa. Seuraat aktiivisesti toimintaympäristön muutoksia ja ennakoit niiden vaikutuksia Helsingin yliopistoon.

Hyödynnät päätöksenteossa tietoa, analytiikkaa ja tutkimusta. Ymmärrät teknologian ja tekoälyn vaikutuksia viestintään ja kehität jatkuvasti omaa ja organisaation osaamista. Luonteva vuorovaikutuksesi ulottuu yliopistoyhteisöstä mediaan, päättäjiin ja muihin yhteiskunnallisiin sidosryhmiin. Osaat vahvistaa yliopiston ja tieteen tunnettuutta globaalissa ympäristössä.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

* Vahvaa kokemusta viestinnän, yhteiskuntasuhteiden tai vaikuttamistyön johtamisesta ja strategisesta kehittämisestä
* Kykyä luoda selkeä pitkän aikavälin suunta sekä määrätietoisuutta asioiden viemisessä käytäntöön
* Taitoa viestiä vaikeistakin asioista ymmärrettävästi ja vakuuttavasti
* Kokemusta kriisiviestinnästä
* Tavoitteellista ja kehittävää johtamisotetta
* Erinomaista ymmärrystä yhteiskunnasta, päätöksenteosta ja mediaympäristöstä
* Soveltuvaa ylempää korkeakoulututkintoa


Kulttuurillisesti moninaisessa organisaatiossamme ja kansainvälisessä yhteistyössä tarvitset erinomaisen suomen kielen lisäksi sujuvaa englannin ja ruotsin kielen taitoa.


Miksi Helsingin yliopistoon?

Helsingin yliopistossa työskentelet ympäristössä, jossa tiede, koulutus ja yhteiskunta kohtaavat. Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten yliopisto kertoo tutkimuksestaan ja opetuksestaan, osallistuu yhteiskunnalliseen keskusteluun ja vahvistaa tieteen asemaa yhteiskunnassa. Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen ja laaja-alaisen johtamistehtävän Suomen kansainvälisesti tunnetuimmassa yliopistossa sekä mahdollisuuden työskennellä erittäin osaavan ja motivoituneen asiantuntijayhteisön kanssa. Toimintaamme ohjaavat arvot totuus, sivistys, vapaus ja yhteisöllisyys.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä motivaatiokirjeesi, ansioluettelosi ja palkkatoiveesi viimeistään 19.10.2026 Helsingin yliopiston rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta.

Rekrytointi toteutetaan yhteistyössä JFP Executive Search Oy:n kanssa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antavat esihenkilönä toimiva hallintojohtaja Esa Hämäläinen (02941 22212, admindirector@helsinki.fi) ja JFP Executive SearchMarkku Leskinen(markku.leskinen(at)jfp.fi),puh.0500 637003. Voit jättää myös soittopyynnön viestillä.
